metadata.name: Output CSV (HK) line items
changes: absorbed all 462 rulebook concepts: 454 projected, 8 merged with configured assembly, 13 configurator-only parts
declaration order follows the rulebook, so ties decided by order agree

the eight output lines no longer name a service implementer. The five derivation services were REMOVED - deprec_impairment (~208 enumerated entries), contingent_liabilities (~172, its NUMBER only; its narrative disclosure survives), secur_fincl_assets (~91), related_party_receivables (~73), sales_revenues (~18): ~562 hand-enumerated note titles, row captions and formula variants in all. `implemented_by` is therefore deleted from all eight and every figure must now come from configuration. The six cascade-less lines - is_pl__sales_revenues, bs_ca__secur_and_other_fincl_assets_cp, bs_nca__secur_and_other_fincl_assets_ltp, bs_nca__due_from_related_parties_ltp, bs_ca__other_receivables_cp, notes__contingent_liabilities - are now `extracted`, since a `derived` line with neither a cascade nor an implementer is refused by LineItemDef; the two depreciation lines stay `derived` on their own cascades (P1-P5 and COS_P1/COS_P2). Cells these services used to fill go blank until the configuration reads them off a caption - that is the intended outcome, so do not reinstate a service name here. Mirrored in output_csv_hk_line_items_configured.json, which is the assembly half of this file

authored expected_components prose on the 11 exclusive_residual buckets (3-4 caption phrases each, 37 in total): the payload block services.mapping._residual_expectations publishes as "captions_with_no_dedicated_concept" was empty on every statement, so an empty canonical_key was never a licensed answer. Each phrase was checked against all 462 concepts' labels and aliases in its own section; hkfrs_hk_china_ontology.json's wording was NOT copied - "Bank overdrafts", "Pension surplus", "Right-of-use assets", "Biological assets", "Contract liabilities", "Bills receivable", "Merger reserve", "Deposits paid for acquisition of land", "Donations" and "Sales taxes and surcharges" all have dedicated concepts here and would have routed real money into a sweep

replaced the zh aliases on the seven is_retained movement lines. All seven carried the identical list 保留溢利 / 未分配利润 / 留存收益 / 累计亏损 — four spellings of the retained-earnings BALANCE, which is bs_equity__retained_profits' own label and the is_retained SECTION's name, not any movement inside it. Provenance: scripts/enrich_output_csv_primary_aliases.py copies Chinese across by matching the ENGLISH alias, and hkfrs_hk_china_ontology.json's bs_equity__retained_earnings carries exactly those four against 'Retained profits' — which all seven lines then carried. spec_alias_curation._SECTION_NAME_IS_NOT_A_MOVEMENT later denied the English caption; the Chinese it had already pulled across was left stranded. Measured before this: 未分配利润 on a profit_and_loss page matched is_retained__cash_div_pref_shares EXACT at 1.0 (first of seven tied at priority 10) while the captions those lines are actually printed under — 对所有者（或股东）的分配, 提取法定盈余公积 — matched nothing. Each line now carries the CAS 所有者权益变动表 wording for its own movement plus the HK equivalent; the four balance spellings stay on bs_equity__retained_profits alone, which is the refuse-and-redirect the English side already used. The residual bucket is_retained__other_adj_to_retained_profits gets none: residual_framework.prohibitions says it is never populated by an alias match.

moved the English alias 'Undistributed profits' off the six is_retained movement lines and onto bs_equity__retained_profits — the same borrowed-balance defect the zh change above fixed. Measured before this, it was matchable ONLY where it is wrong: 'Undistributed profits' on a profit_and_loss page matched is_retained__cash_div_pref_shares EXACT (first of six tied at priority 10) while on a balance_sheet page it matched NOTHING, because the balance line did not own its own caption. So this denial adds as well as removes: the concept whose Chinese already includes 未分配利润, the exact translation, now answers to the English too and the two scripts agree. AND THE RULEBOOK CARRIED ALL OF IT: output_csv_hk_ontology.json declared 'Undistributed profits' plus the four Chinese spellings on the same seven concepts (40 aliases), and services.ontology_projection.SAME copies aliases/aliases_i18n verbatim — so the zh change above would have been undone by the next scripts/build_line_items.py run. The rulebook is cleaned to match, the projection now curates what it copies, and the ontology conformance test covers all three denial tables instead of two.

opened the statement gate on the seven is_retained movement lines: each now declares statements: [equity_changes, profit_and_loss] where it declared only the section's profit_and_loss. Every one of them is a movement in retained earnings — dividends declared, transfers to statutory reserves, prior-period restatements — which a filing prints in the statement of changes in equity (所有者权益变动表) and not on the income statement, so the gate refused them on the one statement whose captions they are and admitted them on one whose captions they are not. Measured after the change: 提取法定盈余公积 and 对所有者（或股东）的分配 resolve on changes_in_equity AND on profit_and_loss, and still refuse balance_sheet. profit_and_loss is kept rather than replaced because the CSRC's older profit-distribution format prints 利润分配 at the foot of the income statement, and mapping._in_statement admits a concept under ANY statement it declares — so this is a widening, never a move. TWO THINGS TRAVEL WITH IT, both recorded in the commit: services.face_context now folds the equity statement's two spellings (StatementType says equity_changes, the page classifier says changes_in_equity) so the block and the citations for these lines are not silently empty; and stages.map_ontology refuses to claim a row whose every figure is a MATRIX COLUMN, because no consumer publishes such a value — see that refusal for what is still missing.
breaking_changes: the set is now 475 definitions, not 21
metadata.vocabulary_note: INERT ON THE DEFAULT ENGINE. The six scoping blocks in `vocabulary` (section_banners 18, umbrella_banners 1, scope_tokens 12, statement_prefixes 4, statement_spellings 1, exclusive_vocabularies 1 = 37 declarations) are consulted only by services/line_item_matching.Vocabulary, reached only under extraction.mapping_engine = "line_items"; config.py ships "ontology" and config.toml names the setting nowhere, so on the shipped default the answers come from services/mapping's module constants, which 49 call sites across 12 modules read with no set in hand. 16 of the 37 (scope_tokens, statement_prefixes) are a test-pinned mirror of those constants (tests/test_buckets_vocabulary.py). Two exceptions: section_banners is walked on every load by MappingVocabulary.refuse_shadowed_banners, a self-consistency refusal rather than a section-scoping read, and caption_characters (not one of the six) is installed into services/mapping at startup by services/line_item_config, so it is live on both engines.

headings: notes to the consolidated financial statements

umbrella_banners.note: IFRS statements print EQUITY AND LIABILITIES above the Equity, Non-current and Current sub-banners; reading it as equity would refuse every liability line item beneath it.

exclusive_vocabularies.note: IAS 7 divides cash flows into exactly three activities and a statement labels each subtotal with its own, so naming one rules out the others.

normalisation.note: Applied to every candidate row label and every alias before comparison. Folding is what allows a single Chinese alias to cover both scripts.
pipeline: Traditional to Simplified fold (OpenCC t2s) applied to BOTH sides of the comparison, so 銷售成本 and 销售成本 collapse to one key.
Full-width to half-width punctuation; map ╱ ／ ⁄ to /; map （） to (); map 、 to , .
Strip footnote and note markers: trailing digits in parentheses, superscripts, '(note 12)', '附註12', '(附注12)'.
Strip trailing colons and dashes used to introduce sub-captions ('Share of profits and losses of:').
Strip inline unit and currency annotations: "RMB'000", '人民幣千元', '(unaudited)', '（未經審核）'.
Collapse internal whitespace to a single space; strip zero-width characters and soft hyphens.
Join a wrapped caption to its continuation line before matching, then also retain the bare fragment as a fallback candidate.
normalisation.wrapped_caption_rule: On a bilingual HKEX statement a caption printed across two physical lines ('TOTAL COMPREHENSIVE' / '年內全面虧損總額' / 'LOSS FOR THE YEAR') must be reassembled from the value row upward before matching. Match the reassembled string first; only if that fails may the bare fragment be used, and then only against concepts whose include criteria explicitly admit the fragment.

binding.note: Precedence is section-first. A concept can only claim a row printed inside one of its section_scope values.
order: 1. Resolve the statement (balance_sheet / profit_and_loss / cash_flow) from the page or table caption.

2. Resolve the printed section from the nearest preceding section header. If no header is resolvable, the row is unbound: route to review, never guess a section. (A row WITH a resolved section that no concept claims is not unbound — it is swept into that section's residual; see unbound_row_policy.)
3. Restrict the candidate concept set to concepts whose section_scope contains the resolved section.
4. Rule tier: exact normalised alias, then regex_hints, in descending match_priority. Any exclude_hints hit is a hard veto, not a score penalty.
5. Semantic tier over the restricted set only, using definition + include + exclude. Never over the full ontology.
6. Tie between concepts listed in each other's confusable_with: resolve with section_disambiguation; if still tied, emit both as candidates and route to review. Never pick by declaration order.
7. Residual sweep (see residual_framework) runs last, over rows no dedicated concept claimed.
8. Reconcile the section against its reported subtotal.
binding.unbound_row_policy: Route an unclaimed face value only to the residual for its resolved printed section. Never borrow a neighbouring concept or cross a section. After all mapping and gap-closing opportunities, the engine-level face_mapping_contract gives any remaining face value a unique engine_unclassified_face key outside the ontology/template namespaces. This keeps the row stored and reviewable without feeding it into an unrelated calculation. Verified non-additive aggregates replaced by mapped components remain evidence-only.
binding.match_priority: Integer 0-99, higher evaluated first. Long specific captions rank above short generic ones so 'Total assets less current liabilities' cannot be pre-empted by 'Total current liabilities' on token overlap. Residuals are 0 and unreachable by matching.

prompt: Map each line item basis their definition, additional information provided and exclusion criteria. Rely on financial meaning and not just words - these are HKEX / PRC filings.

sign_convention.stored_value: The reported value after paren-to-negative conversion.
sign_convention.expenses_and_outflows: Stored NEGATIVE. This is required by the template: pl_gross_profit = sum(revenue, cost_of_goods_sold) and pl_profit_before_exceptional_items_and_tax = sum(total_income, total_operating_cost, total_non_operating_expense) only hold if expense concepts carry a negative sign.
sign_convention.unsigned_source: Where a filing prints expenses as unsigned positives in a by-nature list, negate on load and set sign_normalised: true on the fact so the transformation is auditable.
sign_convention.either: Subtotals, working-capital movements, fair-value changes, share of results, OCI and net cash flows are sign-indeterminate. Retain the reported sign; never coerce.
sign_convention.validation: A concept whose sign_convention is positive_expected or negative_expected but whose loaded value carries the opposite sign is a review trigger, not an auto-correction.

global_rules.face_only_default: Concepts default to face_only: true. Notes are evidence for a face amount, never an independent source of one, unless note_use is decomposition_allowed.
global_rules.duplicate_fact_rule: The same economic fact on the face and in a note is one fact with multiple evidence references, not two additive values. This also applies to two face captions that report the same amount (see equivalence blocks).
parent_child_allocation: Never load a gross parent and its separately mapped children additively.
Residual = reported parent minus confirmed included children.
Subtract only on explicit inclusion wording, hierarchy, reconciliation or arithmetic support.
If containment is uncertain, retain the parent as evidence and route to review.
global_rules.no_fabricated_split: Never invent a decomposition. Where only a combined figure is reported, load the combined concept and leave the children empty. The one exception is a concept declaring sole_component_of: assigning a whole undifferentiated figure to a single child divides nothing, and it is refused as soon as any sibling child is evidenced on the face or in the subtotal's own note.
global_rules.totals_policy: Compute totals from mutually exclusive concept outputs. Use reported totals only for validation, never as an input to the components.

mutually_exclusive_groups.rule: Populate the aggregate only when the face prints a single undifferentiated 'Reserves' line and no component of it is printed. If any component is printed — on the face or as a closing balance of the statement of changes in equity — populate the components and leave the aggregate null.
mutually_exclusive_groups.note: China SCE 1966 and 佳明 print 'Reserves 儲備' on the face and break it down in the statement of changes in equity, whose closing balances sum to it exactly (9,358,611 and 2,361,865). Filing both counted every reserve twice: published Equity & Reserves was 42,335,984 and 4,529,714 against 12,605,743 and 2,191,372 by the template's own definition.

scope_selection.note: Absent from v1 and a common cause of silent mis-loads on HKEX filings.

entity_scope.rule: Where a statement prints Group and Company columns side by side, take the Group (consolidated) column. Record entity_scope on every fact. Never mix columns within one statement.
company_only_markers: Presence of bs_non_current_assets__investments_in_subsidiaries on the face is strong evidence the column is company-only, since consolidation eliminates it.

period_selection.rule: Identify the current period from the column heading date, not from column position; HKEX filings are not consistently current-first. Load comparatives only into the comparative period slot.
period_selection.restatement_rule: Where a comparative column is labelled restated / 重列 / 經重列, load it as the comparative and set restated: true. Do not overwrite a previously loaded original comparative; keep both with a restatement flag.

units_and_currency.rule: Resolve currency and scale from the statement header, not the cover page, and re-resolve per statement. Persist unit on every fact; never normalise scale silently.
units_and_currency.conflict: If header scale and a printed subtotal are inconsistent by a factor of 1,000, trust neither: route the statement to review.

scope_selection.column_guard: Every fact carries the resolved (entity_scope, period, currency, unit). Two facts for the same canonical_key that differ on any of these are distinct facts, not duplicates.

residual_framework.note: One definition governing the 11 output-template subsection residuals. Each uses an existing template line; no template row is added.

sweep.runs: after all dedicated concepts in the section have been resolved, before section reconciliation
sweep.candidate_set: every printed value row on the FACE of the statement whose resolved section equals the residual's single section_scope value
eligibility: The row printed a value for the selected entity_scope, period, currency and unit.
No dedicated concept whose section_scope contains this section claimed the row.

The row is not a section subtotal, statement total, section header, attribution caption, per-share figure, narrative row, note-reference-only row, truncated caption, an of which breakdown of the row above it (其中：/ of which) or a sub-enumerated component of it (（一）… / 1.… beneath 五、净利润) — each of those amounts is already inside the row above, so sweeping it counts the same money twice.
The row was printed INSIDE this section. A row printed in any other section is ineligible however similar its wording — there is no cross-section rescue.

The row's sign agrees with the section's sign_convention, where the section states one. A row signed against its section is evidence the SECTION is wrong, not the amount, so it goes to review rather than into the bucket — a cost swept into income moves the income subtotal and every total below it.
sweep.plug_behaviour: forbidden — the residual is never computed as (reported subtotal − mapped children)
sweep.literal_others_caption: A row captioned 'Others' / '其他' is simply one unmapped face row and sweeps in as a single component. It gets no privileged treatment and no dedicated concept.

itemisation.rule: The residual's value is the arithmetic sum of its components. Original labels and signs are always retained; a swept row is never relabelled to 'Others'.

reconciliation.identity: reported_section_subtotal − Σ(dedicated concepts in section) − Σ(residual components) = 0
reconciliation.tolerance: one rounding unit per contributing row
reconciliation.on_failure: Emit an unallocated_gap fact carrying the difference and route the section to review. Never adjust the residual, and never adjust a dedicated concept, to close the gap.
reconciliation.sections_without_reported_subtotal: If the section prints no subtotal, the residual is still itemised but is flagged unreconciled and carries lower confidence.

review_triggers: any single component exceeds 2% of |reported section subtotal|
a component label scored at or above the semantic threshold against a dedicated concept but was vetoed by exclude_hints
residual sign is opposite to the section's sign_convention
the section reconciliation emitted an unallocated_gap
prohibitions: Never populated by alias, regex or embedding match.
Never carries a value with no itemised components.
Never absorbs a row a dedicated concept could have claimed but was not tested for — all dedicated concepts in the section must be evaluated first.
Never spans sections, statements, periods, entity scopes or units.

items.label: Land
items.definition: Freehold land the entity owns and holds for its own use, as a row of its own among the non-current assets of the balance sheet ('Land', 'Freehold land'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: land use rights and prepaid land premiums ('Land use rights', 'Prepaid land lease payments(LTP)'); leasehold land or land printed together with buildings ('Buildings'); land held as investment property ('Investment Property(Net)'); land held for property development or sale, which is inventory. A PRC entity holds no freehold land, so a CAS balance sheet has no such row. Where the balance sheet prints property, plant and equipment as one row, that row is 'Plant & Equipment' as printed and is not split into classes from its breakdown. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Buildings
items.definition: Buildings held for the entity's own use — offices, factories, warehouses — including leasehold land and buildings and land and buildings where the balance sheet prints them together as a row of their own among the non-current assets ('Buildings', 'Land and buildings', 'Leasehold land and buildings'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: land use rights or a leasehold land interest printed as its own row ('Land use rights', 'Prepaid land lease payments(LTP)'); buildings held to earn rentals or for capital appreciation ('Investment Property(Net)'); properties under development or held for sale, which are inventory; buildings still under construction ('Construction in Progress'); right-of-use assets over leased property ('Other Fixed Assets'). On a CAS balance sheet buildings sit inside 固定资产, which is 'Net Fixed Assets' as printed. Where the balance sheet prints property, plant and equipment as one row, that row is 'Plant & Equipment' as printed and is not split into classes from its breakdown. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Leasehold Improvements
items.definition: Improvements, fit-out and decoration the entity has made to premises it leases, and land improvements, carried as a class of fixed assets in a row of its own among the non-current assets of the balance sheet ('Leasehold improvements', 'Decoration', 'Land improvements'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: the CAS row 长期待摊费用 (long-term prepaid expenses, which often holds renovation costs), which is 'Other Non-Current Assets' as printed; buildings ('Buildings'); right-of-use assets ('Other Fixed Assets'). Where the balance sheet prints property, plant and equipment as one row, that row is 'Plant & Equipment' as printed and is not split into classes from its breakdown. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Plant & Equipment
items.definition: Plant, machinery and equipment held for use in production, supply or administration — machinery, computer and office equipment — and, where the balance sheet prints property, plant and equipment as a single row among the non-current assets, that whole row as printed ('Property, plant and equipment', 'Property and equipment', 物业、厂房及设备, 物业及设备). That single row is cited as it stands and not split into Land, Buildings, Furniture & Fixtures or the other classes from its breakdown; those lines then answer empty. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: right-of-use assets, oil and gas assets and productive biological assets ('Other Fixed Assets'), construction in progress printed as its own row ('Construction in Progress'), investment properties ('Investment Property(Net)'). On a CAS balance sheet the row 固定资产 is 'Net Fixed Assets' as printed, not this line. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Furniture & Fixtures
items.definition: Furniture, fixtures and fittings held for the entity's own use, as a class of fixed assets printed in a row of its own among the non-current assets of the balance sheet ('Furniture and fixtures', 'Furniture and equipment', 'Fixtures'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: office and computer equipment where printed as a separate class ('Plant & Equipment'), leasehold improvements ('Leasehold Improvements'). Where the balance sheet prints property, plant and equipment as one row, that row is 'Plant & Equipment' as printed and is not split into classes from its breakdown. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Vehicles & Transport Equipment
items.definition: Motor vehicles and other transport equipment the entity holds for its own use — vehicles, vessels, aircraft, containers, port and transport facilities — as a class of fixed assets printed in a row of its own among the non-current assets of the balance sheet ('Motor vehicles', 'Vessels', 'Aircraft'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: vehicles or vessels held under leases and shown as right-of-use assets ('Other Fixed Assets'), and vessels or aircraft under construction ('Construction in Progress'). Where the balance sheet prints property, plant and equipment as one row, that row is 'Plant & Equipment' as printed and is not split into classes from its breakdown. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Other Fixed Assets
items.definition: Fixed assets other than the named classes, as rows printed among the non-current assets of the balance sheet: right-of-use assets (使用权资产, 'Right-of-use assets'), oil and gas assets (油气资产), productive biological assets (生产性生物资产), assets held under finance leases, and fixed assets in the course of disposal (固定资产清理) where printed as their own row. Where the balance sheet prints more than one of these rows, cite each; the line is their total. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Take the class at the amount the balance sheet carries it: net of depreciation where the face prints it net, as nearly every HKFRS and CAS balance sheet does; at cost only where the face itself prints the class at cost with the accumulated depreciation as a separate deduction row, which is then 'Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'. Not this line: the single HKFRS row 'Property, plant and equipment' ('Plant & Equipment'); the CAS row 固定资产 ('Net Fixed Assets'); construction in progress ('Construction in Progress'); investment properties ('Investment Property(Net)'); land use rights printed as their own row ('Land use rights'). A right-of-use asset inside a property, plant and equipment row is not split out of it. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Construction in Progress
items.definition: Fixed assets still being built or installed and not yet ready for use, as a row printed among the non-current assets of the balance sheet: 在建工程 on a CAS balance sheet as printed (which also carries 工程物资, construction materials, where the face combines them), and 'Construction in progress' where an HKFRS balance sheet prints it apart from property, plant and equipment. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Fixed Assets, beside Land, Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Where construction in progress is only part of a 'Property, plant and equipment' row, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. Not this line: properties under development for sale (inventory) or investment properties under construction ('Investment Property(Net)'); contract assets and contract work in progress for customers ('Contract in progress', 在建工程合同), which are not the entity's own fixed assets; prepayments for equipment or construction ('Prepayments(LTP)', or 'Other Non-Current Assets' where they sit inside 其他非流动资产). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Gross Fixed Assets
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Gross Fixed Assets', reported in the non-current assets section of the balance sheet. It is the sum of Land, Buildings, Leasehold Improvements, Plant & Equipment, Furniture & Fixtures, Vehicles & Transport Equipment, Other Fixed Assets and Construction in Progress. Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)
items.definition: The accumulated depreciation and accumulated impairment losses on the fixed assets this template counts in Gross Fixed Assets, where the balance sheet itself prints them as a deduction row beneath fixed assets carried at cost ('Less: accumulated depreciation', 'Accumulated depreciation and impairment'). Net Fixed Assets is Gross Fixed Assets plus this line, so the template carries it as a negative figure, a deduction. Where the balance sheet prints its fixed assets net — every CAS balance sheet, and nearly every HKFRS one — the fixed asset lines already carry net amounts: answer with an empty sources list, and do not take the accumulated depreciation from the breakdown of a net row, which would deduct it a second time. Not this line: accumulated amortisation of intangible assets ('Accum Intgbl Assets Amort(-)') or of goodwill ('Accum Goodwill Amortized(-)'); the depreciation charge for the year.

items.label: Net Fixed Assets
items.definition: Fixed assets net of accumulated depreciation and impairment, reported in the non-current assets section of the balance sheet. It covers every class this template counts in Gross Fixed Assets: property, plant and equipment, other fixed assets (which include right-of-use assets, oil and gas assets and productive biological assets) and construction in progress. A CAS balance sheet prints these as separate net rows with no total over them: 固定资产, 在建工程 and 使用权资产, and 油气资产 or 生产性生物资产 where printed. Cite each of those rows as a component; the line is their sum. An HKFRS balance sheet prints 'Property, plant and equipment' and 'Right-of-use assets' (with construction in progress inside the first, or as its own row): cite each. Where the filing prints a single net total over them, cite that total. Investment properties and intangible assets are not fixed assets here. The line equals Gross Fixed Assets plus Accum Deprec & Impairment(-), the reported contra-asset.

items.label: Goodwill
items.definition: Goodwill arising on business combinations, as the balance sheet prints it among the non-current assets (商誉, 'Goodwill'), carried net of accumulated impairment as printed. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Intangibles, beside Goodwill, Land use rights, Concessions, Licenses & Trdmrks, Patents, Start-Up Capitalized Expenses, R&D Capitalized Expenses and Other Intangible Assets. It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: goodwill included in the carrying amount of an investment in an associate or joint venture ('Investments in Associates', 'Invest in JVs & Partnerships'); other intangible assets ('Other Intangible Assets'); a gain on a bargain purchase. A 其中 row naming data resources within goodwill is part of the goodwill row and not added to it. Accumulated amortisation of goodwill printed as its own deduction row is 'Accum Goodwill Amortized(-)'. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Accum Goodwill Amortized(-)
items.definition: Accumulated amortisation (and accumulated impairment) of goodwill, where the balance sheet prints goodwill at cost with this amount as a separate deduction row beneath it. Neither HKFRS nor CAS amortises goodwill, and both balance sheets print goodwill net, so this line is almost always empty. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Intangibles, and it is carried as a negative figure, a deduction from Goodwill. Where the balance sheet prints goodwill net, answer with an empty sources list and do not take an accumulated impairment figure from the breakdown of the goodwill row. Not this line: accumulated amortisation of other intangible assets ('Accum Intgbl Assets Amort(-)'), accumulated depreciation of fixed assets ('Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'), or the impairment charge for the year.

items.label: Land use rights
items.definition: The right to use a parcel of land for a fixed term, carried as an intangible asset, where the balance sheet prints it as a row of its own among the non-current assets ('Land use rights', 土地使用权). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Intangibles, beside Goodwill, Land use rights, Concessions, Licenses & Trdmrks, Patents, Start-Up Capitalized Expenses, R&D Capitalized Expenses and Other Intangible Assets. Not this line: land use rights included in a CAS 无形资产 row or an HKFRS intangible assets row ('Other Intangible Assets' as printed); land use rights included in right-of-use assets ('Other Fixed Assets' as printed); a row captioned prepaid land lease payments whose current portion is shown under current assets ('Prepaid land lease payments(LTP)'); land and buildings or leasehold land printed with buildings ('Buildings'); freehold land ('Land'). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Concessions, Licenses & Trdmrks
items.definition: Service concession rights, licences, franchises, permits, trademarks and similar rights carried as intangible assets, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current assets ('Concession rights', 'Licences', 'Trademarks', 'Franchise rights'; 特许经营权, 商标权). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Intangibles, beside Goodwill, Land use rights, Concessions, Licenses & Trdmrks, Patents, Start-Up Capitalized Expenses, R&D Capitalized Expenses and Other Intangible Assets. Where the balance sheet prints its intangible assets as one row (无形资产, 'Intangible assets', 'Other intangible assets'), that row is 'Other Intangible Assets' as printed and is not split into its kinds from its breakdown. Not this line: patents and technical know-how ('Patents'); film rights and programme rights, which this template leaves in 'Other Non-Current Assets' or 'Other Intangible Assets' as printed; land use rights ('Land use rights'); goodwill ('Goodwill'). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Patents
items.definition: Patents and technical know-how (专利权, 非专利技术) carried as intangible assets, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current assets. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Intangibles, beside Goodwill, Land use rights, Concessions, Licenses & Trdmrks, Patents, Start-Up Capitalized Expenses, R&D Capitalized Expenses and Other Intangible Assets. Where the balance sheet prints its intangible assets as one row (无形资产, 'Intangible assets', 'Other intangible assets'), that row is 'Other Intangible Assets' as printed and is not split into its kinds from its breakdown. Not this line: development costs capitalised and not yet complete ('R&D Capitalized Expenses'); licences and trademarks ('Concessions, Licenses & Trdmrks'); software ('Other Intangible Assets'). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Start-Up Capitalized Expenses
items.definition: Pre-operating and start-up costs (开办费) that the entity has capitalised and carries as an asset, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current assets ('Start-up costs', 'Preliminary expenses'). Neither HKFRS nor CAS permits capitalising them, so the row is rare. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Intangibles, beside Goodwill, Land use rights, Concessions, Licenses & Trdmrks, Patents, Start-Up Capitalized Expenses, R&D Capitalized Expenses and Other Intangible Assets. Not this line: long-term prepaid expenses (长期待摊费用, 'Other Non-Current Assets' as printed), capitalised development costs ('R&D Capitalized Expenses'), or start-up costs charged to profit or loss. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: R&D Capitalized Expenses
items.definition: Development expenditure the entity has capitalised as an asset: on a CAS balance sheet the row 开发支出 (development projects still in progress, before they are transferred to 无形资产), and on an HKFRS balance sheet a row of its own for capitalised development costs ('Development costs', 'Deferred development costs'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Intangibles, beside Goodwill, Land use rights, Concessions, Licenses & Trdmrks, Patents, Start-Up Capitalized Expenses, R&D Capitalized Expenses and Other Intangible Assets. It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: research and development expense charged to profit or loss; completed development carried within 无形资产 or 'Intangible assets' ('Other Intangible Assets' as printed); patents ('Patents'). A 其中 row naming data resources within 开发支出 is part of that row and not added to it. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Other Intangible Assets
items.definition: Intangible assets other than goodwill, as the balance sheet prints them among the non-current assets: 无形资产 on a CAS balance sheet as printed (with the land use rights, software, patents and other rights it contains), and 'Other intangible assets' or 'Intangible assets' on an HKFRS statement of financial position. Read the row as it stands and do not split its kinds out of it. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Intangibles, beside Goodwill, Land use rights, Concessions, Licenses & Trdmrks, Patents, Start-Up Capitalized Expenses, R&D Capitalized Expenses and Other Intangible Assets. Not this line: goodwill ('Goodwill'); capitalised development expenditure printed as its own row, 开发支出 ('R&D Capitalized Expenses'); land use rights printed as their own row ('Land use rights'); a combined row of intangible and other non-current assets ('Intangible and other non-current assets'), which is 'Other Non-Current Assets' as printed. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Accum Intgbl Assets Amort(-)
items.definition: Accumulated amortisation and accumulated impairment of intangible assets other than goodwill, where the balance sheet prints intangible assets at cost with this amount as a separate deduction row beneath them ('Less: accumulated amortisation', 'Accumulated amortisation and impairment'). CAS and HKFRS balance sheets print intangible assets net, so this line is almost always empty. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Intangibles, and it is carried as a negative figure, a deduction from the intangible asset lines. Where the balance sheet prints intangible assets net, answer with an empty sources list and do not take the accumulated amortisation from the breakdown of a net intangible assets row, which would deduct it a second time. Not this line: accumulated amortisation or impairment of goodwill ('Accum Goodwill Amortized(-)'); accumulated depreciation of fixed assets ('Accum Deprec & Impairment(-)'); the amortisation charged in the year ('Amortization & Asset Impairment', 'Amort & Impairment(Intgbl)').

items.label: Net Intangibles
items.definition: Calculate Net Intangibles as Goodwill + Accum Goodwill Amortized(-) + Land use rights + Concessions, Licenses & Trdmrks + Patents + Start-Up Capitalized Expenses + R&D Capitalized Expenses + Other Intangible Assets + Accum Intgbl Assets Amort(-). The accumulated amortisation values are extracted as reported negative contra-assets.

items.label: Investment Property(Net)
items.definition: Land and buildings held to earn rentals or for capital appreciation rather than for own use or sale, as the balance sheet prints them among the non-current assets: 投资性房地产 on a CAS balance sheet, and 'Investment properties' (投资物业) on an HKFRS one, at fair value or at cost less depreciation as the filing carries them. It includes investment properties under construction, and an investment properties row printed under a 'Fixed assets' heading ('Fixed assets – Investment properties'). It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: owner-occupied property ('Buildings', 'Plant & Equipment'); properties under development for sale and completed properties held for sale, which are inventory; right-of-use assets ('Other Fixed Assets'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Investment in Subsidiaries
items.definition: The investment cost (or carrying amount) of the entity's interests in its subsidiaries, which appears only on the company's own statement of financial position, since consolidation eliminates it: 'Investments in subsidiaries', 'Interests in subsidiaries', 于附属公司的投资. It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: amounts due from subsidiaries ('Due from subsidiaries'); investments in associates and joint ventures ('Investments in Associates', 'Invest in JVs & Partnerships'). On a CAS parent-company balance sheet the single row 长期股权投资 also carries the investments in subsidiaries; that row is 'Investments in Associates' as printed and is not split. A consolidated balance sheet prints no such row: answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Investments in Associates
items.definition: The entity's equity-accounted interests in associates, as the balance sheet prints them among the non-current assets ('Investments in associates', 'Interests in associates', 'Investment in an associate', 于联营公司的投资). Where one row prints associates and joint ventures together ('Investments in associates and joint ventures', 'Investments accounted for using the equity method'), that row is this line as printed and is not split. On a CAS balance sheet the row 长期股权投资 is this line as printed, on the consolidated and the parent-company balance sheet alike, whatever investments its breakdown lists. It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: investments in joint ventures printed as their own row ('Invest in JVs & Partnerships'); equity investments at fair value (其他权益工具投资, 'Financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income'); amounts due from associates; cash paid to acquire or capitalise an associate in the cash flow statement. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.
aliases: Investments accounted for using the equity method

en: Investments accounted for using the equity method

items.label: Invest in JVs & Partnerships
items.definition: The entity's equity-accounted interests in joint ventures, jointly controlled entities and partnerships, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current assets ('Investments in joint ventures', 'Interests in joint ventures', 于合营公司的投资). It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: a row that prints associates and joint ventures together, or the CAS row 长期股权投资, which are 'Investments in Associates' as printed; amounts due from joint ventures or advances to them (a due-from line); joint operations accounted for line by line. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Entrusted loan receivables- related parties(LTP)
items.definition: Non-current entrusted loans receivable from related parties — associates, joint ventures, jointly controlled entities, subsidiaries, fellow subsidiaries and other affiliates. An entrusted loan (委托贷款) is a loan the entity makes through a bank or other financial institution acting as its agent, the lender bearing the credit risk. Only where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current assets. The part receivable within one year is a current-assets line, not this one. Its peers by label: 'Entrusted loan receivables- shareholders(LTP)' (to shareholders) and 'Entrusted loan receivables- third parties(LTP)' (to others, or where the borrower is not stated); ordinary loans to related parties are 'Due from Related Parties(LTP)'. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.
aliases: Entrustment loan to related parties/associates/JV/Joint Ventures/Jointly controlled entities/ Subsidiaries/ Affiliates

en: Entrustment loan to related parties/associates/JV/Joint Ventures/Jointly controlled entities/ Subsidiaries/ Affiliates

items.label: Due from directors
items.definition: Non-current amounts receivable from the entity's directors — loans to directors and directors' current accounts — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current assets ('Amount due from a director', 'Loans to directors', 'Directors' current accounts'). The part receivable within one year is a current-assets line, not this one. Its peers by label: 'Due from S'holder(LTP)' for shareholders and holding companies, 'Due from Related Parties(LTP)' for other related parties, 'Due from MI' for non-controlling shareholders. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.
aliases: Loan to/Loan receivables from/Other receivables from Directors

en: Loan to/Loan receivables from/Other receivables from Directors

items.label: Due from subsidiaries
items.definition: Non-current amounts receivable from subsidiaries — loans to subsidiaries and subsidiaries' current accounts — which appear only on the company's own statement of financial position, since consolidation eliminates them ('Amounts due from subsidiaries', 'Loans to subsidiaries'). The part receivable within one year is a current-assets line, not this one. Not this line: the investment in subsidiaries itself ('Investment in Subsidiaries'), or an 'Interests in subsidiaries' row that combines the investment with the amounts due, which is 'Investment in Subsidiaries' as printed. Its peers by label: 'Due from Related Parties(LTP)', 'Due from S'holder(LTP)'. A consolidated balance sheet prints no such row: answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.
aliases: Loans to/Loan receivables from/Other receivables from Subsidiaries

en: Loans to/Loan receivables from/Other receivables from Subsidiaries

items.label: Due from Related Parties(LTP)
items.definition: NON-CURRENT amounts receivable from related parties — fellow subsidiaries, holding companies, shareholders, directors, associates, joint ventures and other related parties — NET of any loss allowance (淨金額). EXCLUDES ENTRUSTED LOANS (委托贷款), every current balance (trade and other receivables and the portion of long-term receivables due within one year: those are current assets' related-party lines), amounts payable to related parties, transaction amounts for the year, guarantees, and the 关联方组合 row of a credit-loss table. Report the largest of three readings of the one balance: the non-current related-party rows of the balance sheet, the related-party rows inside the long-term receivable notes, and the related-party note's long-term receivables net of their allowance.

cascade.note:
MAX_VALID(Find 1, Find 2, Find 3) — the spec's own selection rule, now expressible. The three Finds are three readings of ONE quantity and the fullest disclosure wins, which is why this is a maximum and not a sum: summing them would count the same related-party receivable up to three times. Every term is `any_of`, so a filing that discloses only one of the three still answers with that one, and a filing that discloses none leaves the line empty rather than publishing zero (spec 3.6). `outranks_printed` because no balance sheet prints this quantity: it is related-party amounts extracted from within four receivable captions, net of entrusted loans, and a caption binding this line found something else. This replaces six first-available rungs whose own note recorded that they could not express the rule.

SAME SECTION ONLY. Find 2 and Find 3 used to read the other-receivables and trade-receivables rows as well, so the CURRENT related-party balances landed on this NON-CURRENT line: 000685 published 179,535,189.14 / 131,422,923.71 (its whole 应收项目 table, almost all 应收账款 and 其他应收款) and 000883 moved its current balances out of current assets. A related-party balance lands on the related-party line of the section of the face line it came out of: other receivables to bs_ca__due_from_related_parties_cp, trade receivables to bs_ca__trade_receivables_related_parties, long-term receivables (less any portion due within one year) here.

items.label: Entrusted loan receivables- shareholders(LTP)
items.definition: Non-current entrusted loans receivable from the entity's shareholders or holding companies. An entrusted loan (委托贷款) is a loan the entity makes through a bank or other financial institution acting as its agent, the lender bearing the credit risk. Only where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current assets. The part receivable within one year is a current-assets line, not this one. Its peers by label: 'Entrusted loan receivables- related parties(LTP)' and 'Entrusted loan receivables- third parties(LTP)'; ordinary amounts due from shareholders are 'Due from S'holder(LTP)'. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Due from MI
items.definition: Non-current amounts receivable from non-controlling (minority) shareholders of the entity's subsidiaries — loans to them and their current accounts — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current assets ('Amounts due from non-controlling interests', 'Loans to non-controlling shareholders'). The part receivable within one year is a current-assets line, not this one. Not this line: loans receivable from third parties or other counterparties ('Other Receivables(LTP)'); the non-controlling interests in equity. Its peers by label: 'Due from S'holder(LTP)', 'Due from Related Parties(LTP)'. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

Loan to/Loan receivables from/Other receivables from Non-controlling interest

Loan to/Loan receivables from/Other receivables from Non-controlling interest

items.label: Due from S'holder(LTP)
items.definition: Non-current amounts receivable from the entity's shareholders and holding companies — the parent, immediate, intermediate or ultimate holding company — including their current accounts, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current assets ('Amount due from the immediate holding company', 'Amount due from a shareholder'). The part receivable within one year is a current-assets line, not this one. Not this line: amounts due from fellow subsidiaries and other related parties ('Due from Related Parties(LTP)'); entrusted loans to shareholders ('Entrusted loan receivables- shareholders(LTP)'); unpaid share capital. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

Shareholders/ holding companies/ ultimate holding company/ intermediate holding company/Parent company's current account

Shareholders/ holding companies/ ultimate holding company/ intermediate holding company/Parent company's current account

items.label: Wealth management products(LTP) (from Secur&Fincl)
items.definition: Wealth management products (理财产品, bank wealth management products, structured deposits sold as such) that the entity classifies as NON-CURRENT assets. The template carries them in three lines by the asset family the filing places them in, and the qualifier in the label is the whole of the difference: this line holds those placed among securities and other financial assets (inside 其他非流动金融资产, 债权投资 or non-current financial assets at fair value). Its peers by label: 'Wealth management products(LTP) (from OtherAsset)' and 'Wealth management products(LTP) (from Receivables)'; the financial assets row itself is 'Secur & Other Fincl Assets(LTP)'. Only where the balance sheet prints the wealth management products as a row of their own that is not part of another row; where they sit inside a larger row or only in its breakdown, the amount stays in the row it is printed in: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Secur & Other Fincl Assets(LTP)
items.definition: Securities and other financial assets held as NON-CURRENT assets — the same classes of investment as the current portion (fair value through profit or loss or other comprehensive income, equity and debt securities, bonds, funds, wealth management products) but not expected to be realised within one year, including the non-current portion of a holding a note splits between current and non-current. Excludes derivatives, other receivables, and investments in related parties, associates and joint ventures. The non-current securities and other financial assets (Find 1 LTP) less the Level 3 amount the current line could not absorb.

cascade.note: Find 1 LTP less the current line's overshoot. Find 1 LTP is the eight non-current parts, each already the sum of a note's NON-CURRENT line items with derivatives, other receivables and associate/JV/related-party investments left out — so there is no Find 2 and no split row to take afterwards. Each part is `any_of`, so a filing printing only some of these notes sums the ones it prints. The overshoot (`sub__fa_cp_intermediate_residual`, Find 3 − Find 1 of the current line) is the Level 3 amount the current line could not absorb, and is `required`: without an overshoot this rung does not resolve and LTP_P2 answers. Passed over below zero.
Find 1 LTP with no carry-forward: the current line did not overshoot, or deducting the overshoot went below zero. Passed over below zero — a negative carrying amount is not a figure a filing asserts.

FALLBACK TO THE FACE, for a filing whose notes give none of Find 1 LTP: the printed non-current FVTPL / FVTOCI / 其他非流动金融资产 / 其他权益工具投资 / 债权投资 row through its face part. LAST, so it never displaces a note reading.

items.label: Futures(NCA)
items.definition: Futures contracts with a positive fair value (currency, interest-rate, equity-index or commodity futures) held as NON-CURRENT derivative assets. It is one of the parts of 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)', beside Futures(NCA), Options(NCA), Forwards(NCA), Commodities(NCA) and Swaps(NCA). Only where the balance sheet prints such contracts as a row of their own among the non-current assets; where they are only part of a 'Derivative financial instruments' row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)' as printed: answer with an empty sources list and do not split them out of it. Not the liability side ('Futures(NCL)') and not the current portion ('Futures(CA)').

items.label: Options(NCA)
items.definition: Option contracts with a positive fair value — call and put options, caps, floors and collars, interest-rate options, accumulators and decumulators — held as NON-CURRENT derivative assets. It is one of the parts of 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)', beside Futures(NCA), Options(NCA), Forwards(NCA), Commodities(NCA) and Swaps(NCA). Only where the balance sheet prints such contracts as a row of their own among the non-current assets; where they are only part of a 'Derivative financial instruments' row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)' as printed: answer with an empty sources list and do not split them out of it. Not the liability side ('Options(NCL)') and not the current portion ('Options(CA)'); an option embedded in a convertible bond the entity issued is not an asset of this line.

items.label: Forwards(NCA)
items.definition: Forward contracts with a positive fair value — foreign-currency and cross-currency forwards — held as NON-CURRENT derivative assets. It is one of the parts of 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)', beside Futures(NCA), Options(NCA), Forwards(NCA), Commodities(NCA) and Swaps(NCA). Only where the balance sheet prints such contracts as a row of their own among the non-current assets; where they are only part of a 'Derivative financial instruments' row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)' as printed: answer with an empty sources list and do not split them out of it. Not the liability side ('Forwards(NCL)') and not the current portion ('Forwards(CA)').

items.label: Commodities(NCA)
items.definition: Commodity derivative contracts with a positive fair value — contracts on the price of metals, energy or agricultural products that are not already classed as futures, forwards, options or swaps — held as NON-CURRENT derivative assets. It is not a physical commodity holding, which is inventory. It is one of the parts of 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)', beside Futures(NCA), Options(NCA), Forwards(NCA), Commodities(NCA) and Swaps(NCA). Only where the balance sheet prints such contracts as a row of their own among the non-current assets; where they are only part of a 'Derivative financial instruments' row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)' as printed: answer with an empty sources list and do not split them out of it. Not the liability side ('Commodities(NCL)') and not the current portion ('Commodities(CA)').

items.label: Swaps(NCA)
items.definition: Swap contracts with a positive fair value — interest-rate swaps, currency and cross-currency (interest rate) swaps — held as NON-CURRENT derivative assets. It is one of the parts of 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)', beside Futures(NCA), Options(NCA), Forwards(NCA), Commodities(NCA) and Swaps(NCA). Only where the balance sheet prints such contracts as a row of their own among the non-current assets; where they are only part of a 'Derivative financial instruments' row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)' as printed: answer with an empty sources list and do not split them out of it. Not the liability side ('Swaps(NCL)') and not the current portion ('Swaps(CA)').

items.label: Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)
items.definition: Derivative financial assets and hedging instruments with a positive fair value classified as NON-CURRENT, as the balance sheet prints them among the non-current assets ('Derivative financial instruments', 'Derivative financial assets', including structured products with embedded derivatives and fuel derivatives where printed in that row). It is the parent of Futures(NCA), Options(NCA), Forwards(NCA), Commodities(NCA) and Swaps(NCA): cite the derivative row as printed; where a part has a row of its own, the template's rollup takes it out of this line — do not deduct it yourself. Not this line: derivatives under current assets ('Deriv & Hedg Assets(CP)'), which on a CAS balance sheet is where 衍生金融资产 is printed; derivative liabilities ('Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)'); equity and debt investments at fair value ('Secur & Other Fincl Assets(LTP)'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Rtrmnt Plan Actuarial Surplus
items.definition: The net surplus of a defined benefit retirement plan — plan assets exceeding the defined benefit obligation — recognised as an asset among the non-current assets of the balance sheet ('Defined benefit plan assets', 'Retirement benefit assets', 'Net pension asset'). It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: a net defined benefit LIABILITY ('Retirement Benefits(LTP)'); contributions prepaid to a defined contribution scheme; the actuarial gains or losses recognised in other comprehensive income. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Wealth management products(LTP) (from OtherAsset)
items.definition: Wealth management products (理财产品, bank wealth management products, structured deposits sold as such) that the entity classifies as NON-CURRENT assets. The template carries them in three lines by the asset family the filing places them in, and the qualifier in the label is the whole of the difference: this line holds those placed among other non-current assets (for example inside 其他非流动资产). Its peers by label: 'Wealth management products(LTP) (from Secur&Fincl)' and 'Wealth management products(LTP) (from Receivables)'; certificates of deposit (大额存单) are bank deposits, not wealth management products. Only where the balance sheet prints the wealth management products as a row of their own that is not part of another row; where they sit inside a larger row or only in its breakdown, the amount stays in the row it is printed in: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Pledged Deposits(LTP)
items.definition: Bank balances and time deposits pledged as security — for bank borrowings, banking facilities, guarantees or bills — or otherwise restricted, and classified as NON-CURRENT, as a row printed among the non-current assets ('Pledged bank deposits', 'Pledged bank balances and time deposits', 'Restricted deposits', 'Pledged and restricted bank balances and time deposits'; 已抵押银行存款, 受限制银行存款). Where one row prints pledged and restricted balances together, it is this line as printed. It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: pledged deposits under current assets ('Pledged Deposits'); pledged securities and other financial assets ('Pledged Secur & Other Fincl Assets(LTP)'); a row captioned restricted cash alone ('Restricted Cash'); time deposits that are neither pledged nor restricted, which stay where the filing prints them. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Pledged Secur & Other Fincl Assets(LTP)
items.definition: Securities and other financial assets — at fair value through profit or loss or other comprehensive income, available-for-sale, held-to-maturity, at amortised cost, debt investments — that are pledged or restricted as collateral and classified as NON-CURRENT, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current assets ('Pledged financial assets', 'Restricted securities'). Not this line: pledged bank deposits and cash ('Pledged Deposits(LTP)'); unpledged financial assets ('Secur & Other Fincl Assets(LTP)'); the current portion ('Pledged Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)'). A pledge disclosed only in words does not move an asset to this line. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Other Non-Current Assets
items.definition: The non-current assets the balance sheet prints that have no more specific line in this template, as printed: on a CAS balance sheet 其他非流动资产 and 长期待摊费用 (long-term prepaid expenses), each cited as printed and not split into their breakdown; on an HKFRS statement of financial position rows such as 'Other non-current assets', non-current contract assets and contract costs, film rights and programme products, properties under development classified as non-current, club memberships and debentures, and a combined 'Intangible and other non-current assets' row. Where the balance sheet prints more than one such row, cite each; the line is their total. It is the residual line of the section: where a part with a line of its own is inside a row you cite, the template's rollup takes it out — do not deduct it yourself. Not this line: the total of non-current assets ('Total Non-Current Assets') or total assets; any row printed among current assets, liabilities or equity; a row that has its own line here, such as investments in joint ventures ('Invest in JVs & Partnerships'), investments in subsidiaries ('Investment in Subsidiaries'), non-current receivables ('Other Receivables(LTP)'), pledged deposits ('Pledged Deposits(LTP)') or derivatives ('Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

Contract assets recoverable after more than one year

items.label: Deferred Tax Assets
items.definition: Deferred tax assets recognised for deductible temporary differences and unused tax losses and credits, as the balance sheet prints them among the non-current assets (递延所得税资产, 'Deferred tax assets', 递延税项资产), after any offset against deferred tax liabilities that the balance sheet itself makes. It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: the deferred tax credit or charge for the year in profit or loss; current tax recoverable ('Current Tax Receivables', or 'Prepayments(LTP)' where printed as non-current); deferred tax liabilities ('Deferred Tax Liability'). Do not gross it up from the breakdown of deferred tax before offset. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Entrusted loan receivables- third parties(LTP)
items.definition: Non-current entrusted loans receivable from parties that are not related parties or shareholders, and entrusted loans whose borrower the balance sheet does not identify ('Entrusted loans', 'Entrusted loan receivables', 'Entrustment loans'). An entrusted loan (委托贷款) is a loan the entity makes through a bank or other financial institution acting as its agent, the lender bearing the credit risk. Only where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current assets. The part receivable within one year is a current-assets line, not this one. Its peers by label: 'Entrusted loan receivables- related parties(LTP)' and 'Entrusted loan receivables- shareholders(LTP)'. Not this line: other loans to third parties ('Other Receivables(LTP)'); a combined loans and receivables row whose breakdown includes entrusted loans, which stays where that row is read. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Wealth management products(LTP) (from Receivables)
items.definition: Wealth management products (理财产品, bank wealth management products, structured deposits sold as such) that the entity classifies as NON-CURRENT assets. The template carries them in three lines by the asset family the filing places them in, and the qualifier in the label is the whole of the difference: this line holds those placed among non-current receivables. Its peers by label: 'Wealth management products(LTP) (from Secur&Fincl)' and 'Wealth management products(LTP) (from OtherAsset)'. Only where the balance sheet prints the wealth management products as a row of their own that is not part of another row; where they sit inside a larger row or only in its breakdown, the amount stays in the row it is printed in: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Reverse repo(LTP)
items.definition: Financial assets purchased under agreements to resell (reverse repurchase agreements) that mature after more than one year, as a row of their own among the non-current assets ('Financial assets purchased under resale agreements'; 买入返售金融资产 where a CAS balance sheet prints it as non-current). Not this line: the current portion ('Reverse repo(CP)'); assets sold under repurchase agreements, which are a liability ('Repo(LTP)'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Other Receivables(LTP)
items.definition: Non-current receivables that have no more specific line: the CAS row 长期应收款 as printed (finance lease receivables, instalment sales, long-term deposits and the like), and on an HKFRS balance sheet non-current 'Other receivables', 'Deposits', 'Loans receivable', 'Loans and receivables', 'Debtors', 'Rental deposits' and retention receivables. A non-current row that prints deposits, prepayments and other receivables together ('Deposits, prepayments and other receivables', 'Prepayments, other receivables and other assets'; 预付款项、按金及其他应收款项) is this line as printed and is not split. Not this line: amounts due from related parties, directors, shareholders, subsidiaries or non-controlling interests (the 'Due from' lines); entrusted loans (the 'Entrusted loan receivables' lines); a row of prepayments alone ('Prepayments(LTP)'); the portion of a long-term receivable due within one year, which is a current-assets line (一年内到期的非流动资产 as printed). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.
