items.label: Prepaid land lease payments(LTP)
items.definition: The NON-CURRENT portion of up-front payments for leasehold land, where the balance sheet prints it as a row of its own among the non-current assets ('Prepaid land lease payments', 'Prepaid lease payments'), usually with the portion to be released within one year shown under current assets ('Prepaid land lease payments(CP)'). Since HKFRS 16 most filings carry these payments within right-of-use assets, which are 'Other Fixed Assets' as printed and are not split. Not this line: land use rights carried as intangible assets ('Land use rights'); deposits paid for the acquisition of land ('Prepayments(LTP)'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

items.label: Prepayments(LTP)
items.definition: Payments made in advance that the entity will not recover or use within one year, as a row of their own among the non-current assets: prepayments and deposits paid for the acquisition of property, plant and equipment, land or subsidiaries; advances to suppliers for long-term supply; and income tax prepaid or recoverable where printed as non-current ('Prepayments', 'Deposits paid for acquisition of property, plant and equipment', 'Prepaid tax'; 预缴税项, 可收回税项). Not this line: a row that prints prepayments together with other receivables, which is 'Other Receivables(LTP)' as printed; the CAS row 其他非流动资产, which is 'Other Non-Current Assets' as printed even where its breakdown lists 预付设备款 or 预付工程款; prepaid land lease payments ('Prepaid land lease payments(LTP)'); current prepayments ('Prepayments(CP)'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.
aliases: deposit paid for acquisition of PPE
Advances of purchase property, plant and equipment

en: deposit paid for acquisition of PPE
Advances of purchase property, plant and equipment

items.label: Restricted Cash
items.definition: Cash and bank balances whose use is restricted — by regulation, a court order, an escrow or a supervision account — and that are classified as NON-CURRENT, where the balance sheet prints them in a row captioned as restricted cash among the non-current assets ('Restricted cash', 受限制现金). It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: deposits pledged as security, or a row printing pledged and restricted balances together ('Pledged Deposits(LTP)'); restricted cash under current assets; cash and cash equivalents. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Assets.

zh: 受限制现金及银行结余

items.label: Total Non-Current Assets
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Total Non-Current Assets', reported in the non-current assets section of the balance sheet. It is the sum of the 34 lines this template's rollup adds up under it, among them Net Fixed Assets, Net Intangibles, Investment Property(Net), Investment in Subsidiaries, Investments in Associates, Invest in JVs & Partnerships, Entrusted loan receivables- related parties(LTP) and Due from directors. Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.
aliases: Due from related parties (definition in C32 of NCA)

en: Due from related parties (definition in C32 of NCA)

items.label: Operating Lease Receivables
items.definition: Amounts receivable by the company as LESSOR under operating leases, held as a current asset: rent and lease payments receivable from tenants and lessees, and accrued rental income from straight-lining lease incentives, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own ('Operating lease receivables', 'Lease receivables', 'Rental receivables', 应收经营租赁款). Read the printed row. Not this line: finance lease receivables and other loans and receivables of a leasing business; trade receivables from the sale of goods and services ('Trade Receivables(Gross)'); right-of-use assets and lease liabilities of a lessee; any non-current lease receivable. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Raw materials
items.definition: Inventory of raw materials: materials, components, direct materials, packing materials, consumables and spare parts held for use in production, a part of Inventories. It is the row the balance sheet prints for them in the current assets section ('Raw materials', 原材料). Read the printed row. Where the face prints only an inventories total, that total is 'Inventories' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split the total yourself. Its peers inside Inventories are 'WIP' (work in progress, properties under development) and 'Finished goods' (finished goods, merchandise, goods in transit, completed properties held for sale). Not this line: spare parts and equipment capitalised as property, plant and equipment, and prepayments for materials not yet received ('Prepayments(CP)').

items.label: WIP
items.definition: Inventory in the course of production: work in progress (在产品) and, for a property developer, properties under development held for sale in the ordinary course of business ('Properties under development', 'Properties held for sale under development', 发展中物业, 开发中物业, 在建开发产品), printed as a row in the current assets section. It is a part of Inventories. Read the printed current row. A row of properties under development printed under non-current assets (land and development held for longer than the operating cycle) is not this line. Where the face prints only an inventories total, that total is 'Inventories' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split the total yourself. Its peers are 'Raw materials' and 'Finished goods' (which takes completed properties held for sale). Not this line: construction in progress on the company's own fixed assets, investment properties under construction, and contract assets on construction contracts ('Other Current Assets').

items.label: Finished goods
items.definition: Inventory ready for sale: finished goods, merchandise and goods for resale (库存商品), goods in transit and, for a property developer, completed properties held for sale ('Completed properties held for sale', 'Completed properties for sale', 已完工待售物业, 已落成待售物业, 持作出售已落成物业), printed as a row in the current assets section. It is a part of Inventories. Read the printed row. Where the face prints only an inventories total, that total is 'Inventories' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split the total yourself. Its peers are 'Raw materials' and 'WIP' (which takes properties under development). Not this line: investment properties held for rental ('Investment Property(Net)'), and assets of a disposal group classified as held for sale ('Assets Related to Disc Ops'), even where the caption says 'held for sale'.

zh: 持作销售的已完工物业

items.label: Inventories
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Inventories', reported in the current assets section of the balance sheet. It is the sum of Raw materials, WIP and Finished goods. Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Due from JVs & Partnerships
items.definition: Current amounts receivable from joint ventures and partnerships, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own in the current assets section: 'Amount due from a joint venture', 'Amounts due from joint ventures', 'Due from joint ventures', 'Due from partnerships' (应收合营企业款项, 應收合營公司款項). Read the printed row. Not this line: a row covering related parties generally ('Due from related parties', which is 'Due from Related Parties(CP)'); amounts due from associates printed with other related parties; entrusted loans to joint ventures ('Entrusted loan receivables- related parties(CP)'); the investment in joint ventures, which is a non-current asset; any non-current balance due from joint ventures. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Entrusted loan receivables- related parties(CP)
items.definition: Entrusted loans (委托贷款) the company has made to RELATED PARTIES other than its shareholders — associates, joint ventures, fellow subsidiaries and other related companies — through a bank or other financial institution acting as trustee, falling due within one year and printed in the current assets section ('Entrusted loans to related parties', 'Entrusted loan receivables from related parties'). Read the printed row. Its peers are 'Entrusted loan receivables- shareholders(CP)' (to shareholders) and 'Entrusted loan receivables- third parties(CP)' (to unrelated borrowers); the part due after one year is 'Entrusted loan receivables- related parties(LTP)'. Not this line: other amounts due from related parties ('Due from Related Parties(CP)'), and entrusted loans the company has borrowed, which are liabilities. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Due from Related Parties(CP)
items.definition: Amounts receivable from related parties within CURRENT assets, net of their loss allowance: the balance the balance sheet prints as a line of its own, plus the related-party balances the notes state are inside other receivables (current), which leave that line and arrive here. Excludes entrusted loans, trade receivables from related parties (their own line) and every non-current balance.

cascade.note: WHAT LEAVES A FACE LINE ARRIVES ON THE RELATED-PARTY LINE OF THE SAME SECTION. bs_ca__other_receivables_cp deducts sub__cp_other_receivables_rp (the related-party balances the note files under 其他应收款) on every rung, so the same figure is added here and total current assets is unchanged. Before, nothing received it: 000685 lost 38,748,507.73 / 92,901,866.49 from total current assets and total assets. Plus the printed "Due from related parties" row, through its face part (a derived line is unmatchable by caption). NOT carved_from_face: both terms are amounts the section total counts only through this line. Both `any_of`, so a filing with neither leaves the line empty. `received`: the term's configured parent is Other Receivables (CP), so it is declared as arriving here, which is what makes this cascade run on a filing that prints no related-party row of its own.

items.label: Due from related parties (printed, CP)
items.definition: The current-assets row the balance sheet prints for amounts due from related parties.

items.label: Entrusted loan receivables- shareholders(CP)
items.definition: Entrusted loans (委托贷款) the company has made to its SHAREHOLDERS, including a controlling shareholder or holding company, through a bank or other financial institution acting as trustee, falling due within one year and printed in the current assets section ('Entrusted loan receivables from shareholders'). Read the printed row. Its peers are 'Entrusted loan receivables- related parties(CP)' (to other related parties) and 'Entrusted loan receivables- third parties(CP)'; the part due after one year is 'Entrusted loan receivables- shareholders(LTP)'. Not this line: other amounts due from shareholders ('Due from S'holder(CP)'), and share capital called but not paid ('Subscribed Capital-Called Not Paid'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Due from S'holder(CP)
items.definition: Current amounts receivable from the company's shareholders — a controlling shareholder, the immediate or ultimate holding company, or other equity holders — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own: 'Amount due from a shareholder', 'Due from shareholders', 'Amount due from the immediate holding company', 应收股东款项. Read the printed row. Not this line: share capital called but not paid ('Subscribed Capital-Called Not Paid'); entrusted loans to shareholders ('Entrusted loan receivables- shareholders(CP)'); amounts due from directors; a row covering related parties generally ('Due from Related Parties(CP)'); the non-current balance ('Due from S'holder(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Short Term Securities
items.definition: Marketable securities held as a current asset, where the balance sheet prints them in a row captioned as short-term securities or short-term investments ('Short-term securities', 'Short-term investments', 'Marketable securities', and the older CAS row 短期投资). Read the printed row. The current financial assets the face prints by measurement category — 'Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss', 'Financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income', 'Debt investments at amortised cost', CAS 交易性金融资产 — are 'Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)', not this line. Not this line: wealth management products printed as such ('Wealth management products(CP) (from Secur&Fincl)'); derivatives ('Deriv & Hedg Assets(CP)'); pledged securities ('Pledged Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)'); deposits and cash equivalents. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Wealth management products(CP) (from Secur&Fincl)
items.definition: Wealth management products held as a CURRENT asset that the filing presents among its securities and financial assets, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own: 'Wealth management products', 'Bank wealth management products' (理财产品, 银行理财产品), 'Structured deposits' where printed as wealth management products. Read the printed row. Wealth management products the filing places inside its cash and cash equivalents, its other current assets or its receivables are 'Wealth management products(CP) (from cash equ.)', '(from OtherAsset)' and '(from Receivables)'. Where the face prints only a financial assets row (CAS 交易性金融资产, 'Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss'), that row is 'Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. The non-current holding is 'Wealth management products(LTP) (from Secur&Fincl)'. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)
items.definition: Securities and other financial assets held as CURRENT assets — financial assets at fair value through profit or loss and through other comprehensive income, listed and unlisted equity and debt securities, corporate and government bonds, investment and money market funds, wealth management products, structured deposits and certificates of deposit, expected to be realised within one year. Excludes derivative assets, other receivables, and cash and cash equivalents. The current securities and other financial assets (Find 1) less the Level 3 fair-value total (Find 3), floored at zero.

cascade.note: Find 1 − Find 3. Find 1 is the six current parts, each already the sum of a note's CURRENT line items with derivatives and other receivables left out — so there is no Find 2 and no non-current deduction to take afterwards. Each part is `any_of`, so a filing printing only some of these notes sums the ones it prints. Find 3 (Level 3) is an `adjustment`, so a filing with no fair value hierarchy table subtracts nothing. PASSED OVER WHEN IT COMPUTES BELOW ZERO, and the next rung then publishes zero.

Zero WHEN FIND 1 − FIND 3 WENT BELOW ZERO, and only then. `sub__fa_cp_intermediate_residual` resolves only in that case (it is Find 3 − Find 1, passed over when negative), so min(0, residual) is 0 exactly where the rule says "treat Find 1 as Find 3 and make this field zero"; the overshoot itself is carried to Securities (LTP). AHEAD OF THE FACE, so an overshoot publishes zero rather than falling through to the printed row.

FALLBACK TO THE FACE, for a filing whose notes give none of Find 1: the printed current trading / FVTPL row through its face part. `derived` keys are unmatchable by caption, so without this part the printed row reached no column and the residual sweep filed it on the section's catch-all. LAST, so it never displaces a note reading, and after CP_ZERO, so a Level 3 overshoot publishes zero rather than the face.

items.label: Futures(CA)
items.definition: Futures contracts with a positive fair value held as current assets — exchange-traded futures on currencies, interest rates, commodities or indices (including cross-currency futures) — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('Futures contracts', 'Currency futures', 期货合约). Read the printed row. Its peers by instrument are 'Options(CA)', 'Forwards(CA)', 'Commodities(CA)' and 'Swaps(CA)'. Where the filing prints only one derivatives row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(CP)' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. The part due after one year is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)', and derivative liabilities are 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)'.

items.label: Options(CA)
items.definition: Option contracts with a positive fair value held as current assets — call and put options, caps, floors and collars, interest rate options, accumulators and decumulators — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('Options', 'Call/put options', 期权). Read the printed row. Its peers by instrument are 'Futures(CA)', 'Forwards(CA)', 'Commodities(CA)' and 'Swaps(CA)'. Not this line: share options granted to employees, which are equity ('Other Reserves'). Where the filing prints only one derivatives row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(CP)' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. The part due after one year is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)', and derivative liabilities are 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)'.

items.label: Forwards(CA)
items.definition: Forward contracts with a positive fair value held as current assets — foreign currency forwards, cross-currency forwards and other forward contracts — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('Forward foreign exchange contracts', 'Currency forwards', 远期合约). Read the printed row. Its peers by instrument are 'Futures(CA)', 'Options(CA)', 'Commodities(CA)' and 'Swaps(CA)'. Where the filing prints only one derivatives row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(CP)' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. The part due after one year is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)', and derivative liabilities are 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)'.

items.label: Commodities(CA)
items.definition: Commodity derivative contracts with a positive fair value held as current assets — commodity futures, forwards and swaps on metals, energy, agricultural or other commodities — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('Commodity contracts', 'Commodity derivatives', 'Commodities'). This line sits with the derivative lines, not with inventory. Read the printed row. Its peers by instrument are 'Futures(CA)', 'Options(CA)', 'Forwards(CA)' and 'Swaps(CA)'. Not this line: physical commodities and raw materials held as inventory ('Raw materials', 'Finished goods', 'Inventories'). Where the filing prints only one derivatives row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(CP)' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. The part due after one year is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)', and derivative liabilities are 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)'.

items.label: Swaps(CA)
items.definition: Swap contracts with a positive fair value held as current assets — interest rate swaps, foreign currency swaps and cross-currency interest rate swaps — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('Interest rate swaps', 'Cross currency swaps', 掉期合约, 互换合约). Read the printed row. Its peers by instrument are 'Futures(CA)', 'Options(CA)', 'Forwards(CA)' and 'Commodities(CA)'. Where the filing prints only one derivatives row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(CP)' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. The part due after one year is 'Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)', and derivative liabilities are 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)'.

items.label: Deriv & Hedg Assets(CP)
items.definition: Derivative financial instruments and hedging instruments with a positive fair value, held as CURRENT assets: the row the balance sheet prints in the current assets section — HKFRS 'Derivative financial instruments' (衍生金融工具), 'Derivative financial assets', 'Derivatives'; CAS 衍生金融资产 — including derivatives designated as cash flow or fair value hedges. Read the printed row. Where the filing prints derivatives by instrument as separate current rows, those rows are 'Futures(CA)', 'Options(CA)', 'Forwards(CA)', 'Commodities(CA)' and 'Swaps(CA)'; the arithmetic between this line and them is declared in this template's rollup, so do not split the printed row yourself. Not this line: derivative liabilities ('Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)'), the same row printed under non-current assets ('Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)'), and non-derivative financial assets at fair value ('Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Assets Plgd Under Securitization
items.definition: Current assets pledged or transferred under a securitisation that remain on the company's balance sheet — receivables, loans or other assets placed in an asset-backed securitisation vehicle and still recognised — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own ('Assets pledged under securitisation', 'Securitised receivables'). Read the printed row. Not this line: pledged deposits ('Pledged Deposits'); pledged securities and financial assets ('Pledged Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)'); the same receivables where the filing does not print them apart from its other receivables; the asset-backed securities issued, which are a liability. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Current Tax Receivables
items.definition: Income tax the company is owed by tax authorities and expects to recover within one year, printed as a row of its own in the current assets section: 'Income tax receivable', 'Profits tax receivable', 'Current tax assets' (应收税项资产), 'Current income tax assets'. Read the printed row. A row printed as prepaid tax, prepaid income tax or tax recoverable (预付税项, 预付所得税, 预缴企业所得税, 可收回税项) is 'Prepayments(CP)', where this template places it. Not this line: deferred tax assets ('Deferred Tax Assets', non-current); VAT and other indirect taxes recoverable printed within other current assets; current tax payable, which is a liability ('Current Tax Payable'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Prepaid land lease payments(CP)
items.definition: The current portion of prepaid land lease payments — up-front payments for leasehold land or land use rights that are released to profit or loss over the lease term, the part to be released within one year — where the balance sheet prints it as a current row of its own ('Prepaid land lease payments', 'Prepaid land lease payments - current portion'). Read the printed row. The part released after one year is 'Prepaid land lease payments(LTP)'; land use rights carried as an intangible asset are 'Land use rights'. Not this line: right-of-use assets, general prepayments ('Prepayments(CP)'), and land held by a property developer for development ('WIP'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Prepayments(CP)
items.definition: Amounts paid in advance for goods, services and assets not yet received, held as a current asset: CAS 预付款项; HKFRS 'Prepayments', advances to suppliers, purchase and trade deposits paid, deposits paid for acquisitions (including of property, plant and equipment) where printed in the current section, and temporary payments. It also takes the tax paid in advance that a filing prints as a row of its own — 'Prepaid tax', 'Prepaid income tax', 'Tax recoverable' (预付税项, 预缴税项, 可收回税项). Read the printed row. Not this line: a row that prints prepayments together with deposits and other receivables ('Prepayments, deposits and other receivables', 预付款项、按金及其他应收款项), which is 'Trade and other receivables'; prepaid land lease payments ('Prepaid land lease payments(CP)'); income tax receivable ('Current Tax Receivables'); the non-current prepayments ('Prepayments(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

Advances of purchase property, plant and equipment

items.label: Assets Related to Disc Ops
items.definition: Assets classified as held for sale and the assets of a disposal group or discontinued operation, printed as a row of their own at the foot of the current assets section: HKFRS 'Assets classified as held for sale', 'Assets held for sale', 'Assets of a disposal group classified as held for sale'; CAS 持有待售资产. Read the printed row. Not this line: completed properties held for sale in the ordinary course of business, which are inventory ('Finished goods'); the liabilities directly associated with the assets held for sale, which are a liability; investment properties and other non-current assets not reclassified as held for sale. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Pledged Deposits
items.definition: Bank deposits and cash that are pledged as security or otherwise restricted in use, held as a CURRENT asset and printed as a row of their own in the current assets section: 'Pledged deposits' (已抵押存款), 'Pledged bank deposits', 'Restricted cash' (受限制现金), 'Restricted deposits', 'Restricted and pledged deposits' (受限制及已抵押存款), 'Pledged and restricted bank balances and time deposits', or deposits and cash held as collateral. Read the printed current row. The non-current portion, printed under non-current assets, is 'Pledged Deposits(LTP)'; where one row carries both, the arithmetic that keeps the non-current part out is declared in this template's rollup, so do not split it yourself. A CAS balance sheet normally keeps its restricted funds inside 货币资金, which is 'Cash in Hand and at Banks'; this line then has no face figure. Not this line: unrestricted cash and deposits ('Cash in Hand and at Banks', 'Cash Equivalents'); pledged securities and other financial assets ('Pledged Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)'); client money held in trust ('Segregated Account(CA)').

items.label: Pledged Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)
items.definition: Securities and other financial assets held as CURRENT assets that are pledged as collateral or restricted in use, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own: pledged or restricted financial assets at fair value through profit or loss or through other comprehensive income, available-for-sale or held-to-maturity assets, financial assets at amortised cost, debt investments and other debt investments, and securities 'as collateral'. Read the printed row. Not this line: the same assets unpledged ('Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)'); pledged or restricted bank deposits and cash ('Pledged Deposits'); assets pledged under a securitisation ('Assets Plgd Under Securitization'); non-current pledged assets. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Wealth management products(CP) (from OtherAsset)
items.definition: Wealth management products held as a current asset that the filing presents WITHIN its other current assets — the bank wealth management products and structured deposits a CAS filing commonly holds inside 其他流动资产 — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own. Read the printed row. Where they are only inside the printed other current assets row, that row is 'Other Current Assets' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. Its peers are the other wealth management product lines, named by where the filing presents them: '(from Secur&Fincl)', '(from cash equ.)' and '(from Receivables)'. The non-current holding is 'Wealth management products(LTP) (from OtherAsset)'.

items.label: Segregated Account(CA)
items.definition: Money held for clients in segregated, trust or client accounts and shown as a current asset: a broker's, securities house's or agent's 'Cash held on behalf of clients' or 'Cash held on behalf of customers', 'Client account', 'Customer account', 'Trust account', 'Client's bank balance' or 'Segregated account', and the clearing settlement funds a securities or futures business holds (结算备付金). Read the row the balance sheet prints. It is not the company's own cash ('Cash in Hand and at Banks'), and not deposits pledged for the company's own borrowings ('Pledged Deposits'). A matching liability to the clients is not netted against it. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Suspense Account(CA)
items.definition: A current-asset suspense or clearing balance: amounts the company has paid or recorded but not yet allocated to their final account, printed in the current assets section as a row of their own ('Suspense account', 'Suspense payments', 'Items in transit'), and, on an older-format CAS balance sheet, unprocessed losses of current assets awaiting approval (待处理流动资产损溢). Read the printed row. It is rarely printed under HKFRS or current CAS. Not this line: prepayments and deposits paid ('Prepayments(CP)'), other receivables ('Other Receivables(CP)'), and the catch-all 'Other Current Assets'.

items.label: Other Current Assets
items.definition: The current assets the balance sheet prints that no more specific current-asset line of this template takes: on a CAS balance sheet 其他流动资产 and 一年内到期的非流动资产 as printed, and 合同资产; on an HKFRS statement 'Other current assets', 'Contract assets', 'Amounts due from customers for contract work', 'Contract costs' and costs incurred to obtain or fulfil a contract, and other rows of the current assets section that no other line names. Read each such row as printed. The current-asset lines this template breaks out — inventories and their parts, receivables, prepayments, derivatives, securities, deposits and cash among them — are their own lines, and the arithmetic that keeps them out of this line is declared in this template's rollup; do not net them off yourself. Not this line: the current assets total ('Total Current Assets'), total assets, any row printed under non-current assets, equity or liabilities.

items.label: Trade receivables- related parties
items.definition: Trade receivables due from related parties — the parent, fellow subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures and other related companies — held as a current asset, NET of their loss allowance. Where the related-party disclosure tabulates balances under the heading 应收账款 with a carrying amount (账面余额) and a loss allowance (坏账准备) but no net column, the line is the carrying amount less the allowance; otherwise it is the face row 'Trade receivables- related parties' or 'Trade receivables from related parties'. This template derives the figure from those parts; do not assemble it yourself. Not this line: other receivables, prepayments and loans due from related parties ('Due from Related Parties(CP)'); a single row of trade AND other receivables from related parties ('Trade and other receivables- related parties'); entrusted loans; amounts payable to related parties; transaction amounts for the year. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

cascade.note: THE NET, because the note publishes only the two halves. A 关联方应收应付款项 table is laid out 项目名称 | 账面余额 | 坏账准备 | 账面余额 | 坏账准备 and prints no net column, so the net is gross LESS allowance — the same shape sub__rp_find_3 uses for the same table. Measured on 000709: 952,791,540.11 less 573,861,138.36 = 378,930,401.75; 河北承钢工贸's allowance EQUALS its gross. THE DOUBLE COUNT WITH FIND 3 IS DELIBERATE: the 应收账款 group read here is also inside sub__rp_find_3_gross, which feeds bs_nca__due_from_related_parties_ltp, so 000709's 378,930,401.75 publishes in both columns — instructed: "for now want to double count on related parties". The two parts read two columns of the same rows, so both must be given the note (see line_item_notes.claimed_notes: siblings compete only for the same measure).

FALLBACK TO THE FACE, on the same grounds as the related-party payable twins: `line_items.evaluate` runs a cascade only for a `derived` line and `mapping._computed_parent` makes every `derived` key unmatchable by caption, so giving this column a note route would otherwise cost it its aliases outright. They move to a PART, which is the shape `sub__face_principal_revenue` uses for `is_pl__sales_revenues`. LAST, so the note rung above — the specific disclosure — can never be displaced by the face.

items.label: Trade and other receivables- related parties
items.definition: Trade and other receivables due from related parties printed together as ONE current-asset row: 'Trade and other receivables- related parties', 'Trade and other receivables from related parties', 'Amounts due from related companies (trade and non-trade)'. Read the printed row. Where the filing separates the trade part, that part is 'Trade receivables- related parties' and the other balances are 'Due from Related Parties(CP)'; this line is only the combined row. Not this line: a 'Trade and other receivables' row covering third parties ('Trade and other receivables'); amounts due from joint ventures or shareholders printed on their own ('Due from JVs & Partnerships', 'Due from S'holder(CP)'); entrusted loans; any non-current balance.

items.label: Trade and other receivables
items.definition: Current receivables that the balance sheet prints in ONE row together with trade receivables, or other receivable rows this template files here: HKFRS 'Trade and other receivables' (贸易及其他应收款项, 应收账款及其他应收款项), 'Accounts and other receivables', and combined rows of prepayments, deposits and other receivables (预付款项、按金及其他应收款项, 按金、预付款项及其他应收款); on a CAS balance sheet 应收票据 (bills receivable), 应收款项融资 (receivables financing) and 其他应收款项, and an insurer's 应收保费 and 应收分保账款. Read the printed row. Where trade receivables are printed in a row of their own, that row is 'Trade Receivables(Gross)', and related-party balances printed apart are 'Trade and other receivables- related parties'; the arithmetic between this line and those two is declared in this template's rollup, so do not split the combined row yourself. Not this line: a trade receivables row alone (应收账款, 'Trade receivables', 'Debtors'); other receivables printed alone ('Other Receivables(CP)'); prepayments printed alone ('Prepayments(CP)'); amounts due from related parties printed alone ('Due from Related Parties(CP)'); any non-current receivable. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Trade Receivables(Gross)
items.definition: Trade receivables at their gross carrying amount, before the loss allowance: amounts due from customers for goods sold and services rendered, held as a current asset. The balance sheet normally prints trade receivables net of the allowance, and that net row is not this line. On a CAS filing this line is the 合计 of the 账面余额 column in the disclosed breakdown of 应收账款, before 坏账准备 is deducted — not the 账面价值. On an HKFRS filing it is the gross amount of trade receivables ('Trade receivables', 'Trade and bills receivables', 'Debtors', 'Accounts receivable') before the impairment or loss allowance, as the filing's breakdown of them prints it. Where the balance sheet itself prints the gross amount and the allowance as rows of their own, this line is the gross row. Where the filing states no allowance on trade receivables, the gross and the net amount are the same figure. The allowance is 'Allow for Doubtful Accounts(-)', carried as a negative figure, and this template's rollup adds the two lines into Net Trade Receivables, which is therefore the gross amount less the allowance. Trade receivables from related parties are 'Trade receivables- related parties'; the arithmetic that keeps them out of this line is declared in this template's rollup. Not this line: a row that prints trade and other receivables together ('Trade and other receivables'); bills receivable and receivables financing (应收票据, 应收款项融资), which this template files on 'Trade and other receivables'; other receivables ('Other Receivables(CP)'); contract assets; non-current trade receivables.

items.label: Allow for Doubtful Accounts(-)
items.definition: The loss allowance on trade receivables — the provision for impairment, expected credit losses or bad and doubtful debts held against them at the end of the period — which takes trade receivables from their gross amount to their net carrying amount. On a CAS filing it is the 合计 of the 坏账准备 column in the disclosed breakdown of 应收账款; on an HKFRS filing it is the loss or impairment allowance that the filing's breakdown of trade receivables deducts ('Less: loss allowance', 'Allowance for credit losses', 'Provision for impairment of trade receivables'). Where the balance sheet itself prints the allowance as a row of its own beneath the gross trade receivables, it is that row. Cite the figure as printed, which is normally unsigned: the template carries this line as a negative figure, a deduction, and this template's rollup adds it to 'Trade Receivables(Gross)' to make Net Trade Receivables. It is the balance at the end of the period, not a movement: not the impairment loss of the year ('Bad Debt Expense'), and not the amounts provided, reversed or written off in the year. Not this line: the allowance on other receivables, on bills receivable or receivables financing, on contract assets or on long-term receivables. Where the filing states no allowance on trade receivables, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Net Trade Receivables
items.definition: Trade receivables net of the loss allowance: their carrying amount, which the balance sheet normally prints as its trade receivables row among the current assets — CAS 应收账款 as printed, HKFRS 'Trade receivables', 'Accounts receivable' or 'Debtors' as printed. Read the printed row. It is Trade Receivables(Gross) less Allow for Doubtful Accounts(-), which is carried as a negative figure; this template's rollup adds those two lines into this one, so do not compute it here and do not replace a printed figure with one added up from them. Where the balance sheet prints no trade receivables row of its own, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup. Not this line: a row that prints trade and other receivables together ('Trade and other receivables').

items.label: Subscribed Capital-Called Not Paid
items.definition: Share capital that shareholders have subscribed and that has been called up but not yet paid, presented as an asset in the current assets section ('Subscribed capital called but not paid', 'Called-up share capital not paid', 'Capital contribution receivable', 应收股东出资). Read the printed row. It is not deducted from share capital here: 'Common Share Capital' stays as printed. Not this line: other amounts due from shareholders ('Due from S'holder(CP)'), and treasury shares ('Treasury Shares(-)'), which are a deduction from equity. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Entrusted loan receivables- third parties(CP)
items.definition: Entrusted loans (委托贷款) the company has made to borrowers that are not related parties, through a bank or other financial institution acting as trustee, falling due within one year and printed in the current assets section: 'Entrusted loan receivables', 'Entrusted loans', 'Entrustment loan'. Where the row does not say who the borrower is, it is this line. Read the printed row. Its peers are 'Entrusted loan receivables- related parties(CP)' and 'Entrusted loan receivables- shareholders(CP)', which take loans to those borrowers; the part due after one year is 'Entrusted loan receivables- third parties(LTP)'. Not this line: other loans and receivables ('Other Receivables(CP)'), and entrusted loans the company has borrowed, which are liabilities. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Wealth management products(CP) (from Receivables)
items.definition: Wealth management products held as a current asset that the filing presents WITHIN its receivables — for example inside other receivables or loans and receivables at amortised cost — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own. Read the printed row. Where they are only inside a printed receivables row, that row keeps them ('Other Receivables(CP)', 'Trade and other receivables') and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. Its peers are the other wealth management product lines, named by where the filing presents them: '(from Secur&Fincl)', '(from cash equ.)' and '(from OtherAsset)'. The non-current holding is 'Wealth management products(LTP) (from Receivables)'. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Reverse repo(CP)
items.definition: Financial assets purchased under agreements to resell (reverse repurchase agreements), held as a current asset: the CAS row 买入返售金融资产 or the HKFRS row 'Financial assets purchased under resale agreements' / 'Reverse repurchase agreements' printed in the current assets section. Read the printed row. The part due after one year, printed under non-current assets, is 'Reverse repo(LTP)'. Not this line: securities held outright ('Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)'); assets sold under repurchase agreements, which are a liability ('Repo(CP)'); deposits with banks ('Cash Equivalents'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Other Receivables(CP)
items.definition: Sum of all current receivables other than trade receivables — other receivables (其他应收款), interest and dividends receivable, the current portion of long-term receivables and of loans and advances, and funds placed with banks — net of their loss allowance, excluding amounts due from related parties, trade receivables and prepayments. Only the current portion — not the non-current portion.

cascade.note: Find 1 less Find 2. Find 1 is the other-receivables row of its note, plus the classes a filing states beside it: interest and dividends receivable (000709 prints 应收股利 230,806,800.00 beside 其他应收款 683,092,791.26, adding to the face's 913,899,591.26), the current portion of long-term receivables and of loans and advances, and funds placed. The other-receivables row is REQUIRED: without it the rung would publish a component alone — 688008's parent-company 40,000,000.00 of dividends against a face of 1,287,570,989.98 — so it falls to the face instead. Find 2 is the related-party money the note breaks out INSIDE that row (000709's parent-company 关联借款 88,000,000.00); an adjustment, so it never resolves the rung on its own. NEGATIVE is refused, per the specification's NEGATIVE_RESIDUAL.

LAST: the balance sheet's own 其他应收款 row, which already holds the interest and dividends it prints beneath it as 其中, LESS the related-party balances the note states are inside it — the same deduction CP_P1 makes, so whichever rung answers, what leaves this line is what bs_ca__due_from_related_parties_cp receives.

items.label: Wealth management products(CP) (from cash equ.)
items.definition: Wealth management products held as a current asset that the filing presents WITHIN its cash and cash equivalents — short-term bank wealth management products the filing classifies as cash equivalents — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the cash rows. Read the printed row. Where they are only inside the printed cash row (CAS 货币资金, 'Cash and cash equivalents'), that row is 'Cash in Hand and at Banks' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. Its peers are the other wealth management product lines, named by where the filing presents them: '(from Secur&Fincl)' (among financial assets), '(from OtherAsset)' (among other current assets) and '(from Receivables)' (among receivables). Not this line: time deposits ('Cash Equivalents'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Cash Equivalents
items.definition: Short-term deposits and other near-cash balances that the balance sheet prints in the current assets section as a row of their own, separate from the cash row: time deposits, fixed deposits, deposits with licensed banks or with other financial institutions, or a row captioned cash equivalents (现金等价物). Read the printed row. Where the balance sheet prints a single cash row that already takes these deposits in (CAS 货币资金, HKFRS 'Cash and cash equivalents' or 'Cash and bank balances'), that row is 'Cash in Hand and at Banks' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split the cash row yourself. Where pledged deposits are inside the row you cite, this template's rollup takes them out of this line; do not deduct them yourself. Not this line: pledged, restricted or collateral deposits ('Pledged Deposits'; non-current ones 'Pledged Deposits(LTP)'); time deposits the filing places outside cash and cash equivalents and prints as a separate current row (for example 'Time deposits with maturities over three months'), which this template leaves in 'Other Current Assets'; wealth management products presented within cash ('Wealth management products(CP) (from cash equ.)'); securities and money-market funds ('Secur & Other Fincl Assets(CP)').

items.label: Cash in Hand and at Banks
items.definition: Cash on hand and balances at banks held as a current asset: the cash row the balance sheet prints in the current assets section. On a CAS balance sheet it is 货币资金 as printed (库存现金, 银行存款 and 其他货币资金 together); on an HKFRS statement of financial position it is the row 'Cash and cash equivalents' (现金及现金等价物) or 'Cash and bank balances' (现金及银行结余, 银行结余及现金). Read the printed row. Where the filing prints pledged or restricted deposits, or time and fixed deposits, as rows of their own beside the cash row, those rows are 'Pledged Deposits' and 'Cash Equivalents', not this line; the arithmetic between the three lines is declared in this template's rollup, so do not take anything off the printed cash row yourself. Not this line: non-current pledged or restricted deposits ('Pledged Deposits(LTP)', 'Restricted Cash'); client money held in trust ('Segregated Account(CA)'); wealth management products and other short-term investments; bank overdrafts, which are a liability. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Assets.

items.label: Total Current Assets
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Total Current Assets', reported in the current assets section of the balance sheet. It is the sum of the 39 lines this template's rollup adds up under it, among them Operating Lease Receivables, Inventories, Due from JVs & Partnerships, Entrusted loan receivables- related parties(CP), Due from Related Parties(CP), Entrusted loan receivables- shareholders(CP), Due from S'holder(CP) and Short Term Securities. Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.
aliases: Due from related parties (definition in C32 of NCA)

en: Due from related parties (definition in C32 of NCA)

items.label: Total Assets
items.definition: The total of every asset the balance sheet reports, current and non-current together: the grand total printed below both asset sections — 资产总计 on a CAS balance sheet, 'Total assets' on an HKFRS statement of financial position. It belongs to neither the current nor the non-current section, and it is not 'Total assets less current liabilities' or net assets. It equals Total Non-Current Assets plus Total Current Assets. Read the printed total. Do not add it up yourself; the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup. Where the filing prints no total of its assets — an HKFRS statement of financial position often prints only 'Total assets less current liabilities' and net assets — answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Common Share Capital
items.definition: The issued and paid-up ordinary share capital of the company, printed in the equity section: CAS 股本, 实收资本 or 实收资本（或股本）; HKFRS 'Share capital' (股本), 'Issued capital' (已发行股本), 'Ordinary shares', 'Paid-up capital' or 'Paid-in capital', and the paid-in capital of an entity without shares. It is the nominal or stated capital as printed: for a Hong Kong company with no par value it includes the amount that was formerly share premium. Read the printed row. Not this line: preference share capital ('Pref Share Capital'); share premium printed separately ('Share Premium'); CAS 资本公积 ('Capital & Restricted Reserves'); treasury shares ('Treasury Shares(-)'); share capital called but unpaid shown as an asset ('Subscribed Capital-Called Not Paid'); a sole proprietor's fund or partners' capital ('Other Equity'); the equity attributable to owners of the parent (归属于母公司所有者权益合计) or total equity. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Permanent Equity.

items.label: Pref Share Capital
items.definition: Preference share capital classified as equity, printed in the equity section as a row of its own: 'Preference shares', 'Preference share capital', 优先股. Read the printed row. Not this line: preference shares classified as liabilities (borrowings); ordinary share capital ('Common Share Capital'); perpetual bonds and other equity instruments printed together under CAS 其他权益工具 ('Other Equity'); dividends on preference shares ('Cash Div Pref Shares(-)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Permanent Equity.

items.label: Share Premium
items.definition: The amount received on the issue of shares in excess of their nominal value, where the filing prints it as a reserve of its own: HKFRS 'Share premium' (股份溢价, 股份溢价账), 'Share premium account', 'Additional paid-in capital'. Where the balance sheet prints a single undifferentiated 'Reserves' (儲備) row, as a Hong Kong statement of financial position usually does, this line is the closing balance of its own column in the statement of changes in equity, not a share of that row. Read the printed amount. Not this line: CAS 资本公积 (capital reserve, which takes in 股本溢价 but is printed as one row: 'Capital & Restricted Reserves'); share capital ('Common Share Capital'); contributed surplus and capital contribution reserves ('Capital & Restricted Reserves'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Permanent Equity.

items.label: Special Items with Equity Character
items.definition: Items a filing presents between liabilities and equity that carry an equity portion — untaxed special reserves and similar special items with an equity character, shown in the equity section as a row of their own ('Special items with an equity portion', 'Special reserve with equity portion'). Read the printed row. It is seldom printed under HKFRS or CAS. Not this line: CAS 专项储备 (the safety production reserve, which is 'Other Reserves'); government grants carried as deferred income, which are a liability; perpetual and other equity instruments ('Other Equity'); subordinated debt presented in equity ('Subordinated Debt Equity'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Permanent Equity.

items.label: Capital & Restricted Reserves
items.definition: Capital reserves and reserves restricted by law or regulation, printed in the equity section: CAS 资本公积 (including 股本溢价 and 其他资本公积) and 盈余公积 (statutory and discretionary surplus reserves), and an insurer's or financial company's 一般风险准备; HKFRS 'Capital reserve' (资本储备), 'Capital contribution reserve', 'Capital redemption reserve', 'Share redemption reserve', 'Contributed surplus' (实收盈余), 'Statutory surplus reserve', 'PRC statutory reserve', 'Statutory reserve' (法定储备, 法定公积金), 'Legal reserve', 'Restricted reserve', 'Non-distributable reserve', 'General reserve' (一般储备) and the merger reserve printed as 合并储备. Where the filing prints several of these, the line is their total. Where the balance sheet prints a single undifferentiated 'Reserves' (儲備) row, as a Hong Kong statement of financial position usually does, this line is the closing balance of its own column in the statement of changes in equity, not a share of that row. Not this line: share premium printed as its own reserve ('Share Premium'); CAS 专项储备 ('Other Reserves'); revaluation, hedging, exchange and fair value reserves (their own lines); retained profits ('Retained Profits'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Permanent Equity.

items.label: Permanent Equity
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Permanent Equity', reported in the equity section of the balance sheet. It is the sum of Common Share Capital, Pref Share Capital, Share Premium, Special Items with Equity Character and Capital & Restricted Reserves. Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Revaluation Reserves
items.definition: The reserve that holds revaluation surpluses on property, plant and equipment and land: 'Property revaluation reserve', 'Asset revaluation reserve', 'Land revaluation reserve', 'Revaluation reserve property, plant and equipment', and the 'Investment property revaluation reserve' arising when owner-occupied property is transferred to investment property at fair value. Where the balance sheet prints a single undifferentiated 'Reserves' (儲備) row, as a Hong Kong statement of financial position usually does, this line is the closing balance of its own column in the statement of changes in equity, not a share of that row. Read the printed amount. Not this line: the fair value or investment revaluation reserve on financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income ('Accum Oth Eqty Rsrv Inc'); the hedging reserve ('Hedging Reserves'); the exchange reserve ('Forex Translation Equity'); fair value gains on investment properties taken to profit or loss, which are inside retained profits. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Equity & Reserves.

items.label: Hedging Reserves
items.definition: The reserve that holds the effective portion of gains and losses on cash flow hedges, and the cost-of-hedging reserve where the filing prints it with it: 'Hedging reserve', 'Cash flow hedging reserve', 'Cash flow hedge reserve' (套期储备, 对冲储备). Where the balance sheet prints a single undifferentiated 'Reserves' (儲備) row, as a Hong Kong statement of financial position usually does, this line is the closing balance of its own column in the statement of changes in equity, not a share of that row. Read the printed amount. Not this line: the year's movement on cash flow hedges in other comprehensive income ('Deferred Hedging Gain(Loss)'); derivative assets and liabilities themselves; the exchange reserve ('Forex Translation Equity'); fair value reserves on financial assets ('Accum Oth Eqty Rsrv Inc'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Equity & Reserves.

items.label: Other Reserves
items.definition: The reserves the equity section prints that no more specific equity line of this template takes: CAS 专项储备 (the safety production reserve); HKFRS 'Share option reserve', 'Share-based compensation reserve', 'Employee share-based compensation reserve', 'Special reserve', 'Other reserves' (其他储备), a proposed final dividend shown as a component of equity, and other named reserves; and, where the filing prints nothing but a single undifferentiated 'Reserves' (儲備) row and no component of it, that row. Where the statement of changes in equity gives the reserves by column, each column goes to its own line and only the columns no other line takes are this line. Read the printed amounts. The equity lines this template breaks out are their own lines, and the arithmetic that keeps them out of this line is declared in this template's rollup; do not net them off yourself. Not this line: retained profits ('Retained Profits'); net assets, equity attributable to owners or total equity; non-controlling interests; any row printed in the assets or liabilities sections; any movement of the year in retained profits. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Equity & Reserves.

items.label: Reserves (face aggregate)
items.definition: The single 'Reserves' line a Hong Kong statement of financial position prints under Equity (儲備 / 储备), between Share capital and Equity attributable to owners of the parent: the AGGREGATE of every reserve the company holds — share premium, capital and statutory reserves, revaluation, hedging, exchange, share-option and other reserves, and retained profits. Read OFF THE FACE of the balance sheet. It is not Other Reserves and it is not Retained Profits. Where the filing also states the components — normally as the closing balances of the statement of changes in equity, which the filing says comprise this line — the components are filed and this aggregate is kept only as evidence (mutually_exclusive_groups.equity_reserves). Where the filing prints nothing but the aggregate, its figure is carried to Other Reserves, the equity section's residual, which is where the template places reserves the filing does not break down.

items.label: Auditor adj on retained profits
items.definition: An adjustment to retained profits that the auditor proposed and the company did not book, entered by an analyst so that equity reflects it: 'Auditor adjustment on retained profits', 'Unadjusted audit differences'. A filing does not print it in its statements, so this line is normally empty: answer with an empty sources list. It is not the retained profits the filing prints ('Retained Profits'), not a restatement the filing has itself made of opening retained profits ('Prior Period Adjustments'), and not any movement of the year in retained profits.

items.label: Retained Profits
items.definition: The retained earnings the filing prints in the equity section of the balance sheet — 'Retained profits', 'Retained earnings', 'Accumulated profits' or 'Accumulated losses', 保留溢利, 未分配利润 — or the retained-profits closing balance of the statement of changes in equity. It is ONE reserve among several, not a subtotal of the others: revaluation, hedging and other reserves are their own lines and are added BESIDE it in Equity & Reserves and in Total Equity & Reserves, so none of them is inside this figure. Read the printed amount. A single undifferentiated 'Reserves' (儲備) line is not this line: it is the aggregate of every reserve, retained profits included.

items.label: Treasury Shares(-)
items.definition: The company's own shares it has bought back and holds, deducted from equity: CAS 库存股, printed as '减：库存股'; HKFRS 'Treasury shares', 'Shares held by the company', 'Own shares held' (持有的自身股份), 'Shares repurchased and held for cancellation'. Read the printed amount; it reduces equity. Not this line: shares held by a trust for a share award scheme, which this template files on 'Other Equity'; the cash paid in the year to buy back shares ('Purchase(Sale) Treasury Stock', cash flow); share capital reduced on cancellation ('Common Share Capital'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Equity & Reserves.

items.label: Forex Translation Equity
items.definition: The cumulative exchange differences on translating the financial statements of foreign operations into the presentation currency, held in equity: 'Exchange fluctuation reserve' (汇兑波动储备), 'Exchange reserve', 'Translation reserve', 'Foreign currency translation reserve' (外币折算储备), 'Exchange difference reserve'. Where the balance sheet prints a single undifferentiated 'Reserves' (儲備) row, as a Hong Kong statement of financial position usually does, this line is the closing balance of its own column in the statement of changes in equity, not a share of that row. Read the printed amount. On a CAS balance sheet the translation differences sit inside 其他综合收益, which is printed as one row and is 'Accum Oth Eqty Rsrv Inc'; do not split that row. Not this line: the year's translation differences in other comprehensive income ('Other Equity & Reserves Adj'); exchange gains and losses in profit or loss; hedging and revaluation reserves.
aliases: Release of exchange reserve upon deregistration of subsidiaries

en: Release of exchange reserve upon deregistration of subsidiaries

items.label: Subordinated Debt from related parties
items.definition: Subordinated loans from shareholders, directors or other related parties that the filing presents in the equity section as quasi-equity — loans from a controlling shareholder or holding company that rank after all creditors and carry no fixed repayment, printed as a row of equity ('Subordinated loans from shareholders', 'Loan from shareholder (equity)'). Read the printed row. Not this line: the same loans printed as liabilities ('LTD Subordinated', or a due-to line such as 'Due to S'holder(LTP)'); subordinated debt from third parties classified as equity ('Subordinated Debt Equity'); amounts due to related parties in the ordinary course ('Due to Related Parties(CP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Equity & Reserves.

items.label: Subordinated Debt Equity
items.definition: Subordinated debt instruments that the filing classifies as equity and prints in the equity section — subordinated loans or capital instruments with no contractual obligation to repay, ranking after all creditors ('Subordinated capital', 'Subordinated loan capital' printed in equity). Read the printed row. Not this line: such instruments borrowed from related parties, which are 'Subordinated Debt from related parties'; subordinated debt carried as a liability ('LTD Subordinated', 'CPLTD Subordinated'); perpetual securities and CAS 其他权益工具 ('Other Equity', 'Perpetual Bond'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Equity & Reserves.

items.label: Other Equity
items.definition: Equity items that are neither share capital nor a reserve: CAS 其他权益工具 as printed (perpetual bonds and preference shares classified as equity together, with their 其中 rows read inside it, not beside it); 'Merger reserve' or 'Merger deficit' printed in English; 'Shares held for share award scheme'; a sole proprietor's fund or partners' capital and contributions where printed in equity. Read the printed row. Not this line: share capital ('Common Share Capital', 'Pref Share Capital'); capital and statutory reserves ('Capital & Restricted Reserves'); subordinated debt presented in equity ('Subordinated Debt Equity', 'Subordinated Debt from related parties'); non-controlling interests ('Minority Interest Equity'); other reserves ('Other Reserves').

items.label: Policyholders Equity
items.definition: The policyholders' share of equity that an insurer presents in its equity section — the participating or with-profits policyholders' interest in surplus not yet allocated, printed as a row of equity ('Policyholders' equity', 'Unallocated surplus' printed in equity). Read the printed row. It is printed only by insurers. Not this line: insurance contract liabilities and technical reserves, which are liabilities; non-controlling interests ('Minority Interest Equity'); shareholders' equity. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Equity & Reserves.

items.label: Accum Oth Eqty Rsrv Inc
items.definition: Accumulated other comprehensive income held in equity: on a CAS balance sheet 其他综合收益 as printed (one row, whatever items of other comprehensive income it accumulates); on an HKFRS statement the reserve for fair value changes of financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income — 'Fair value reserve', 'Fair value reserve of financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income', 'Investment revaluation reserve', 'Financial assets revaluation reserve', 'AFS financial assets revaluation reserve' — or a row 'Accumulated other comprehensive income'. Where the balance sheet prints a single undifferentiated 'Reserves' (儲備) row, as a Hong Kong statement of financial position usually does, this line is the closing balance of its own column in the statement of changes in equity, not a share of that row. Not this line: the property revaluation reserve ('Revaluation Reserves'); the hedging reserve ('Hedging Reserves'); the exchange reserve printed on its own ('Forex Translation Equity'); the year's other comprehensive income ('Total Other Comprehensive Income'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Equity & Reserves.
aliases: Reserve for fair value changes of financial assets at FVTOCI

en: Reserve for fair value changes of financial assets at FVTOCI

items.label: Minority Interest Equity
items.definition: Non-controlling interests: the equity in subsidiaries not attributable to the owners of the parent, printed in the equity section of the consolidated balance sheet — CAS 少数股东权益; HKFRS 'Non-controlling interests' (非控股权益, 非控股股东权益), 'Minority interests'. Read the printed row of the balance sheet, or the closing balance of the non-controlling interests column of the statement of changes in equity. Not this line: the non-controlling interests' share of the year's profit ('Minority Interests(PL)') or of total comprehensive income; holders of perpetual securities printed beside it; amounts due to non-controlling shareholders ('Due to MI(CP)'); the equity attributable to owners of the parent. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Equity & Reserves.

items.label: Total Equity & Reserves
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Total Equity & Reserves', reported in the equity section of the balance sheet. It is the sum of Permanent Equity, Revaluation Reserves, Hedging Reserves, Other Reserves, Auditor adj on retained profits, Retained Profits, Treasury Shares(-), Forex Translation Equity, Subordinated Debt from related parties, Subordinated Debt Equity, Other Equity, Policyholders Equity, Accum Oth Eqty Rsrv Inc and Minority Interest Equity. Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: LTD Bank
items.definition: Long-term bank borrowings: loans from banks repayable after more than one year — term, syndicated and mortgage loans, secured and unsecured together — reported in the non-current liabilities section of the balance sheet. On a CAS statement this line is 长期借款 as printed, whatever kinds of loan its breakdown lists (信用借款, 保证借款, 抵押借款, 质押借款). On an HKFRS statement it is the non-current 'Bank borrowings', 'Bank loans', 'Interest-bearing bank borrowings' or 'Long-term borrowings' row. Where one non-current row prints bank and other loans together ('Interest-bearing bank and other borrowings', 'Bank and other loans'), or long-term borrowings that include debentures or notes, cite that row as printed: the other loans and the bonds in it are 'LTD Other', and this template's rollup takes the debt lines that have a figure of their own out of this line, so do not split the row or deduct them yourself. The part due within one year is 'CPLTD Bank'. Not this line: bonds, guaranteed or senior notes, debentures and other non-bank loans ('LTD Other'); convertible, subordinated or perpetual instruments ('LTD Convertible', 'LTD Subordinated', 'Perpetual Bond'); repurchase agreements ('Repo(LTP)'); lease liabilities ('Lease liabilities(LTP)'); finance lease payables ('Finance Leases(LTP)'); entrusted loans (the 'Entrusted loan payables' lines); amounts due to related parties, directors, shareholders or subsidiaries (the 'Due to' lines). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.
aliases: Due to banks and other financial institutions

en: Due to banks and other financial institutions

items.label: Entrusted loan payables- third parties(LTP)
items.definition: Non-current entrusted loans payable to lenders that are not related parties or shareholders, and entrusted loans whose lender the balance sheet does not identify ('Entrusted loans', 'Entrusted loan payables'). An entrusted loan (委托贷款) is a loan the entity receives through a bank or other financial institution acting as the lender's agent. Only where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities. The part due within one year is a current-liabilities line, not this one. Its peers by label: 'Entrusted loan payables- related parties(LTP)' and 'Entrusted loan payables- shareholders(LTP)', which take the row where its caption names related parties or shareholders as the lender. Not this line: bank loans ('LTD Bank'); other loans ('LTD Other'). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.
