items.label: Perpetual Bond
items.definition: Perpetual bonds and perpetual capital securities that the entity classifies as a FINANCIAL LIABILITY, printed as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities ('Perpetual bonds', 'Perpetual capital securities' under non-current liabilities; 永续债 under 非流动负债). Not this line: perpetual instruments classified as equity — 其他权益工具 / 永续债 printed in owners' equity, or 'Holders of perpetual securities' and perpetual capital instruments printed in equity — which are equity lines, never this one; convertible preference shares classified as a liability ('Other Non-Current Liabilities'); subordinated debt with a maturity ('LTD Subordinated'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Repo(LTP)
items.definition: Financial assets sold under agreements to repurchase (repurchase agreements) where the repurchase falls after more than one year, as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities ('Financial assets sold under repurchase agreements'; 卖出回购金融资产款 where printed as non-current). Not this line: the current portion ('Repo(CP)'); assets bought under resale agreements, which are an asset ('Reverse repo(LTP)'); bank loans secured on securities ('LTD Bank'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.
aliases: Financial assets sold under repurchase agreements

en: Financial assets sold under repurchase agreements

items.label: LTD Other
items.definition: Long-term debt other than bank loans, repayable after more than one year and reported in the non-current liabilities section of the balance sheet: bonds, guaranteed notes, senior notes, domestic bonds, debentures, sukuk, and loans from third parties, other financial institutions and government ('Guaranteed notes', 'Senior notes and domestic bonds', 'Other borrowings'; 应付债券, 优先票据, 境内债券). On a CAS statement it is 应付债券 as printed, even where its breakdown lists convertible bonds. Where a combined bank-and-other borrowings row is printed, this line is the other loans part of it, as the filing's breakdown splits it (the bank part is 'LTD Bank'). Where the face prints the same instrument under both current and non-current liabilities, this line is the non-current row; the current row is 'CPLTD Other'. Not this line: bank loans ('LTD Bank'); convertible bonds printed as their own row ('LTD Convertible'); subordinated debt ('LTD Subordinated'); perpetual instruments ('Perpetual Bond'); bills and notes payable due within one year ('Notes Payable(CP)'); lease liabilities ('Lease liabilities(LTP)'); finance lease payables ('Finance Leases(LTP)'); entrusted loans (the 'Entrusted loan payables' lines); amounts due to related parties, directors, shareholders or subsidiaries (the 'Due to' lines). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: LTD Convertible
items.definition: The liability component of convertible bonds and convertible notes issued by the entity, repayable after more than one year, where the balance sheet prints it as a row of its own among the non-current liabilities ('Convertible bonds', 'Convertible notes', 'Convertible bonds – host debts'). Not this line: the equity component of the convertible bonds (equity); a conversion option or other embedded derivative carried at fair value ('Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)'); the current portion ('CPLTD Convertible'); convertible bonds inside a CAS 应付债券 row, which is 'LTD Other' as printed; convertible preference shares classified as a liability ('Other Non-Current Liabilities'). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: LTD Subordinated
items.definition: Subordinated debt — loans and borrowings that rank behind the entity's other creditors — repayable after more than one year, where the balance sheet prints it as a row of its own among the non-current liabilities ('Subordinated loans', 'Subordinated borrowings'), including subordinated loans from shareholders, directors or related parties printed as such. Not this line: the current portion ('CPLTD Subordinated'); perpetual instruments ('Perpetual Bond'); ordinary loans from shareholders or related parties (the 'Due to' lines). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Finance Leases(LTP)
items.definition: Obligations under finance leases and hire purchase contracts repayable after more than one year, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities ('Obligations under finance leases', 'Finance lease payables', 'Hire purchase loans'), as filings presenting leases before HKFRS 16 and CAS 21 (2018) print them. Not this line: lease liabilities under HKFRS 16 or CAS 21, 租赁负债 ('Lease liabilities(LTP)'); finance lease or sale-and-leaseback payables inside a CAS 长期应付款 row, which is 'Other Non-Current Liabilities' as printed; the current portion ('Finance Leases(CP)'). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Entrusted loan payables- related parties(LTP)
items.definition: Non-current entrusted loans payable to related parties — associates, joint ventures, fellow subsidiaries and other affiliates — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities and its caption names a related party as the lender. An entrusted loan (委托贷款) is a loan the entity receives through a bank or other financial institution acting as the lender's agent. The part due within one year is a current-liabilities line, not this one. Its peers by label: 'Entrusted loan payables- shareholders(LTP)' and 'Entrusted loan payables- third parties(LTP)'; ordinary loans from related parties are 'Due to Related Parties(LTP)'. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Due to directors(LTP)
items.definition: Non-current amounts payable to the entity's directors — loans and advances from directors and directors' current accounts — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities ('Amounts due to directors', 'Loans from directors'). The part due within one year is a current-liabilities line, not this one. Its peers by label: 'Due to S'holder(LTP)', 'Due to Related Parties(LTP)', 'Due to MI(LTP)'; directors' remuneration accrued is not this line. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Due to subsidiaries(LTP)
items.definition: Non-current amounts payable to subsidiaries — loans and advances from subsidiaries and their current accounts — which appear only on the company's own statement of financial position, since consolidation eliminates them ('Amounts due to subsidiaries', 'Loans from subsidiaries'). The part due within one year is a current-liabilities line, not this one. Its peers by label: 'Due to Related Parties(LTP)', 'Due to S'holder(LTP)'. A consolidated balance sheet prints no such row: answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Due to Related Parties(LTP)
items.definition: NON-CURRENT amounts payable to related parties — holding companies, shareholders, fellow subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures and other related parties — as long-term payables and loans, without any portion due within one year (that is the current line's). It excludes entrusted loans, trade and other payables, guarantees, transaction amounts for the year and totals. The template derives it in declared steps: first the related-party balances disclosure's non-current long-term payables (the 长期应付款 group of a CAS 应付项目 table); failing that, the loans from the holding company and from a shareholder that the balance sheet prints as their own non-current rows, summed. Do not add it up yourself; this template derives the figure from those parts. Its peers by label: 'Due to S'holder(LTP)', 'Due to directors(LTP)', 'Due to subsidiaries(LTP)', 'Due to MI(LTP)', and the 'Entrusted loan payables' lines. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

cascade.note: The related-party note's non-current payables: the counterparty rows under the 长期应付款 group of a mainland (CAS) 应付项目 table, without any portion due within one year (that is the current line's). FIRST, because the note is the specific disclosure.

FALLBACK TO THE FACE: the printed loans from the holding company and from a shareholder, summed; `any_of`, so a filing printing one of them resolves and one printing neither stays empty. TWO PARTS, NOT ONE: a cascade takes the first printed row per part and slot, so one part matching both of kaming's rows handed the rung 36,800 of 581,054. LAST, so it never displaces a note reading.

items.definition: A non-current loan from a controlling or other shareholder, as the balance sheet prints it under non-current liabilities.

items.label: Loan from the holding company, on the face of the balance sheet
items.definition: A non-current loan from the parent or ultimate holding company, as the balance sheet prints it under non-current liabilities. Excludes loans from third parties.

items.definition: Non-current entrusted loans payable to the entity's shareholders or holding companies, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities ('Entrusted loans from shareholders'). An entrusted loan (委托贷款) is a loan the entity receives through a bank or other financial institution acting as the lender's agent. The part due within one year is a current-liabilities line, not this one. Its peers by label: 'Entrusted loan payables- related parties(LTP)' and 'Entrusted loan payables- third parties(LTP)'; ordinary amounts due to shareholders are 'Due to S'holder(LTP)'. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Due to MI(LTP)
items.definition: Non-current amounts payable to non-controlling (minority) shareholders of the entity's subsidiaries — loans and advances from them and their current accounts — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities ('Loans from non-controlling shareholders', 'Amounts due to non-controlling interests'). The part due within one year is a current-liabilities line, not this one. Not this line: the non-controlling interests in equity (少数股东权益, 'Non-controlling interests'), which are equity and never a liability here; a loan from a non-controlling shareholder inside a CAS 长期应付款 row ('Other Non-Current Liabilities' as printed). Its peers by label: 'Due to S'holder(LTP)', 'Due to Related Parties(LTP)'. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Due to S'holder(LTP)
items.definition: Non-current amounts payable to the entity's shareholders and holding companies — the parent, immediate, intermediate or ultimate holding company — as advances and current accounts, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities ('Amount due to the immediate holding company', 'Amount due to a shareholder'). A LOAN from the holding company or from a shareholder printed as its own non-current row ('Loan from ultimate holding company', 'Loans from controlling shareholder') is counted in 'Due to Related Parties(LTP)', which takes it by its own declared steps; it is not cited here as well. The part due within one year is a current-liabilities line, not this one. Not this line: entrusted loans from shareholders ('Entrusted loan payables- shareholders(LTP)'); subordinated loans from shareholders ('LTD Subordinated'); amounts due to fellow subsidiaries ('Due to Related Parties(LTP)'). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Lease liabilities(LTP)
items.definition: The NON-CURRENT portion of lease liabilities recognised under HKFRS 16 or CAS 21, as the balance sheet prints it among the non-current liabilities: 租赁负债 on a CAS balance sheet (the portion due within one year sits in 一年内到期的非流动负债), and 'Lease liabilities' under non-current liabilities on an HKFRS one. It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: lease liabilities under current liabilities ('Lease liabilities(CP)'); obligations under finance leases or hire purchase printed as such ('Finance Leases(LTP)'); right-of-use assets. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Other Non-Current Liabilities
items.definition: The non-current liabilities the balance sheet prints that have no more specific line in this template, as printed: on a CAS balance sheet 长期应付款 (with 专项应付款 where the face combines them) and 其他非流动负债, each cited as printed and not split into their breakdown; on an HKFRS statement of financial position 'Other non-current liabilities', 'Other long-term obligations', financial guarantee contracts, deferred or contingent consideration payable on an acquisition, and convertible preference shares classified as a liability. Where the balance sheet prints more than one such row, cite each; the line is their total. It is the residual line of the section: where a part with a line of its own is inside a row you cite, the template's rollup takes it out — do not deduct it yourself. Not this line: the total of non-current liabilities, total assets less current liabilities, net current assets or net assets; perpetual instruments, which are 'Perpetual Bond' where classified as a liability and equity where classified as equity (其他权益工具); a row that has its own line here, such as borrowings ('LTD Bank', 'LTD Other'), derivatives ('Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)'), non-current other payables and accruals ('Trade and other payables(LTP)'), asset retirement obligations ('Decomm & Envir Costs(LTP)') or deferred income ('Deferred Income(LTP)'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Customer Advances(LTP)
items.definition: Amounts received from customers in advance for goods or services the entity will deliver after more than one year, printed as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities: non-current receipts in advance, customer deposits and contract liabilities ('Advances from customers', 'Customer deposits', 'Contract liabilities' under non-current liabilities). The part due within one year is a current-liabilities line, not this one. Not this line: deferred government grants and other deferred income ('Deferred Income(LTP)'); rental or other deposits received that are not for goods or services to be delivered ('Trade and other payables(LTP)'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Deferred Income(LTP)
items.definition: Deferred income classified as non-current: on a CAS balance sheet 递延收益 under 非流动负债 as printed (mainly government grants to be released over the assets' lives), and on an HKFRS one 'Deferred income', 'Deferred revenue' or 'Deferred government grants' under non-current liabilities. It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: deferred income under current liabilities ('Deferred Income(CP)'); customer advances and contract liabilities ('Customer Advances(LTP)'); deferred tax liabilities ('Deferred Tax Liability'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Futures(NCL)
items.definition: Futures contracts with a negative fair value (currency, interest-rate, equity-index or commodity futures) held as NON-CURRENT derivative liabilities. It is one of the parts of 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)', beside Futures(NCL), Options(NCL), Forwards(NCL), Commodities(NCL) and Swaps(NCL). Only where the balance sheet prints such contracts as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities; where they are only part of a 'Derivative financial instruments' row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)' as printed: answer with an empty sources list and do not split them out of it. Not the asset side ('Futures(NCA)').

items.label: Options(NCL)
items.definition: Option contracts with a negative fair value — written call and put options, caps, floors and collars, interest-rate options, accumulators and decumulators — held as NON-CURRENT derivative liabilities. It is one of the parts of 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)', beside Futures(NCL), Options(NCL), Forwards(NCL), Commodities(NCL) and Swaps(NCL). Only where the balance sheet prints such contracts as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities; where they are only part of a 'Derivative financial instruments' row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)' as printed: answer with an empty sources list and do not split them out of it. Not the asset side ('Options(NCA)'); the conversion option of a convertible bond printed with the bond is not split out of it.

items.label: Forwards(NCL)
items.definition: Forward contracts with a negative fair value — foreign-currency and cross-currency forwards — held as NON-CURRENT derivative liabilities. It is one of the parts of 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)', beside Futures(NCL), Options(NCL), Forwards(NCL), Commodities(NCL) and Swaps(NCL). Only where the balance sheet prints such contracts as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities; where they are only part of a 'Derivative financial instruments' row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)' as printed: answer with an empty sources list and do not split them out of it. Not the asset side ('Forwards(NCA)').

items.label: Commodities(NCL)
items.definition: Commodity derivative contracts with a negative fair value — contracts on the price of metals, energy or agricultural products not already classed as futures, forwards, options or swaps — held as NON-CURRENT derivative liabilities. It is one of the parts of 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)', beside Futures(NCL), Options(NCL), Forwards(NCL), Commodities(NCL) and Swaps(NCL). Only where the balance sheet prints such contracts as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities; where they are only part of a 'Derivative financial instruments' row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)' as printed: answer with an empty sources list and do not split them out of it. Not the asset side ('Commodities(NCA)').

items.label: Swaps(NCL)
items.definition: Swap contracts with a negative fair value — interest-rate swaps, currency and cross-currency (interest rate) swaps — held as NON-CURRENT derivative liabilities. It is one of the parts of 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)', beside Futures(NCL), Options(NCL), Forwards(NCL), Commodities(NCL) and Swaps(NCL). Only where the balance sheet prints such contracts as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities; where they are only part of a 'Derivative financial instruments' row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)' as printed: answer with an empty sources list and do not split them out of it. Not the asset side ('Swaps(NCA)').

items.label: Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)
items.definition: Derivative financial liabilities and hedging instruments with a negative fair value classified as NON-CURRENT, as the balance sheet prints them among the non-current liabilities ('Derivative financial instruments', 'Derivative financial liabilities', 衍生金融工具 under non-current liabilities), with short positions in securities where printed in that row. It is the parent of Futures(NCL), Options(NCL), Forwards(NCL), Commodities(NCL) and Swaps(NCL): cite the derivative row as printed; where a part has a row of its own, the template's rollup takes it out of this line — do not deduct it yourself. Not this line: derivatives under current liabilities; derivative assets ('Deriv & Hedg Assets(LTP)'); the liability component of convertible bonds ('LTD Convertible'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Trade and other payables(LTP)
items.definition: Trade and other payables and accruals due after more than one year, as a row printed among the non-current liabilities of an HKFRS balance sheet: non-current 'Trade and other payables', 'Other payables and accruals', 'Accruals', and deposits received and retention payables printed in such a row (其他应付款项及应计费用). It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Its peer by label: 'Trade Payables(LTP)' takes a row of trade creditors printed alone. Not this line: the CAS rows 长期应付款 and 其他非流动负债 ('Other Non-Current Liabilities' as printed); trade and other payables under current liabilities ('Trade and other payables(CP)'); amounts due to related parties (the 'Due to' lines). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Trade Payables(LTP)
items.definition: Trade payables (trade creditors, accounts payable to suppliers) due after more than one year, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities. Its peer by label: 'Trade and other payables(LTP)' takes a row that prints trade and other payables or accruals together, as printed and not split. Not this line: trade payables under current liabilities ('Trade Payables(CP)'); bills payable ('Notes Payable(CP)'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Soc Sec & Other Taxes(LTP)
items.definition: Social security contributions and taxes other than income tax — value added tax, business tax, surcharges and similar levies — payable after more than one year, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities (for example contributions or taxes whose payment has been deferred under a relief arrangement). Not this line: income tax payable or provided ('Tax Provision(LTP)'); deferred tax ('Deferred Tax Liability'); retirement benefit obligations ('Retirement Benefits(LTP)'); taxes payable under current liabilities (CAS 应交税费). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Decomm & Envir Costs(LTP)
items.definition: Provisions for the cost of dismantling and removing assets and restoring sites — asset retirement obligations, decommissioning, plant shut-down, land reclamation and environmental clean-up costs — due after more than one year, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities ('Asset retirement obligations', 'Decommissioning provision', 'Provision for environmental restoration'). Not this line: the CAS row 预计负债 as printed and other general provisions ('Other Provisions(LTP)'), even where its breakdown lists 弃置费用; provisions for major overhauls ('Other Provisions(LTP)'); restructuring provisions ('Restruct Provision(LTP)'). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Share Option Costs(LTP)
items.definition: The liability for cash-settled share-based payments — share appreciation rights and other awards the entity will settle in cash — due after more than one year, where the balance sheet prints it as a row of its own among the non-current liabilities ('Share option liability', 'Cash-settled share-based payment liability'). Not this line: the share option reserve or other equity-settled awards, which are equity; a cash-settled share incentive inside the CAS row 长期应付职工薪酬 ('Retirement Benefits(LTP)' as printed). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Retirement Benefits(LTP)
items.definition: Post-employment and other long-term employee benefit obligations due after more than one year, as the balance sheet prints them among the non-current liabilities: 长期应付职工薪酬 on a CAS balance sheet as printed (net defined benefit liabilities, termination benefits and whatever else its breakdown lists), and on an HKFRS one 'Retirement benefit obligations', 'Defined benefit obligations', 'Provision for long service payments' or provident fund contributions payable under non-current liabilities. It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: salaries and benefits payable within one year (CAS 应付职工薪酬, a current liability); a defined benefit surplus recognised as an asset ('Rtrmnt Plan Actuarial Surplus'); cash-settled share-based payments printed as their own row ('Share Option Costs(LTP)'). Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Deferred Tax Liability
items.definition: Deferred tax liabilities recognised for taxable temporary differences, as the balance sheet prints them among the non-current liabilities (递延所得税负债, 'Deferred tax liabilities', 递延税项负债), after any offset against deferred tax assets that the balance sheet itself makes. It is a printed row; read it as it stands. Not this line: the deferred tax charge for the year in profit or loss; current tax payable; deferred tax assets ('Deferred Tax Assets'); deferred income ('Deferred Income(LTP)'). Do not gross it up from the breakdown of deferred tax before offset. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Restruct Provision(LTP)
items.definition: Provisions for restructuring — redundancy and termination costs, closure of operations and onerous costs of a restructuring plan — due after more than one year, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own among the non-current liabilities ('Provision for restructuring costs'). Not this line: the CAS row 预计负债 as printed and other general provisions ('Other Provisions(LTP)'); decommissioning and restoration provisions ('Decomm & Envir Costs(LTP)'); termination benefits inside 长期应付职工薪酬 ('Retirement Benefits(LTP)' as printed). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Tax Provision(LTP)
items.definition: Income tax payable or provided for that falls due after more than one year, where the balance sheet prints it as a row of its own among the non-current liabilities — a non-current provision for profits tax, provisional tax payable or provisions for uncertain tax positions ('Profits tax provision', 'Provisional tax payable', 'Tax payable' under non-current liabilities). Not this line: income tax payable under current liabilities ('Current Tax Payable'); deferred tax liabilities ('Deferred Tax Liability'); social security and taxes other than income tax ('Soc Sec & Other Taxes(LTP)'). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the balance sheet prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Other Provisions(LTP)
items.definition: Provisions classified as non-current that have no more specific line: on a CAS balance sheet 预计负债 under 非流动负债 as printed (product warranties, pending litigation, onerous contracts, guarantees and whatever else its breakdown lists), and on an HKFRS one 'Provisions', 'Provision for major overhauls' (大修拨备) or other provisions under non-current liabilities. Where the balance sheet prints more than one such row, cite each; the line is their total. Not this line: decommissioning, restoration and environmental provisions printed as their own row ('Decomm & Envir Costs(LTP)'); restructuring provisions ('Restruct Provision(LTP)'); income tax provisions ('Tax Provision(LTP)'); retirement benefit obligations ('Retirement Benefits(LTP)'); provisions under current liabilities ('Other Provisions(CP)'); impairment allowances against assets. Where the balance sheet prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Non-Current Liabilities.

items.label: Total Non-Current Liabilities
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Total Non-Current Liabilities', reported in the non-current liabilities section of the balance sheet. It is the sum of the 35 lines this template's rollup adds up under it, among them LTD Bank, Entrusted loan payables- third parties(LTP), Perpetual Bond, Repo(LTP), LTD Other, LTD Convertible, LTD Subordinated and Finance Leases(LTP). Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: CPLTD Bank
items.definition: The current portion of long-term bank loans: the part of term, syndicated, mortgage and other long-term bank loans that falls due within one year, reported in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet, in a row such as 'Current portion of long-term borrowings' or 'Current portion of long term bank loans'. Where the filing prints that portion in several rows (secured and unsecured, or by currency), this line is their total. On a CAS statement it is a row '一年内到期的长期借款' where the face prints one; the single face row '一年内到期的非流动负债' is 'CPLTD Other', and its parts are not split out to this line. Not this line: short-term bank loans ('ST Bank Loans Payable'); the current portion of bonds, guaranteed or senior notes and other non-bank debt ('CPLTD Other'), of convertible debt ('CPLTD Convertible') or of subordinated debt ('CPLTD Subordinated'); lease liabilities ('Lease liabilities(CP)'); bank overdrafts ('Overdrafts'). The part due after one year is 'LTD Bank'.

cascade.note: THE CURRENT PORTION THE SHORT-TERM BORROWINGS ROW TOOK IN, as the borrowings note splits it (PetroChina note 29: 92,828 / 109,801). Not `carved_from_face`: the face row this figure was in is now the bank part alone, so the section adds it here.

items.label: Current portion of long-term borrowings inside short-term borrowings (borrowings note)

row_caption_none: ^\s*(?:total|subtotal|合计|合計|小计|小計|总计|總計)

items.definition: The current portion of long-term borrowings as the borrowings note prints it beside the short-term borrowings it is split from ('Current portion of long-term borrowings'), where the face prints the two together as one short-term borrowings row. Read only together with the note's 'Short-term borrowings excluding current portion of long-term borrowings' row.

items.label: Entrusted loan payables- third parties(CP)
items.definition: Entrusted loans (委托借款) the company has borrowed through a bank or other financial institution acting as trustee, falling due within one year and printed in the current liabilities section: 'Entrusted loan payables', 'Entrusted loans', 'Entrustment loan'. Where the row does not say who the lender is, it is this line; a row naming related parties, associates, joint ventures or fellow subsidiaries as the lenders is this line too where it is the face's only entrusted-loans row, as this template's aliases place it. Read the printed row. Its peers are 'Entrusted loan payables- shareholders(CP)', which takes entrusted loans from shareholders, and 'Entrusted loan payables- related parties(CP)', which takes a related-party row the face prints apart from this one; the part due after one year is 'Entrusted loan payables- third parties(LTP)'. Not this line: bank loans ('ST Bank Loans Payable'); other loans from third parties ('ST Other Loans Payable'); entrusted loans the company has made, which are assets. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.
aliases: Entrusted loan payables to related parties/associates/JV/Joint Ventures/Jointly controlled entities/ fellow subsidiaries
Entrustment loan from related parties/associates/JV/Joint Ventures/Jointly controlled entities/ fellow subsidiaries

en: Entrusted loan payables to related parties/associates/JV/Joint Ventures/Jointly controlled entities/ fellow subsidiaries
Entrustment loan from related parties/associates/JV/Joint Ventures/Jointly controlled entities/ fellow subsidiaries

items.label: CPLTD Other
items.definition: The current portion of long-term debt other than bank loans: bonds, guaranteed notes, senior notes, debentures, sukuk and domestic bonds falling due within one year, as a row printed in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet ('Guaranteed notes', 'Senior notes and domestic bonds', 'Current portion of guaranteed notes'). Where the face prints the same instrument under both current and non-current liabilities, this line is the current row; the non-current row is 'LTD Other'. On a CAS statement this line is '一年内到期的非流动负债' as printed: the face states the current portion of every non-current liability in that one row. Not this line: short-term other loans and loans from third parties ('ST Other Loans Payable'); bank loans ('ST Bank Loans Payable', 'CPLTD Bank'); convertible bonds ('CPLTD Convertible'); subordinated debt ('CPLTD Subordinated'); bills payable, short-term notes and commercial paper ('Notes Payable(CP)').

zh: 一年内到期的非流动负债

items.label: CPLTD Convertible
items.definition: The liability (host debt) component of convertible bonds and convertible notes that falls due, or is classified as repayable, within one year, as a row printed in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet: 'Convertible bonds', 'Convertible notes', 'Convertible bonds – host debts' (可转换债券). Read the printed row. On a CAS statement convertible bonds sit in 应付债券, a non-current row, and the part due within one year is inside 一年内到期的非流动负债, which is 'CPLTD Other'; it is not split out to this line. Not this line: the conversion option or other embedded derivative carried at fair value, where printed as a row of its own ('Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)'); the equity component of a convertible instrument, which is equity; other bonds and guaranteed or senior notes ('CPLTD Other'); bank loans ('CPLTD Bank', 'ST Bank Loans Payable'); subordinated debt ('CPLTD Subordinated'). The part due after one year is 'LTD Convertible'.

items.label: CPLTD Subordinated
items.definition: Subordinated debt — loans, borrowings and bonds whose claim ranks after the company's other creditors — falling due within one year and printed as a row of its own in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet: 'Subordinated loans', 'Subordinated borrowings', 'Subordinated debt', including a subordinated loan from a shareholder, director or related party where the face prints it as subordinated. Read the printed row. Not this line: subordinated debt and capital instruments the filing presents within equity ('Subordinated Debt Equity', 'Subordinated Debt from related parties'); bank loans that are not subordinated ('ST Bank Loans Payable', 'CPLTD Bank'); bonds and guaranteed or senior notes ('CPLTD Other'); convertible bonds ('CPLTD Convertible'); amounts due to shareholders, directors or related parties that are not subordinated ('Due to S'holder(CP)', 'Due to directors(CP)', 'Due to Related Parties(CP)'). The part due after one year is 'LTD Subordinated'.

items.label: Trade financing
items.definition: Short-term bank financing of trade transactions, repayable within one year and printed as a current row of its own: trust receipt loans ('Trust receipt loans', 'Trust receipts'), import and export loans, packing loans, invoice financing and export invoice discounting, bill advance loans, bills discounted with recourse, and letter of credit or banker's acceptance financing drawn by the company ('Bank acceptances', 'Bankers' acceptances'). Read the printed row. Where the filing prints such financing within a bank borrowings row, it is part of that row and this line has no row of its own; do not split it out — on a CAS statement discounted bills inside 短期借款 stay with 'ST Bank Loans Payable'. Not this line: other short-term bank loans ('ST Bank Loans Payable'); bank overdrafts ('Overdrafts'); bills the company issues to its suppliers, including CAS 应付票据 bank acceptance bills ('Notes Payable(CP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: ST Bank Loans Payable
items.definition: Short-term bank borrowings: loans from banks repayable within one year, secured and unsecured together, reported in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet. Where the filing prints bank loans and other loans in one row (an HKFRS face row 'Interest-bearing bank and other borrowings' or 'Bank and other loans'), this line is the bank loans part only, as the filing's breakdown of that row splits it (its current 'Bank loans' rows); the other loans are 'ST Other Loans Payable'. Where a short-term borrowings figure takes in the current portion of long-term borrowings, this line leaves that portion out (a row such as 'Short-term borrowings excluding current portion of long-term borrowings'); the current portion is 'CPLTD Bank'. On a CAS statement this line is '短期借款' as printed, whatever kinds of loan its breakdown lists (信用借款, 保证借款, 抵押借款, 质押借款, discounted bills, accrued interest). Not this line: bank overdrafts ('Overdrafts'); trust receipt, import and export loans ('Trade financing'); bills and notes payable ('Notes Payable(CP)'); bonds and guaranteed or senior notes due within one year ('CPLTD Other').

cascade.note: THE BANK PART OF A FACE ROW THAT TAKES IN THE CURRENT PORTION, as the borrowings note splits it. PetroChina's face 'Short-term borrowings' 138,783 / 148,780 is note 29's 'Short-term borrowings excluding current portion of long-term borrowings' 45,955 / 38,979 plus 'Current portion of long-term borrowings' 92,828 / 109,801; this line is the first, CPLTD Bank the second. A printed note row, never the face less a part. `first` over two REQUIRED terms: the rung resolves only where the note prints BOTH rows, so this line and CPLTD Bank move together and the section's total does not; its figure is the first term. `outranks_printed`, because the face row states more than this line. Where no note prints the split the face row stands — the fallback, and every CAS 短期借款, which is the line as printed.

items.label: Short-term borrowings excluding the current portion of long-term borrowings (borrowings note)

row_caption_none: ^\s*(?:total|subtotal|合计|合計|小计|小計|总计|總計)

items.definition: The short-term borrowings the borrowings note prints apart from the current portion of long-term borrowings, in a row such as 'Short-term borrowings excluding current portion of long-term borrowings'. It is read where the face's short-term borrowings row takes in that current portion, and only together with the note's 'Current portion of long-term borrowings' row: the two rows are the face row's split.

items.label: IPO Loans (ST Bank Loans Pay)
items.definition: Short-term loans from BANKS drawn to finance subscriptions for shares in initial public offerings — typically a securities broker's borrowing to fund its clients' IPO subscriptions, repaid when the shares are allotted and refunds come back — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('IPO loans from banks', 'Bank loans for IPO financing'). Read the printed row. Its peer is 'IPO Loans (ST Other Loans Pay)', the same financing from lenders other than banks. Not this line: other short-term bank loans ('ST Bank Loans Payable'); the current portion of long-term bank loans ('CPLTD Bank'); IPO or margin financing the company lends to its clients, which is a receivable.

items.label: IPO Loans (ST Other Loans Pay)
items.definition: Short-term loans from financial institutions OTHER THAN BANKS drawn to finance subscriptions for shares in initial public offerings — typically a securities broker's borrowing to fund its clients' IPO subscriptions, repaid when the shares are allotted and refunds come back — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('IPO loans from financial institutions'). Read the printed row. Its peer is 'IPO Loans (ST Bank Loans Pay)', the same financing from banks. Not this line: other short-term loans from non-bank lenders ('ST Other Loans Payable'); IPO or margin financing the company lends to its clients, which is a receivable. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Repo(CP)
items.definition: Amounts the company owes under agreements to repurchase financial assets it has sold (repurchase agreements), falling due within one year: the CAS row 卖出回购金融资产款 or the HKFRS row 'Financial assets sold under repurchase agreements' / 'Repurchase agreements' printed in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet. Read the printed row. The part due after one year, printed under non-current liabilities, is 'Repo(LTP)'. Not this line: financial assets purchased under agreements to resell, which are an asset ('Reverse repo(CP)'); bank loans secured on securities ('ST Bank Loans Payable'); bills discounted with recourse ('Trade financing'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: ST Other Loans Payable
items.definition: Short-term loans from lenders other than banks (third parties, other financial institutions, government and other non-bank lenders) repayable within one year, as a row printed in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet ('Other borrowings', 'Other loans', 'Loans from third parties'; on a CAS statement '向中央银行借款' and '拆入资金'). A row that prints bank and other borrowings together ('Interest-bearing bank and other borrowings') is not this line: it is read as 'ST Bank Loans Payable'. Not this line: bank loans ('ST Bank Loans Payable', 'CPLTD Bank'); bonds and guaranteed or senior notes due within one year ('CPLTD Other'); entrusted loans ('Entrusted loan payables- third parties(CP)' and its related-party and shareholder peers); amounts due to related parties, directors or shareholders ('Due to Related Parties(CP)', 'Due to directors(CP)', 'Due to S'holder(CP)'); bills and notes payable ('Notes Payable(CP)').
aliases: Short term loan from third parties

en: Short term loan from third parties

items.label: Finance Leases(CP)
items.definition: Obligations under finance leases and hire purchase contracts falling due within one year, where the balance sheet prints them under that name in the current liabilities section: 'Obligations under finance leases', 'Finance lease payables', 'Finance lease liabilities', 'Hire purchase loans', and Murabaha (cost-plus instalment) financing. Read the printed row. Under HKFRS 16 and the current CAS lease standard a lessee prints 'Lease liabilities' (租赁负债) instead; that row is 'Lease liabilities(CP)', not this line. On a CAS statement the current portion of finance lease payables inside 一年内到期的非流动负债 is 'CPLTD Other' and is not split out to this line. Not this line: bank and other loans ('ST Bank Loans Payable', 'ST Other Loans Payable'); the part due after one year ('Finance Leases(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Overdrafts
items.definition: Bank overdrafts: amounts drawn on bank current accounts beyond the balance held, repayable on demand, printed as a row of their own in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet ('Bank overdrafts', 'Overdrafts', 銀行透支). Read the printed row. Where the filing prints overdrafts within a bank borrowings row ('Bank loans and overdrafts'), they are part of that row and this line has no row of its own; do not split them out. Overdrafts netted against cash in the cash flow statement are not this line; it reads the current liabilities section only. Not this line: short-term bank loans ('ST Bank Loans Payable'); trust receipt and import loans ('Trade financing'); the current portion of long-term bank loans ('CPLTD Bank').

items.label: Entrusted loan payables- related parties(CP)
items.definition: Entrusted loans (委托借款) the company has borrowed from RELATED PARTIES other than its shareholders — associates, joint ventures, fellow subsidiaries and other related companies — through a bank or other financial institution acting as trustee, falling due within one year, where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own apart from its other entrusted loans ('Entrusted loan payables- related parties'). Read the printed row. Where the face prints a single entrusted-loans row, whoever the lender other than a shareholder, that row is 'Entrusted loan payables- third parties(CP)', where this template's aliases place it. Its peer 'Entrusted loan payables- shareholders(CP)' takes entrusted loans from shareholders; the part due after one year is 'Entrusted loan payables- related parties(LTP)'. Not this line: other amounts due to related parties ('Due to Related Parties(CP)'), and entrusted loans the company has made, which are assets. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Due to directors(CP)
items.definition: Current amounts the company owes to its directors — loans and advances from directors, directors' current accounts and other balances due to them — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own: 'Amount due to a director', 'Amounts due to directors', 'Due to directors', 'Loan from directors', 'Advance from directors', 'Directors' current account' (應付董事款項). Read the printed row. Not this line: directors' fees and remuneration accrued within other payables and accruals; amounts the row names as due to a shareholder or holding company ('Due to S'holder(CP)'); amounts due to related companies ('Due to Related Parties(CP)'); a loan from a director printed as subordinated ('CPLTD Subordinated'); the non-current balance printed under non-current liabilities ('Due to directors(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Due to subsidiaries(CP)
items.definition: Current amounts the company owes to its own subsidiaries — loans, advances and current accounts — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own: 'Amounts due to subsidiaries' (應付附屬公司款項), 'Due to subsidiaries', 'Loan from subsidiaries', 'Advance from subsidiaries', 'Subsidiaries' current account'. It is a balance of the parent company's own (standalone) balance sheet: the consolidated balance sheet eliminates balances within the group, so its figure is normally empty. Read the printed row. Not this line: amounts due to fellow subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures and other related companies ('Due to Related Parties(CP)'); amounts due to the holding company ('Due to S'holder(CP)'); the non-current balance printed under non-current liabilities ('Due to subsidiaries(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Due to Related Parties(CP)
items.definition: Current amounts the company owes to related parties other than for goods and services bought — to the parent group, fellow subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures and other related companies — such as non-trade payables, advances, current accounts, and interest and dividends payable to them. The figure comes first from the related-party disclosure of balances: on a CAS filing the counterparty rows listed under the 其他应付款 group of its table of amounts payable to related parties (应付项目); on an HKFRS filing the balances under a 'Due to related parties' heading. Where that disclosure gives none, it is the current-liabilities row the balance sheet prints as 'Due to related parties' or 'Amounts due to related companies' (應付關聯方款項). This template derives the figure from those parts; do not assemble it yourself. Not this line: trade payables to related parties ('Trade payables- related parties'); a single row of trade AND other payables to related parties ('Trade and other payables- related parties'); borrowings and entrusted loans from related parties; contract liabilities; rows the balance sheet prints on their own as due to directors, subsidiaries, shareholders or holding companies, or non-controlling interests ('Due to directors(CP)', 'Due to subsidiaries(CP)', 'Due to S'holder(CP)', 'Due to MI(CP)'); the non-current balance ('Due to Related Parties(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

cascade.note: The related-party note's current non-trade payables. A mainland (CAS) note prints them as counterparty rows under the 其他应付款 group of its 应付项目 table; an HKFRS note under a "Due to related parties" heading. FIRST, because the note is the specific disclosure.

FALLBACK TO THE FACE, for a filing whose note gives none: the printed "Due to related parties" row through its face part. A derived parent is unmatchable by caption (`mapping._computed_parent`), so the aliases live on the part; without it the printed row was swept into the section's catch-all. LAST, so it never displaces a note reading.

items.label: Due to related parties on the face of the balance sheet
items.definition: The current amount due to related parties as the balance sheet prints it, as its own row under current liabilities. Excludes trade payables to related parties and entrusted loans.

items.label: Entrusted loan payables- shareholders(CP)
items.definition: Entrusted loans (委托借款) the company has borrowed from its SHAREHOLDERS — a controlling shareholder or the holding company — through a bank or other financial institution acting as trustee, falling due within one year and printed in the current liabilities section ('Entrusted loan payables to shareholders', 'Entrustment loan from shareholders'). Read the printed row. Its peers are 'Entrusted loan payables- related parties(CP)' and 'Entrusted loan payables- third parties(CP)', which take entrusted loans from other lenders; the part due after one year is 'Entrusted loan payables- shareholders(LTP)'. Not this line: other loans and advances from shareholders ('Due to S'holder(CP)'), and entrusted loans the company has made, which are assets. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Due to MI(CP)
items.definition: Current amounts owed to the non-controlling (minority) shareholders of the company's subsidiaries — loans, advances and current accounts from them — where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own: 'Amounts due to non-controlling interests' (應付非控股權益款項), 'Due to non-controlling shareholders of subsidiaries', 'Loan from non-controlling interests', 'Advance from minority interests'. Read the printed row. Not this line: the non-controlling interests in equity ('Minority Interest Equity'); dividends declared to non-controlling shareholders and printed as dividends payable ('Dividends Payable'); amounts due to associates, joint ventures and other related companies ('Due to Related Parties(CP)'); the non-current balance printed under non-current liabilities ('Due to MI(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Due to S'holder(CP)
items.definition: Current amounts the company owes to its shareholders — a controlling shareholder, the immediate, intermediate or ultimate holding company or parent company, or other equity holders — such as loans, advances and current accounts from them, where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own: 'Amount due to a shareholder', 'Due to shareholders', 'Amount due to the immediate holding company' (應付直接控股公司款項), 'Loan from the ultimate holding company', 'Advance from the parent company'. Read the printed row. Not this line: entrusted loans from shareholders ('Entrusted loan payables- shareholders(CP)'); a loan from a shareholder printed as subordinated ('CPLTD Subordinated'); dividends payable ('Dividends Payable'); amounts due to directors ('Due to directors(CP)'); amounts due to fellow subsidiaries and other related companies ('Due to Related Parties(CP)'); a balance printed under non-current liabilities. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Liabilities to Enterprises
items.definition: Current amounts owed to affiliated (group) enterprises and to enterprises in which the company holds a participating interest, where the balance sheet prints them under that heading — a presentation of continental European (for example German HGB) balance sheets: 'Liabilities to affiliated enterprises', 'Liabilities to enterprises with which a participating relationship exists'. Read the printed row. An HKFRS or CAS balance sheet does not print this heading: its amounts due to related companies, associates and joint ventures are 'Due to Related Parties(CP)', amounts due to subsidiaries 'Due to subsidiaries(CP)' and amounts due to the holding company 'Due to S'holder(CP)'. Not this line: trade payables to third parties ('Trade Payables(CP)'); borrowings. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Lease liabilities(CP)
items.definition: The current portion of a lessee's lease liabilities — the present value of the lease payments due within one year — printed in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet: HKFRS 'Lease liabilities' (租賃負債) among the current liabilities, 'Operating lease obligations', and 租赁负债 where a CAS face prints it among its current liabilities. Read the printed row. On a CAS balance sheet 租赁负债 is normally a non-current row and the part due within one year sits inside 一年内到期的非流动负债, which is 'CPLTD Other'; it is not split out to this line. Not this line: obligations printed under the older finance lease or hire purchase captions ('Finance Leases(CP)'); the part due after one year, printed under non-current liabilities ('Lease liabilities(LTP)'); right-of-use assets. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Segregated Account(CL)
items.definition: Money the company holds for its clients and owes back to them, shown as a current liability: a securities or futures broker's amounts payable to clients for funds it holds in segregated, trust or client accounts — CAS 代理买卖证券款 (funds received as agent for clients' securities trading), HKFRS 'Accounts payable to clients', 'Client deposits held in trust', 'Segregated account'. Read the printed row. It is the counterpart of 'Segregated Account(CA)' and is not netted against it. Not this line: trade payables to suppliers ('Trade Payables(CP)'); deposits and advances from customers for goods, services or property ('Customer Advances(CP)'); the company's own borrowings. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Suspense Account(CL)
items.definition: A current-liability suspense or clearing balance: amounts the company has received or recorded but not yet allocated to their final account, printed in the current liabilities section as a row of its own ('Suspense account', 'Suspense receipts', 'Unallocated receipts'). Read the printed row. It is rarely printed under HKFRS or current CAS. Not this line: deposits and advances received from customers ('Customer Advances(CP)'); other payables ('Trade and other payables(CP)'); the catch-all 'Other Current Liabilities'; a suspense balance on the assets side ('Suspense Account(CA)').

items.label: Other Current Liabilities
items.definition: The current liabilities the balance sheet prints that no more specific current-liability line of this template takes: on a CAS balance sheet 其他应付款 (with the 应付利息 and 应付股利 printed beneath it as its parts), 应付职工薪酬, 其他流动负债, 交易性金融负债 and 持有待售负债 as printed; on an HKFRS statement 'Other current liabilities', 'Accrued staff salaries, bonuses and welfare payable', 'Liabilities directly associated with assets classified as held for sale', financial liabilities held for trading or at fair value through profit or loss that are not derivatives, and other rows of the current liabilities section that no other line names. Read each such row as printed. The current-liability lines this template breaks out — borrowings, payables, customer advances, deferred income, derivatives, taxes, dividends and provisions among them — are their own lines, and the arithmetic that keeps them out of this line is declared in this template's rollup; do not net them off yourself. Not this line: the current liabilities total ('Total Current Liabilities'), total liabilities, total equity and liabilities, net current assets or liabilities, total assets less current liabilities, and any row printed under non-current liabilities, equity or assets.
expected_components: Liabilities directly associated with assets classified as held for sale
Accrued staff salaries, bonuses and welfare payable
Financial liabilities held for trading that are not derivatives
never_sweep: any row printed in the non-current liabilities, equity or assets sections

items.label: Customer Advances(CP)
items.definition: Consideration the company has received, or is owed, from customers before it has transferred the goods, services or property it relates to, held as a current liability: on a CAS balance sheet 合同负债 and 预收款项 as printed; on an HKFRS statement 'Contract liabilities' (合約負債, 合同負債), 'Receipts in advance', 'Advances from customers' (预收客户款项), 'Deposits from customers', 'Customer deposits', 'Trade deposits received', 'Sales deposits received' and deposits received on pre-sale of properties (已收預售款項), and 'Amounts due to customers for contract work'. Where the face prints 合同负债 and 预收款项 as two rows, this line is their total. Read the printed rows. Not this line: deposits received that the row does not say come from customers in advance of a sale, such as rental or tender deposits; deferred income and deferred government grants ('Deferred Income(CP)'); billings in excess of contract costs printed under that name ('Billings in Excess of Costs'); trade payables ('Trade Payables(CP)'). A row that prints contract liabilities together with other deposits received or deferred income is read whole; do not split it yourself. The part expected to be settled after one year is 'Customer Advances(LTP)'. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.
aliases: Due to customers for contract works

en: Due to customers for contract works

items.label: Deferred Income(CP)
items.definition: Income received or receivable that will be recognised in profit or loss in later periods, held as a current liability: government grants not yet recognised (递延收益, 递延政府补助, 'Deferred government grants') and other deferred income or deferred revenue (递延收入, 'Deferred income', 'Deferred revenue') printed in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet. Read the printed row. On a CAS balance sheet 递延收益 is normally printed under non-current liabilities, which is 'Deferred Income(LTP)'; this line takes the row only where it is printed among the current liabilities. Not this line: contract liabilities, receipts in advance and deposits from customers ('Customer Advances(CP)'); deferred tax liabilities ('Deferred Tax Liability'); accrued expenses ('Trade and other payables(CP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Billings in Excess of Costs
items.definition: Progress billings on construction and other long-term contracts that exceed the contract costs incurred plus recognised profits (less recognised losses), held as a current liability, where the balance sheet prints that excess as a row of its own under that name: 'Billings in excess of costs', 'Billings in excess of costs and estimated earnings on uncompleted contracts', 'Excess of progress billings over contract costs'. Read the printed row. Under HKFRS 15 and the current CAS revenue standard this balance is presented as a contract liability, so the line is rarely printed: 'Contract liabilities' (合同负债, 合約負債) and 'Amounts due to customers for contract work' are 'Customer Advances(CP)', where this template's aliases place them. Not this line: amounts due FROM customers for contract work, which are an asset; deposits and advances received from customers ('Customer Advances(CP)'); deferred income ('Deferred Income(CP)'); trade payables to subcontractors ('Trade Payables(CP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Futures(CL)
items.definition: Futures contracts with a negative fair value held as current liabilities — exchange-traded futures on currencies, interest rates or indices, including cross-currency futures — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('Futures contracts', 'Currency futures', 期货合约). Read the printed row. Its peers by instrument are 'Options(CL)', 'Forwards(CL)', 'Commodities(CL)' and 'Swaps(CL)'; a commodity future is 'Commodities(CL)'. Where the filing prints only one derivatives row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. The part due after one year is 'Futures(NCL)', and futures with a positive fair value are 'Futures(CA)'.

items.label: Options(CL)
items.definition: Option contracts with a negative fair value held as current liabilities — written call and put options, caps, floors and collars, interest rate options, accumulators and decumulators — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('Options', 'Call/put options', 期权). Read the printed row. Its peers by instrument are 'Futures(CL)', 'Forwards(CL)', 'Commodities(CL)' and 'Swaps(CL)'. Not this line: share options granted to employees, which are equity ('Other Reserves'), and a liability for cash-settled share-based payments ('Share Option Costs(CP)'). Where the filing prints only one derivatives row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. The part due after one year is 'Options(NCL)', and options with a positive fair value are 'Options(CA)'.

items.label: Forwards(CL)
items.definition: Forward contracts with a negative fair value held as current liabilities — foreign exchange forwards, currency and cross-currency forwards and other forward contracts — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('Forward foreign exchange contracts', 'Currency forwards', 远期外汇合约). Read the printed row. Its peers by instrument are 'Futures(CL)', 'Options(CL)', 'Commodities(CL)' and 'Swaps(CL)'; a commodity forward is 'Commodities(CL)'. Where the filing prints only one derivatives row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. The part due after one year is 'Forwards(NCL)', and forward contracts with a positive fair value are 'Forwards(CA)'.

items.label: Commodities(CL)
items.definition: Commodity derivative contracts with a negative fair value held as current liabilities — commodity futures, forwards and swaps on metals, energy, agricultural or other commodities — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('Commodity contracts', 'Commodity derivatives', 'Commodities'). This line sits with the derivative lines, not with trade payables. Read the printed row. Its peers by instrument are 'Futures(CL)', 'Options(CL)', 'Forwards(CL)' and 'Swaps(CL)'. Not this line: amounts owed for physical commodities bought ('Trade Payables(CP)'). Where the filing prints only one derivatives row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. The part due after one year is 'Commodities(NCL)', and commodity contracts with a positive fair value are 'Commodities(CA)'.

items.label: Swaps(CL)
items.definition: Swap contracts with a negative fair value held as current liabilities — interest rate swaps, foreign currency swaps and cross-currency interest rate swaps — where the balance sheet prints them as a current row of their own ('Interest rate swaps', 'Cross currency swaps', 掉期合约, 互换合约). Read the printed row. Its peers by instrument are 'Futures(CL)', 'Options(CL)', 'Forwards(CL)' and 'Commodities(CL)'; a commodity swap is 'Commodities(CL)'. Where the filing prints only one derivatives row, that row is 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)' and this line has no figure of its own; do not split it yourself. The part due after one year is 'Swaps(NCL)', and swaps with a positive fair value are 'Swaps(CA)'.

items.label: Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)
items.definition: Derivative financial instruments and hedging instruments with a negative fair value, held as CURRENT liabilities: the row the balance sheet prints in the current liabilities section — HKFRS 'Derivative financial instruments' (衍生金融工具), 'Derivative financial liabilities', 'Derivatives'; CAS 衍生金融负债 — including derivatives designated as cash flow or fair value hedges and an embedded derivative printed apart from its host contract; a short-selling position printed as a row of its own is also this line, where this template's aliases place it. Read the printed row. Where the filing prints derivatives by instrument as separate current rows, those rows are 'Futures(CL)', 'Options(CL)', 'Forwards(CL)', 'Commodities(CL)' and 'Swaps(CL)'; the arithmetic between this line and them is declared in this template's rollup, so do not split the printed row yourself. Not this line: derivative assets ('Deriv & Hedg Assets(CP)'); the same row printed under non-current liabilities ('Deriv & Hedg Liab(LTP)'); non-derivative financial liabilities held for trading or at fair value through profit or loss (交易性金融负债, 'Financial liabilities at fair value through profit or loss'), which this template files in 'Other Current Liabilities'.

items.label: Current Tax Payable
items.definition: Income tax the company owes on its profits and expects to settle within one year, printed as a row of its own in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet: HKFRS 'Tax payable' (應付稅項), 'Income tax payable', 'Income taxes payable', 'Profits tax payable', 'Current tax liabilities' (應付稅項負債), 'Current income tax liabilities', 'Corporate income tax payable'. Where one printed row combines income tax with other taxes on profits or property gains (a 'Tax payable' row holding PRC corporate income tax and land appreciation tax), this line is that row as printed. Read the printed row. On a CAS balance sheet income tax payable sits inside 应交税费 together with the other taxes; that row is 'Soc Sec & Other Taxes(CP)' as printed, and its income tax part is not split out to this line. A row captioned as a provision for taxation ('Provision for taxation', 'Profits tax provision', 'Provisional tax payable') is 'Tax Provision(CP)'. Not this line: VAT, other indirect taxes and social security contributions payable ('Soc Sec & Other Taxes(CP)'); deferred tax liabilities ('Deferred Tax Liability'); tax recoverable, which is an asset ('Current Tax Receivables'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Interest Payable
items.definition: Interest accrued on borrowings, bonds and other interest-bearing liabilities and not yet paid at the balance sheet date, printed as a row of its own in the current liabilities section: 'Interest payable', 'Interest payables', 'Accrued interest', 应付利息. Read the printed row. On a CAS balance sheet 应付利息 is printed beneath 其他应付款 as a part of it (the format's '其中：应付利息'): it is inside the 其他应付款 figure, which this template files in 'Other Current Liabilities', so this line has no row of its own; do not split it out. Interest accrued into the carrying amount of a loan (未到期应付利息 within 短期借款 or 长期借款) stays with that borrowing. Not this line: dividends payable ('Dividends Payable'); interest expense for the year; interest-bearing borrowings themselves.

items.label: Soc Sec & Other Taxes(CP)
items.definition: Taxes other than income tax, and social security contributions, owed and payable within one year. On a CAS balance sheet it is 应交税费 as printed: that one row takes in VAT, consumption tax, city construction and education surcharges, property, land use, stamp and land appreciation taxes AND the enterprise income tax payable, and this template files the row here whole — do not take the income tax out of it. On an HKFRS statement it is a row such as 'Other taxes payable', 'Value-added tax payable', 'Social security and other taxes', 'Social security contributions payable'. Read the printed row. Not this line: on an HKFRS face, income tax payable printed as a row of its own ('Current Tax Payable') or as a provision for taxation ('Tax Provision(CP)'); deferred tax liabilities ('Deferred Tax Liability'); contributions to retirement schemes printed as such ('Retirement Benefits(CP)'); 应付职工薪酬 ('Other Current Liabilities'). The part payable after one year is 'Soc Sec & Other Taxes(LTP)'.

items.label: Proposed Dividends
items.definition: A dividend the directors have proposed for the year that had not been approved or declared at the balance sheet date, where the balance sheet prints it as a current liability of its own ('Proposed dividends', 'Proposed final dividend', 'Final dividend'). Read the printed row. Under HKFRS and CAS a dividend proposed after the reporting date is not a liability, so this row is printed only under older or other presentations; a proposed final dividend shown as a component of equity is 'Other Reserves'. Not this line: dividends declared and still unpaid ('Dividends Payable'); the dividends of the year in the statement of changes in equity. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Dividends Payable
items.definition: Dividends the company has declared to its shareholders (and, where printed in the same row, to non-controlling shareholders of its subsidiaries) that remain unpaid at the balance sheet date, printed as a row of its own in the current liabilities section: 'Dividends payable', 'Dividend payables', 应付股息. Read the printed row. On a CAS balance sheet 应付股利 is printed beneath 其他应付款 as a part of it (the format's '其中：应付股利'), whether or not the caption carries 其中: it is inside the 其他应付款 figure, which this template files in 'Other Current Liabilities', so this line has no row of its own; do not split it out. Not this line: a dividend proposed after the year end and not yet approved ('Proposed Dividends'); dividends paid or declared during the year; interest payable ('Interest Payable').

items.label: Notes Payable(CP)
items.definition: Bills payable and short-term notes or commercial paper, reported in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet — on a CAS statement '应付票据' (bank and commercial acceptance bills payable). Not bonds, guaranteed notes, senior notes or the current portion of long-term notes, even where they are printed under current liabilities: those are 'CPLTD Other'.

items.label: Trade payables- related parties
items.definition: Trade payables owed to related parties — the parent group, fellow subsidiaries, associates, joint ventures and other related companies — for goods and services bought, held as a current liability, where the balance sheet prints them as a row of their own: 'Trade payables- related parties', 'Trade payables to related parties', 'Amounts due to related companies (trade)'. Read the printed row. Not this line: non-trade amounts due to related parties ('Due to Related Parties(CP)'); a single row of trade AND other payables to related parties ('Trade and other payables- related parties'); entrusted loans and borrowings from related parties; trade payables to third parties ('Trade Payables(CP)'); amounts receivable from related parties. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Trade and other payables- related parties
items.definition: Trade and other payables owed to related parties printed together as ONE current-liability row: 'Trade and other payables- related parties', 'Trade and other payables to related parties', 'Amounts due to related companies (trade and non-trade)'. Read the printed row. Where the filing separates the trade part, that part is 'Trade payables- related parties' and the other balances are 'Due to Related Parties(CP)'; this line is only the combined row. Not this line: a 'Trade and other payables' row covering third parties ('Trade and other payables(CP)'); amounts due to directors, subsidiaries, shareholders or non-controlling interests printed on their own ('Due to directors(CP)', 'Due to subsidiaries(CP)', 'Due to S'holder(CP)', 'Due to MI(CP)'); entrusted loans; any non-current balance. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

Trade and other payables to related parties
