items.label: Trade and other payables(CP)
items.definition: Current payables that the balance sheet prints in ONE row together with trade payables, and the other-payables and accruals rows this template files here: HKFRS 'Trade and other payables' (應付賬款及其他應付款項, 貿易及其他應付款項), 'Creditors, other payables and accruals', 'Trade payables, other payables and accruals' (貿易應付款、其他應付款及應計費用), 'Accounts payable and accrued liabilities', and 'Other payables and accruals' (其他應付款項及應計費用), 'Other payables' (其他應付款項) or 'Accruals' (應計費用) printed on their own. Read the printed row. Where trade payables are printed in a row of their own, that row is 'Trade Payables(CP)', and related-party balances printed apart are 'Trade and other payables- related parties'. Not this line: on a CAS balance sheet 其他应付款, which this template files in 'Other Current Liabilities'; a trade payables or trade and bills payables row alone (应付账款, 'Trade payables', 'Trade and bills payables': 'Trade Payables(CP)'); bills payable ('Notes Payable(CP)'); contract liabilities and receipts in advance ('Customer Advances(CP)'); amounts due to related parties printed on their own ('Due to Related Parties(CP)'); the non-current balance ('Trade and other payables(LTP)').

zh: 其他应付款及应计费用
其他应付款项及应计费用
应计费用及其他应付款项
贸易应付款、其他应付款及应计费用

items.label: Trade Payables(CP)
items.definition: Amounts owed to suppliers for goods and services bought in the ordinary course of business, held as a current liability: CAS 应付账款 as printed; HKFRS 'Trade payables' (貿易應付款項, 應付貿易款項), 'Accounts payable', 'Creditors', 'Trade creditors', a 'Creditors and accruals' row where this template's aliases place it, and 'Trade and bills payables' (貿易應付款項及票據, 應付賬款及票據) — where trade and bills payables are printed in one row, the whole row is this line. Read the printed row. Not this line: bills payable printed in a row of their own (应付票据, 'Notes Payable(CP)'); a row combining trade payables with other payables ('Trade and other payables(CP)'); trade payables to related parties printed apart ('Trade payables- related parties'); contract liabilities and receipts in advance ('Customer Advances(CP)'); the non-current balance ('Trade Payables(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Decomm & Envir Costs(CP)
items.definition: Provisions for the cost of decommissioning, dismantling and removing assets, shutting down plant, and for environmental clean-up and remediation, expected to be settled within one year and printed as a current row of their own: 'Provision for decommissioning costs', 'Asset retirement obligations', 'Environmental provision', 'Provision for shut-down of plant'. Read the printed row. Not this line: a provision for reinstating leased premises (复原拨备) and other provisions ('Other Provisions(CP)', where this template's aliases place them); restructuring provisions ('Restruct Provision(CP)'); the part expected to be settled after one year, normally printed under non-current liabilities ('Decomm & Envir Costs(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Share Option Costs(CP)
items.definition: A liability for share-based payments the company will settle in cash — cash-settled share options, share appreciation rights and similar awards — falling due within one year and printed as a current row of its own ('Share option liability', 'Share option cost', 'Liability for cash-settled share-based payments'). Read the printed row. Not this line: equity-settled share options, whose cost is credited to a reserve in equity ('Other Reserves'); option contracts held as derivatives ('Options(CL)', 'Deriv & Hedg Liab(CP)'); accrued salaries and bonuses. The part due after one year is 'Share Option Costs(LTP)'. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Retirement Benefits(CP)
items.definition: Obligations for retirement and other post-employment benefits — pensions, defined benefit and early-retirement obligations — and contributions owed to defined contribution schemes such as the Mandatory Provident Fund (MPF) and other provident funds, payable within one year and printed as a current row of their own: 'Provision for retirement benefits', 'Retirement benefit obligations', 'MPF contributions payable', 'Provident fund contributions payable'. Read the printed row. On a CAS balance sheet these sit inside 应付职工薪酬, which this template files in 'Other Current Liabilities'; they are not split out to this line. Not this line: accrued salaries, wages and bonuses; social security contributions printed as such ('Soc Sec & Other Taxes(CP)'); a retirement plan surplus, which is an asset ('Rtrmnt Plan Actuarial Surplus'); the non-current obligation (长期应付职工薪酬, 'Retirement Benefits(LTP)').

items.label: Restruct Provision(CP)
items.definition: Provisions for the cost of a restructuring the company has committed to — redundancy and termination payments, closure or reorganisation of business lines, and the costs of exiting them — expected to be settled within one year and printed as a current row of their own ('Provision for restructuring costs', 'Restructuring provision', 'Provision for restructure cost'). Read the printed row. Not this line: other provisions ('Other Provisions(CP)'); decommissioning, environmental and plant shut-down provisions ('Decomm & Envir Costs(CP)'); retirement benefit obligations ('Retirement Benefits(CP)'); accrued salaries and bonuses; the part expected to be settled after one year ('Restruct Provision(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Tax Provision(CP)
items.definition: Income tax that the balance sheet presents as a provision — the estimated tax on the year's profits not yet assessed or settled — printed as a current row of its own: 'Provision for taxation', 'Profits tax provision', 'Provision for Hong Kong profits tax', 'Provisional tax payable'. Read the printed row. A row captioned as tax payable or as current tax liabilities ('Tax payable', 'Income tax payable', 'Current tax liabilities') is 'Current Tax Payable', not this line. Not this line: CAS 应交税费 ('Soc Sec & Other Taxes(CP)'); deferred tax liabilities ('Deferred Tax Liability'); tax recoverable, which is an asset ('Current Tax Receivables'); a provision for tax due after one year ('Tax Provision(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Other Provisions(CP)
items.definition: Provisions — liabilities of uncertain timing or amount — expected to be settled within one year that no more specific provision line takes, printed in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet: HKFRS 'Provisions' (拨备), 'Other provisions', 'Provision for warranties', 'Provision for onerous contracts', 'Provision for litigation', 'Provision for major overhauls' (大修撥備) and 'Provision for reinstatement costs' (复原拨备) among current liabilities; CAS 预计负债 where it is printed among the current liabilities. Read the printed row. Not this line: decommissioning and environmental provisions ('Decomm & Envir Costs(CP)'); restructuring provisions ('Restruct Provision(CP)'); retirement and other employee benefit obligations ('Retirement Benefits(CP)'); provisions for taxation ('Tax Provision(CP)'); a cash-settled share option liability ('Share Option Costs(CP)'); loss allowances, which are deducted from assets. The part expected to be settled after one year, printed under non-current liabilities, is 'Other Provisions(LTP)'. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Current Liabilities.

items.label: Total Current Liabilities
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Total Current Liabilities', reported in the current liabilities section of the balance sheet. It is the sum of the 50 lines this template's rollup adds up under it, among them CPLTD Bank, Entrusted loan payables- third parties(CP), CPLTD Other, CPLTD Convertible, CPLTD Subordinated, Trade financing, ST Bank Loans Payable and IPO Loans (ST Bank Loans Pay). Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Total Liabilities
items.definition: The total of every liability the balance sheet reports, current and non-current together: the total printed after both liability sections — 负债合计 on a CAS balance sheet, 'Total liabilities' on an HKFRS statement of financial position. It belongs to neither the current nor the non-current section, and it is not Total Current Liabilities, Total Non-Current Liabilities or the total of equity and liabilities. It equals Total Non-Current Liabilities plus Total Current Liabilities. Read the printed total. Do not add it up yourself; the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup. Where the filing prints no total of its liabilities, as an HKFRS statement of financial position usually does not, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Total Equity and Liabilities
items.definition: The grand total of the balance sheet's equity-and-liabilities side: total equity, non-controlling interests included, plus total liabilities, printed at the foot of the statement — 负债和所有者权益（或股东权益）总计 on a CAS balance sheet, 'Total equity and liabilities' on an HKFRS or Ind AS one. It equals Total Assets. It belongs to no section, and it is not total liabilities or total equity alone. Read the printed total. Do not add it up yourself; the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup. Where the filing prints no such total — an HKFRS statement of financial position that ends at total equity — answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

zh: 负债和所有者权益总计
负债和所有者权益（或股东权益）总计
负债和股东权益（或所有者权益）总计

items.label: Sales(Revenues)
items.definition: Revenue from the ordinary course of business — turnover from the sale of goods and the rendering of services, before cost of sales and excluding other income, finance income and gains. This is the top line of the income statement, and a revenue note disaggregates the same figure by product, service line, geography, segment or timing of transfer. The principal-business revenue the revenue note prints, or the face's revenue line where no note gives it.

cascade.note: Principal-business revenue from the revenue note (主营业务 on a CAS filing, total revenue on an HKFRS one).
The face's revenue line, where the revenue note gives no figure.

items.label: Net Premium Earned
items.definition: An insurer's premiums earned for the year net of reinsurance: gross written premiums, adjusted for the change in the unearned premium provision, less premiums ceded to reinsurers ('Net premiums earned', 'Net premium'; 已赚保费 on a CAS statement). It is insurance revenue, which this template carries beside Sales(Revenues) rather than inside it: where the statement prints the premiums within its revenue, the template's rollup takes this line out of Sales(Revenues) — cite the premium row as printed and do not deduct it yourself. It is not gross written premiums before reinsurance, and not claims (Net Claims and Benefits). Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Changes in Inventories Incr/(Dcr)
items.definition: The change in inventories of finished goods and work in progress that a statement of profit or loss presented by nature of expense prints as a row of its own ('Changes in inventories of finished goods and work in progress', 'Increase/(decrease) in inventories'), adjusting the year's production costs to the cost of what was sold. An increase is positive and a decrease negative, as the label says. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Gross Profit. It is not the movement in inventories in the cash flow statement, not raw materials and consumables used (Material Expenses), and not an inventory write-down (Asset impairment loss). A statement presented by function of expense — every CAS income statement, and most HKFRS ones — prints no such row: answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Expenses(Own Work Capitalized)(+)
items.definition: Own work capitalised: the credit a statement of profit or loss presented by nature of expense prints for costs the entity incurred on building or developing its own assets and carried to the balance sheet ('Own work capitalised', 'Work performed by the entity and capitalised'). It is added in this template's rollup towards Gross Profit. It is not interest or borrowing costs capitalised (Interest expense - capitalised), not capitalised development costs shown only in the intangible assets movement, and not Capitalized Costs. A statement presented by function of expense prints no such row: answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Derivatives(COS)
items.definition: Gains and losses on derivatives — commodity, currency or other hedging contracts — that the statement of profit or loss charges within cost of sales and prints as a row of its own among its cost-of-sales rows. It is one of the rows this template's rollup adds into Total Cost of Sales. It is not a derivative gain or loss printed below operating profit or among other gains (Gain(loss) on derivatives, FMV adj on derivatives), and not cost of sales itself. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Cost of Sales
items.definition: The cost of the goods sold and services rendered that produced the year's revenue, as the statement of profit or loss prints it: 'Cost of sales', 'Cost of goods sold', 'Direct costs' (直接成本), 'Cost of properties sold' (已售物业成本) on an HKFRS statement; 营业成本 (减：营业成本, or 其中：营业成本 under 营业总成本) on a CAS one — the whole 营业成本 row, principal and other business together. Cite the printed row whole. Where this template carries part of it on a line of its own (amortisation or impairment of intangible assets, depreciation or commission charged to cost of sales), its rollup takes that part out: do not deduct it yourself. It is not Total Cost of Sales, and not 营业总成本 (total operating costs), which also takes in 税金及附加 and the selling, administrative, research and finance expenses. Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Net Claims and Benefits
items.definition: An insurer's claims and benefits incurred for the year net of the reinsurers' share: claims paid, the change in outstanding claims provisions and policyholder benefits, less amounts recoverable from reinsurers ('Net claims and benefits', 'Claims and claims adjustment expenses', 'Reinsurers' share of claims'; 赔付支出净额 on a CAS statement). It is one of the cost rows this template's rollup adds into Total Cost of Sales. It is not premiums (Net Premium Earned) and not the insurance contract provisions on the balance sheet. Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Goods & Services
items.definition: The cost of goods and services bought in, as a statement of profit or loss presented by nature of expense prints it on a row of its own ('Purchases of goods and services', 'Purchases, services and other', 'Goods and services'). It is one of the cost rows this template's rollup adds into Total Cost of Sales, beside Material Expenses. It is not raw materials and consumables used where the statement prints those separately (Material Expenses), not employee costs (Personnel & Benefit Expenses), and not cost of sales printed by function. A statement presented by function of expense prints no such row: answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Material Expenses
items.definition: Raw materials and consumables used in the year, as a statement of profit or loss presented by nature of expense prints it on a row of its own ('Raw materials and consumables used', 'Cost of materials', 'Material expenses'). It is one of the cost rows this template's rollup adds into Total Cost of Sales, beside Goods & Services. It is not purchases of goods and services in general (Goods & Services), not the change in inventories (Changes in Inventories Incr/(Dcr)), and not cost of sales printed by function. A statement presented by function of expense prints no such row: answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Amort & Impairment(Intgbl)(COS)
items.definition: Amortisation and impairment of intangible assets charged within cost of sales — for example the amortisation of licences, concession rights or capitalised development costs consumed in production — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own among its cost-of-sales rows. It is one of the rows this template's rollup adds into Total Cost of Sales. Its peers by label: Amort & Impairment(Intgbl) is the amortisation of intangible assets charged in operating expenses, and Impairment(Intgbl) the impairment of intangible assets charged there; where one printed row covers all of them, the template's rollup takes those parts out of this line — do not split it yourself. Not goodwill (Goodwill Amortization) and not depreciation (Deprec & Impairment(COS)). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Deprec & Impairment(COS)
items.definition: Sum of all depreciation charged to cost of sales, excluding the share charged to operating expenses, impairment, and amortisation of intangible assets printed on a row of its own.

cascade.note: The cost-of-sales note's depreciation rows.
Total depreciation less the operating-expense share. Used when the cost-of-sales note itself discloses nothing.

items.label: Total Cost of Sales
items.definition: The total cost of the goods sold and services rendered, reported in the statement of profit and loss: cost of sales together with any other cost-of-sales rows the filing prints (claims and benefits, goods and services, materials, and depreciation, amortisation or impairment charged to cost of sales). Where the filing prints a subtotal over those rows, cite it. Where it prints a single cost-of-sales row and no subtotal, such as 'Cost of sales', 'Direct costs' 直接成本 or 营业成本, that row is the total: cite it as this line's figure. It is not total operating costs (营业总成本 in a CAS income statement), which also takes in taxes and surcharges and the selling, administrative, research and finance expenses. Do not add it up yourself; the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup. Where the filing prints no cost of sales, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Gross Profit
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Gross Profit', reported in the statement of profit and loss. It is the sum of Sales(Revenues), Net Premium Earned, Changes in Inventories Incr/(Dcr), Expenses(Own Work Capitalized)(+) and Total Cost of Sales. Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Rents & Royalty Income
items.definition: Rental, sublet and royalty income that the statement of profit or loss prints as a row of its own outside revenue ('Rental income', 'Sublet income', 'Royalty income', 'Gross rental income' among the other-income rows). It is operating income that this template adds into Net Operating Profit. It is not rental income that is the entity's revenue — a property investor's or lessor's 'Revenue from operating leases' printed in its revenue rows is Sales(Revenues) — and not the gain or fair-value change on investment properties (Gain(Loss) on Invest Properties, FMV adj on investment properties). Where rental income is only part of an 'Other income and gains' row, that row is Other Operating Income and this line has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Other Operating Income
items.definition: Other income and gains from the year's operations that the statement of profit or loss prints outside revenue: on an HKFRS statement the row 'Other income', 'Other income and gains' (其他收入及收益), 'Other revenue and gains' or 'Other income and gains/(losses), net', and a reversal of an impairment loss printed on a row of its own; on a CAS income statement the row 加：其他收益 (government grants and other income related to daily activities). Cite the printed row whole. On a CAS filing this line also carries the other-business revenue (其他业务收入) the template takes from the revenue breakdown, beside the printed 其他收益 row: do not add it in yourself. Where this template carries part of the row on a line of its own (rental income, grants, interest income, gains on disposals and fair-value changes), its rollup takes that part out: do not deduct it yourself. Not this line: CAS 投资收益 (Other Fncl Asset Income(Dvds)), 公允价值变动收益 (FMV Adj on Fncl Assets), 资产处置收益 (Gain(Loss) Disp of Fixed Assets), 营业外收入 (Other Non-Operating Inc(Exp)), and revenue itself. Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Operating Profit.

items.label: Commission Income (Other Operating Inc)
items.definition: Commission income earned outside the entity's revenue — for example agency or referral commission a trading or property company receives incidentally — that the statement of profit or loss prints as a row of its own among its other income rows ('Commission income'). It is operating income that this template adds into Net Operating Profit. Its peer by label is Commission Income (Sales): commission that IS the entity's revenue, printed among its revenue rows. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Commission Income (Sales)
items.definition: Commission income that is the entity's revenue — the turnover of an agent or broker earning commission rather than selling goods — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own among its revenue rows ('Commission income'). This template adds it into Net Operating Profit beside Gross Profit. Its peer by label is Commission Income (Other Operating Inc): commission earned outside revenue and printed among the other income rows. It is not fee and commission income of a bank, and not commission expenses. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Grants & Subsidies
items.definition: Government grants and subsidies recognised in profit or loss for the year where the statement of profit or loss prints them as a row of their own ('Government grants', 'Government subsidies', 'Government grants and subsidies', 政府补助及补贴). It is operating income that this template adds into Net Operating Profit. It is not the CAS row 其他收益, which is Other Operating Income even though it consists largely of grants, not grants within 营业外收入 (Other Non-Operating Inc(Exp)), and not deferred income for grants on the balance sheet. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Selling & Marketing Expenses
items.definition: The selling and distribution expenses for the year as the statement of profit or loss prints them: 'Selling and distribution expenses' / 'costs', 'Selling and marketing expenses', 'Selling expenses', 'Distribution costs' (销售及分销开支, 销售及营销开支, 销售开支, 分销成本) on an HKFRS statement; 销售费用 on a CAS one. Cite the printed row whole. Where this template carries part of it on a line of its own (depreciation, amortisation, impairment or commission charged to it), its rollup takes that part out: do not deduct it yourself. Not this line: administrative expenses (General & Admin Expenses) and research and development expenses (Research & Development). Where the statement prints one combined 'Selling, general and administrative expenses' row, that row is General & Admin Expenses and this line has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Operating Profit.

items.label: General & Admin Expenses
items.definition: The administrative expenses for the year as the statement of profit or loss prints them: 'Administrative expenses', 'General and administrative expenses' (行政开支, 一般及行政开支) on an HKFRS statement; 管理费用 on a CAS one. Where the statement prints one combined 'Selling, general and administrative expenses' row, that whole row is this line. It is not selling and distribution expenses (Selling & Marketing Expenses), not 研发费用, which a CAS statement prints on a row of its own (Research & Development), not 财务费用 (finance costs), and not 'Other expenses' (Other Operating Expenses). Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Operating Profit.

items.label: Personnel & Benefit Expenses
items.definition: The cost of employee benefits the filing charges to profit or loss for the year: wages and salaries, bonuses and allowances, pension and other retirement scheme contributions, social security and housing fund contributions, staff welfare, and equity-settled share-based payments to employees. It is the employee benefit (staff costs) total the filing prints — 'Employee benefit expense' or 'Staff costs' in the profit-before-tax note of an HKFRS filing, 职工薪酬 or 员工成本 in a CAS one. Take that total as the note prints it: with the directors' and chief executive's remuneration where the note's total includes it, and without it where the note excludes it and states it in another note (do not add that note to it). Where the note deducts amounts capitalised (into properties under development, construction in progress or inventories) or government grants released against the cost, the line is the figure after those deductions — the cost charged to profit or loss. Where the note prints no total, cite each of its components; the line is their sum. It is not employee benefits payable, and not the remuneration of directors or key management alone.

items.label: Officers Compensation
items.definition: The remuneration of directors, the chief executive and other key management personnel charged to profit or loss — fees, salaries, allowances, bonuses, their retirement scheme contributions and share-based payments — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Directors' remuneration', 'Directors' emoluments', 'Key management compensation'). It is a cost that this template deducts in Net Operating Profit beside Personnel & Benefit Expenses, which is the staff cost of the workforce. Where the directors' remuneration is only part of a staff-costs row or a disclosure, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out.

items.label: Operating Lease & Rent Expenses
items.definition: Rental and lease expense charged to profit or loss for the year — short-term and low-value lease payments, variable lease payments, and minimum lease payments under operating leases — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Rental expense', 'Rent and rates', 'Minimum lease payments under operating leases', rental of machinery, equipment or godowns). It is not depreciation of right-of-use assets, not interest on lease liabilities (Interest on lease liabilities), and not rental income (Rents & Royalty Income). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Operating Profit.

en: Minimum lease payments under operating lease

items.label: Research & Development
items.definition: Research and development costs charged to profit or loss for the year as the statement of profit or loss prints them: 'Research and development expenses' / 'costs' (研究及开发费用, 研发开支) on an HKFRS statement; 研发费用 on a CAS one. Cite the printed row whole. Where this template carries part of it on a line of its own (depreciation, amortisation or impairment charged to it), its rollup takes that part out: do not deduct it yourself. It is not development costs capitalised as intangible assets, and not the research costs included within administrative expenses where the statement prints no row for them. Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Operating Profit.

items.label: Restructuring Costs
items.definition: Restructuring costs charged to profit or loss for the year — termination benefits, closure and reorganisation costs — where the statement of profit or loss prints them as a row of their own ('Restructuring costs'). It is a cost that this template deducts in Net Operating Profit. It is not a restructuring provision on the balance sheet, and not an impairment loss recognised in a restructuring (Asset impairment loss). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Asset impairment loss
items.definition: Impairment losses on non-financial assets for the year, net of reversals, as the statement of profit or loss prints them: 资产减值损失 on a CAS income statement (inventory write-downs, impairment of contract assets, fixed assets, construction in progress, intangible assets and goodwill), and on an HKFRS statement a row such as 'Impairment loss on other assets' or 'Write down to net realisable value of completed properties held for sale and properties under development'. It is not the credit-loss impairment of receivables and other financial assets (信用减值损失, 'Impairment losses on financial assets, net'), which is Bad Debt Expense, and not a fair-value loss. Where the statement prints an impairment of fixed assets, intangible assets or goodwill on a row of its own, that row goes to its own line (Impairment(Fixed Assets)(Oper Exp), Impairment(Intgbl), Goodwill Amortization). Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Operating Profit.

items.label: Other Operating Expenses
items.definition: The operating expenses and losses the statement of profit or loss prints that no other line of this template claims: 'Other expenses' (其他开支), 'Other operating expenses', 'Other operating expenses, net', listing expenses, other losses, and on a CAS statement 其他业务成本 where it is printed apart from 营业成本. It is the template's residual for the income-and-expenses section: each unclaimed row printed in that section is kept under its own caption and the line is their sum — never the operating subtotal less the named lines. Where this template carries part of such a row on a line of its own, its rollup takes that part out. Not this line: a subtotal or total (gross profit, operating profit, 营业利润, profit before tax, profit for the year); a row of the other comprehensive income or the attribution; finance costs; the share of results of associates and joint ventures; and 税金及附加, which is Other Non-Income Related Taxes. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Operating Profit.

items.label: Commission Expenses (Other Operating Exp)
items.definition: Commission expenses charged within operating expenses — sales agents' and brokers' commission and similar fees — where the statement of profit or loss prints them as a row of their own ('Commission expenses'). It is a cost that this template deducts in Net Operating Profit. Its peer by label is Commission Expenses (Cost of Sales), the commission charged within cost of sales; where one printed commission row covers both, the template's rollup takes that part out of this line — do not split it yourself. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Commission Expenses (Cost of Sales)
items.definition: Commission expenses charged within cost of sales — commission directly attributable to the revenue earned, such as sales commission on property sold — where the statement of profit or loss prints them as a row of their own among its cost-of-sales rows ('Commission expenses'). This template deducts it in Net Operating Profit and keeps it out of Cost of Sales through its rollup. Its peer by label is Commission Expenses (Other Operating Exp), the commission charged within operating expenses. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Bad Debt Expense (Other Receivables)
items.definition: The impairment loss (expected credit loss) on other receivables, and other receivables written off, where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Impairment loss recognised on other receivables', 'Write off of other receivables', the same for other long-term receivables). Its peers by label: Bad Debt Expense (Trade and Other Receivables) is a row covering trade and other receivables together, and Bad Debt Expense the credit-loss row for receivables and financial assets generally (信用减值损失). Not an impairment of non-financial assets (Asset impairment loss). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Operating Profit.

items.label: Bad Debt Expense (Trade and Other Receivables)
items.definition: The impairment loss (expected credit loss) on trade and other receivables taken together, and trade and other receivables written off, where the statement of profit or loss prints it as one row of its own ('Impairment loss recognised on trade and other receivables', 'Write off of trade and other receivables'). Its peers by label: Bad Debt Expense (Other Receivables) is a row for other receivables alone, and Bad Debt Expense the credit-loss row for trade receivables or for financial assets generally (信用减值损失, 'Impairment losses on financial assets, net'). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Operating Profit.

items.label: Bad Debt Expense
items.definition: Credit-loss impairment for the year, net of reversals: the expected credit losses on trade receivables, loans, finance lease receivables and other financial assets, and bad debts written off, as the statement of profit or loss prints them. On a CAS income statement it is the row 信用减值损失; on an HKFRS one a row such as 'Impairment losses on financial assets, net', 'Impairment losses on financial and contract assets, net', 'Impairment loss recognised on trade receivables' or 'Impairment loss of loan receivables'. Its peers by label: Bad Debt Expense (Other Receivables) and Bad Debt Expense (Trade and Other Receivables) are the rows a statement prints for those receivables specifically. It is not the impairment of inventories, contract assets alone or long-lived assets (资产减值损失, Asset impairment loss), and not the loss allowance on the balance sheet. Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Operating Profit.

items.label: Prov for Retirement Costs
items.definition: The cost of retirement benefits charged to profit or loss for the year — contributions to defined contribution schemes (pension scheme contributions, MPF mandatory contributions) and the cost of defined benefit plans — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Retirement benefit scheme contributions', 'Pension scheme contributions', 'Provision for retirement benefits'). It is not the retirement benefit obligation on the balance sheet, not remeasurements of a defined benefit plan in other comprehensive income, and not the directors' own retirement contributions where those are printed with their remuneration (Officers Compensation). Where the pension cost is only part of a staff-costs row, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Operating Profit.

items.label: Share Option Costs
items.definition: The equity-settled share-based payment expense for the year — the cost of share options and share awards granted to employees and directors — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Share option expenses', 'Equity-settled share-based payment expense'). It is a cost that this template deducts in Net Operating Profit. It is not the share option reserve in equity, and not the proceeds of options exercised. Where the expense is only part of a staff-costs row, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out.

items.label: Other Taxes
items.definition: An individual tax other than income tax that the statement of profit or loss charges among its operating expenses on a row of its own — stamp duty, additional business tax and similar levies. It is a cost that this template deducts in Net Operating Profit. It is not the combined taxes-and-surcharges row (税金及附加, 'Taxes and surcharges', 'Taxes other than income taxes'), which is Other Non-Income Related Taxes, and not income tax (Current Income Taxes, Total Income Tax). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Other Oper Exp(Provisions)
items.definition: Provisions charged to operating expenses for the year — for example for onerous contracts, warranties, litigation or other operating obligations, net of provisions released — where the statement of profit or loss prints them as a row of their own ('Other operating provisions'). It is a cost that this template deducts in Net Operating Profit. It is not a credit-loss allowance (Bad Debt Expense), not an impairment of assets (Asset impairment loss), not a provision for retirement costs (Prov for Retirement Costs), and not the provision balance on the balance sheet. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Impairment(Fixed Assets)(Oper Exp)
items.definition: The impairment loss for the year on property, plant and equipment (fixed assets), and on construction in progress and right-of-use assets, charged to operating expenses, where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Impairment of property, plant and equipment', 'Impairment of fixed assets'). It is a cost that this template deducts in Net Operating Profit. It is not depreciation (Deprec & Impairment(Oper Exp)), not the impairment of intangible assets (Impairment(Intgbl)) or goodwill (Goodwill Amortization), and not a CAS 资产减值损失 row covering several classes of asset, which is Asset impairment loss. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Deprec & Impairment(Oper Exp)
items.definition: Sum of all depreciation charged to operating expenses — selling and distribution, administrative, research and development and other operating expenses — excluding the share charged to cost of sales, impairment, and amortisation of intangible assets printed on a row of its own. A combined depreciation and amortisation row is taken whole.

cascade.note: The sentences that state each operating-expense function's share, summed. Any subset a filing states is still a sum, so each term is optional.
The PBT note's own operating-expense callout. Already means this line, so nothing is deducted.
Total depreciation less the cost-of-sales share. A filing that discloses no cost-of-sales depreciation is taken to charge none, so the deduction is optional and the base is not.
The depreciation rows of the selling, administrative and R&D expense notes, summed. After the sentences and the PBT note, so a filing that states its split keeps it.
The asset notes, less the cost-of-sales share.
The cash-flow add-back, less the cost-of-sales share.
The cash flow statement's own depreciation line, less the cost-of-sales share — where the add-back binds to that line rather than the part (a CAS supplement).

items.label: Impairment(Intgbl)
items.definition: The impairment loss for the year on intangible assets other than goodwill, charged to operating expenses, where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Impairment of intangible assets', 'Impairment of other intangible assets'). It is a cost that this template deducts in Net Operating Profit. Its peers by label: Amort & Impairment(Intgbl) is the amortisation of intangible assets in operating expenses, and Amort & Impairment(Intgbl)(COS) the amortisation and impairment charged within cost of sales. It is not goodwill impairment (Goodwill Amortization), not the intangible assets balance, and not a CAS 资产减值损失 row covering several classes of asset (Asset impairment loss). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Amort & Impairment(Intgbl)
items.definition: The amortisation of intangible assets (other than goodwill) charged to operating expenses for the year, where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Amortisation of intangible assets', 无形资产摊销). It is a cost that this template deducts in Net Operating Profit. Its peers by label: Amort & Impairment(Intgbl)(COS) is the amortisation charged within cost of sales, and Impairment(Intgbl) the impairment of intangible assets. It is not depreciation of property, plant and equipment, not amortisation of prepaid land lease payments shown as depreciation of right-of-use assets, and not a combined 'Depreciation and amortisation' row (Deprec & Impairment(Oper Exp)). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Goodwill Amortization
items.definition: The impairment loss on goodwill recognised for the year, or goodwill written off (amortisation of goodwill under older standards), where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Impairment loss on goodwill', 'Impairment of goodwill', 'Goodwill written off'). HKFRS and CAS do not amortise goodwill, so on a current filing this is the goodwill impairment. It is a cost that this template deducts in Net Operating Profit. It is not the impairment of other intangible assets (Impairment(Intgbl)), and not a CAS 资产减值损失 row that includes goodwill among other assets (Asset impairment loss). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Capitalized Costs
items.definition: Operating costs transferred out of the year's expenses to the balance sheet — costs the filing deducts from its operating expenses because they were capitalised into an asset — where the statement of profit or loss prints that deduction as a row of its own ('Capitalised costs', 'Less: amounts capitalised'). It is a credit that this template adds back in Net Operating Profit. It is not borrowing costs capitalised (Interest expense - capitalised), not own work capitalised in a by-nature statement (Expenses(Own Work Capitalized)(+)), and not capitalised development costs shown only in the intangible assets movement. Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Net Operating Profit
items.definition: The operating profit or loss as this template's rollup adds it: gross profit plus the other operating income, less the selling, administrative, research and other operating expenses — the result of the year's operations before finance costs, investment income, fair-value changes, the share of results of associates and joint ventures, and income tax. It is not profit before tax and not gross profit. On an HKFRS statement that prints this subtotal — 'Operating profit', 'Profit from operations' or 'Loss from operating activities' (經營溢利 / 經營虧損) — cite that printed row. On a CAS income statement it is not 营业利润 (三、营业利润), which is struck after 财务费用 (finance costs) and 投资收益 (investment income) and so is a different subtotal: do not cite that row; answer with an empty sources list and leave it to this template's rollup. Do not add the line up from its components yourself; the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup. Where the filing prints no operating profit, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Interest income from derivatives
items.definition: Interest income arising on derivative instruments — for example the net interest received on interest rate swaps — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own among its interest rows ('Interest income from derivatives'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Interest Income(Expense). It is not interest income on deposits and loans (Interest Income), not a fair-value change on a derivative (FMV adj on derivatives), and not other income from derivatives (Fncl income from derivatives). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Interest income from wealth management products
items.definition: Interest income on wealth management products (理财产品) — structured deposits and bank wealth management products carried at amortised cost — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Interest income from wealth management products'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Interest Income(Expense). Its peers by label: Fncl income from wealth management products and Gain(loss) on wealth management products are the investment income and disposal gains on such products, FMV adj on wealth management products their fair-value change. It is not bank deposit interest (Interest Income). On a CAS statement the return on such products is inside 投资收益 or 利息收入 and has no row of its own. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Interest income from Entrusted loan receivables
items.definition: Interest income on entrusted loans (委托贷款) — loans the entity made to another enterprise through a bank acting as agent — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Entrusted loan interest income'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Interest Income(Expense). It is not bank deposit interest or interest on other loans receivable (Interest Income). On a CAS statement it is inside 利息收入 or 投资收益 and has no row of its own. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Interest Income
items.definition: Interest income for the year on bank deposits, loans and other receivables, as the statement of profit or loss prints it on a row of its own: 'Interest income', 'Bank interest income', 'Finance income' where it is interest; on a CAS income statement the row 利息收入 printed under 财务费用. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Interest Income(Expense). Its peers by label are the interest income from derivatives, from wealth management products and from entrusted loan receivables, each on its own line where printed. It is not interest income that is the entity's revenue (a lender's or lessor's interest income printed in its revenue rows, Sales(Revenues)), and not interest received in the cash flow statement. Where interest income is only part of an 'Other income and gains' row, that row is Other Operating Income and this line has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out.

items.label: Interest on lease liabilities
items.definition: The interest expense on lease liabilities for the year: the finance charge on leases recognised under HKFRS 16 or CAS 21 — 'Interest on lease liabilities' (租赁负债的利息, 租赁负债利息), and on a CAS filing 租赁负债利息费用 — as the filing prints it within its finance costs. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Interest Income(Expense). It is not depreciation of right-of-use assets, not rental expense for short-term or low-value leases (Operating Lease & Rent Expenses), not the lease payments in the cash flow statement, and not interest on bank and other borrowings (Interest on debt market instruments). Where the filing prints no lease interest, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Interest on debt market instruments
items.definition: Interest expense for the year on bank loans, overdrafts and other borrowings — and finance lease and hire purchase charges — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Interest on bank borrowings', 'Interest on bank loans', 'Interest on other borrowings', 'Interest on bank overdrafts'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Interest Income(Expense). Its peers by label: Interest on capital market instruments is the interest on bonds, notes and debentures issued; Interest on lease liabilities, Interest on trade finance and Interest paid to related parties each have a line of their own where printed. Where the statement prints finance costs in one row ('Finance costs'), that row is Interest Expense(-): where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Interest on capital market instruments
items.definition: Interest expense for the year on bonds, notes and debentures the entity has issued — senior notes, guaranteed notes, corporate and domestic bonds, convertible bonds — and distributions on perpetual bonds charged as a finance cost, where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Interest on bonds', 'Interest on senior notes', 'Interest on debentures'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Interest Income(Expense). Its peer by label is Interest on debt market instruments, the interest on bank loans and other borrowings. It is not a distribution to holders of perpetual securities classed as equity, which is an attribution of profit (Minority Interests(PL)). Where the statement prints finance costs in one row, that row is Interest Expense(-): where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Interest on trade finance
items.definition: Interest and charges for the year on trade finance — import and export loans, trust receipt loans, bills payable and discounted bills, factoring — where the statement of profit or loss prints them as a row of their own ('Interest on trade finance', 'Bills interest', 'Import loan interest', 'Factoring charges'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Interest Income(Expense). It is not interest on term bank loans (Interest on debt market instruments) and not bank charges (Other Debt Service Expenses(-)). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Interest paid to related parties
items.definition: Interest expense for the year on amounts borrowed from related parties — shareholders, fellow subsidiaries, associates and other related companies — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Interest expense to related parties', 'Interest on amounts due to related parties'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Interest Income(Expense). Where the interest on related-party loans is printed only within the interest on borrowings, it stays with Interest on debt market instruments. It is not interest paid in the cash flow statement, and not a related-party transaction listed only in a disclosure. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Interest expense - capitalised
items.definition: Borrowing costs capitalised in the year: the interest on borrowings the filing added to the cost of qualifying assets — construction in progress, properties under development, investment properties under construction — instead of charging it to profit or loss. An HKFRS filing prints it in the finance costs note, deducted from the total interest to arrive at the finance costs charged ('Less: Interest capitalised', 'Amount capitalised in properties under development'); where the note prints one such row per class of asset, cite each, and the line is their total. A CAS filing states it as 利息资本化金额 (本期利息资本化金额, 资本化利息) in the 财务费用 or 在建工程 note; it is not printed on the income statement. It is not the interest expense charged to profit or loss, and not the capitalisation rate. Where the filing states no interest capitalised, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Finance cost on derivatives
items.definition: Finance costs arising on derivatives — futures, options, forwards, commodity contracts and swaps used to hedge borrowings, such as the net interest paid on interest rate or cross-currency swaps — where the statement of profit or loss prints them as a row of their own among its finance cost rows ('Finance cost on derivatives', 'Interest expenses on derivatives'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Interest Income(Expense). It is not a fair-value change on derivatives (FMV adj on derivatives), not a realised gain or loss on derivatives (Gain(loss) on derivatives), and not interest income on derivatives where the statement prints that apart (Interest income from derivatives). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Interest Expense(-)

It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Interest Income(Expense). Cite the printed row as it stands; do not deduct from it yourself the components the filing breaks it into — interest on lease liabilities, on bank borrowings, on bonds, interest capitalised — which reach lines of their own. It is not interest paid in the cash flow statement. Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Net Interest Income(Expense)
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Net Interest Income(Expense)', reported in the statement of profit and loss. It is the sum of the 15 lines this template's rollup adds up under it, among them Interest income from derivatives, Interest income from wealth management products, Interest income from Entrusted loan receivables, Interest Income, Interest on lease liabilities, Interest on debt market instruments, Interest on capital market instruments and Interest on trade finance. Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Income(Loss) from Related Party
items.definition: The share of profits and losses of associates for the year under the equity method, and dividend income from associates and other related companies (and from subsidiaries, in a parent company's own statement), as the statement of profit or loss prints it: on an HKFRS statement 'Share of profits and losses of associates', 'Share of profit of an associate', 'Share of results of associates' (应占联营公司溢利及亏损), or the row 'Associates' (联营公司) printed under a 'Share of profits and losses of:' heading; on a CAS income statement the row 其中：对联营企业和合营企业的投资收益, which covers associates and joint ventures together and is this line whole. A row printed for associates and joint ventures together ('Share of profit of associates and joint ventures') is this line whole. The CAS row is printed inside 投资收益 (Other Fncl Asset Income(Dvds)); the template shows it here without counting it twice. Its peer by label is Income(Loss) from Joint Ventures, for joint ventures printed on a row of their own. Not the share of other comprehensive income of associates, and not the investment in associates on the balance sheet. Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Other Financial Inc(Exp).

Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Fncl income from wealth management products
items.definition: Investment income earned on wealth management products (理财产品) held during the year — the return received or accrued on bank wealth management and structured products — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Income on wealth management products'). It is not a fair-value change (公允价值变动收益, FMV Adj on Fncl Assets), not interest income on deposits (Interest Income), and not dividends received in the cash flow statement. items.label: Gain(loss) on derivatives
items.definition: Realised gains and losses on derivative instruments for the year — on settlement or close-out of futures, options, forwards and swaps not designated as hedges, and the ineffective or net-exposure hedging result recognised in profit or loss (净敞口套期收益 on a CAS statement) — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own ('Gain/(loss) on derivative financial instruments'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Other Financial Inc(Exp). Its peer by label is FMV adj on derivatives, the unrealised fair-value change. It is not the cash flow hedge movement in other comprehensive income. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Gain(loss) on wealth management products
items.definition: Gains and losses realised for the year on wealth management products (理财产品) — on redemption or disposal of bank wealth management and structured products — where the statement of profit or loss prints them as a row of their own ('Income from wealth management products', 'Gain on redemption of wealth management products'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Other Financial Inc(Exp). Its peers by label: Fncl income from wealth management products, Interest income from wealth management products and FMV adj on wealth management products (the unrealised fair-value change). On a CAS statement such gains are inside 投资收益 and have no row of their own. Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

items.label: Gain(Loss) on Fncl Assets
items.definition: Gains and losses realised for the year on the disposal or derecognition of financial assets — securities, debt instruments and debt investments, other financial instruments — where the statement of profit or loss prints them as a row of their own: on an HKFRS statement 'Gain/(loss) on disposal of financial assets', 'Gains on derecognition of financial assets measured at amortised cost'; on a CAS income statement the row 其中：以摊余成本计量的金融资产终止确认收益 printed beneath 投资收益, which the template does not count twice. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Net Other Financial Inc(Exp). Its peer by label is FMV Adj on Fncl Assets, the unrealised fair-value change. It is not the disposal of subsidiaries, associates or joint ventures (Gain(Loss) Disp of Disc Ops). Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Rlzd Forex Translation G(L)

items.label: Other Non-Operating Inc(Exp)
items.definition: Non-operating income and expenses for the year, net — items outside the ordinary operating activities, such as donations made and received, penalties, compensation, ex-gratia receipts and losses on disposing of intangible assets. On a CAS income statement it is the net of 营业外收入 (non-operating income) and 营业外支出 (non-operating expenses), which this template reads as two parts and adds: do not net them yourself. On an HKFRS statement it is a row such as 'Charitable donations' or 'Ex-gratia allowance received' printed below operating profit. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Other Income(Expense); where this template carries part of the row on a line of its own, its rollup takes that part out. It is not CAS 其他收益 (Other Operating Income), 投资收益 (Other Fncl Asset Income(Dvds)) or 资产处置收益 (Gain(Loss) Disp of Fixed Assets). Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: FMV adj on investment properties
items.definition: The fair-value gain or loss for the year on investment properties held under the fair value model, as the statement of profit or loss prints it: on an HKFRS statement 'Changes in fair value of investment properties' (投资物业公平值变动, 投资物业公允值变动净额), 'Fair value gains/(losses) on investment properties, net' or 'Increase/(decrease) in fair value of investment properties', and a fair-value gain recognised on transferring a property to investment property; on a CAS statement 投资性房地产公允价值变动收益 where the face prints it on a row of its own — an undivided 公允价值变动收益 row is FMV Adj on Fncl Assets. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Other Income(Expense). It is not the gain on disposing of investment properties (Gain(Loss) on Invest Properties), and not a revaluation surplus on reclassifying an owner-occupied property to investment property, which is other comprehensive income. Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Other Non-Oper Inc(Exp)(NC)
items.definition: Non-cash non-operating gains and losses for the year — chiefly the gain or loss on dilution or deemed disposal of an interest in a subsidiary, associate or joint venture, where no consideration is received — where the statement of profit or loss prints them as a row of their own ('Gain/(loss) on dilution of interest in associates', 'Gain on deemed disposal of a subsidiary'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Other Income(Expense). It is not a gain or loss on an actual disposal (Gain(Loss) Disp of Disc Ops), and not cash non-operating items (Other Non-Operating Inc(Exp)). Where the amount is only part of a larger row the statement prints, it has no row of its own: answer with an empty sources list and do not split it out of that row.

en: Dilution of interest in associates/ Jointly controlled entities/ Subsidiaries',

items.label: Other Income(Expense)
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Other Income(Expense)', reported in the statement of profit and loss. It is the sum of Gain(Loss) Disp of Fixed Assets, Gain(Loss) on Invest Properties, Gain(Loss) Disp of Disc Ops, Exchange Gain(Loss) Sale of Bus, Other Non-Income Related Taxes, Other Non-Operating Inc(Exp), FMV adj on investment properties and Other Non-Oper Inc(Exp)(NC). Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Profit(Loss) Before Tax
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Profit(Loss) Before Tax', reported in the statement of profit and loss. It is the sum of Net Operating Profit, Net Interest Income(Expense), Net Other Financial Inc(Exp) and Other Income(Expense). Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Current Income Taxes
items.definition: The current income tax charged for the year — PRC enterprise income tax, Hong Kong profits tax and overseas taxes on the year's taxable profit, and land appreciation tax where the filing includes it in income tax — where the statement of profit or loss prints the current tax as a row of its own beside deferred tax ('Current tax', 'Current income tax', 当期所得税). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Income Tax, beside Deferred Income Taxes(NC) and Prior Year Tax Adj(-). Where the statement prints a single undivided income tax row ('Taxation', 'Income tax expense', 所得税费用, 税项开支), that row is the total charge and is Total Income Tax's printed figure: answer this line with an empty sources list rather than citing it here. It is not income tax paid in the cash flow statement and not taxes other than income tax (Other Non-Income Related Taxes).

items.label: Deferred Income Taxes(NC)
items.definition: The deferred income tax charge or credit for the year — the movement in deferred tax assets and liabilities recognised in profit or loss, a non-cash item — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own beside current tax ('Deferred tax', 'Deferred income tax', 递延所得税). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Income Tax. It is not deferred tax recognised in other comprehensive income ('Income tax effect' in that section), not the deferred tax balances on the balance sheet, and not the change in deferred taxes in the cash flow statement. Where the statement prints a single undivided income tax row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Prior Year Tax Adj(-)
items.definition: The adjustment for the year to income tax of prior years — under- or over-provision in prior years — where the statement of profit or loss prints it as a row of its own beside the current tax ('Under/(over) provision in prior years', 'Adjustments in respect of current tax of previous periods', 以前年度所得税调整). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Income Tax. It is not a prior period adjustment to retained profits from a restatement (Prior Period Adjustments). Where the statement prints a single undivided income tax row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Total Income Tax
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Total Income Tax', reported in the statement of profit and loss. It is the sum of Current Income Taxes, Deferred Income Taxes(NC) and Prior Year Tax Adj(-). Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Profit(Loss) Bef Extraord Items
items.definition: The profit or loss for the year after income tax for the whole group, including the share that belongs to non-controlling interests, before any extraordinary items. CAS and HKFRS recognise no extraordinary items, so this is the net profit the statement of profit and loss prints for the whole group: the row 净利润 (五、净利润) in a CAS income statement, and the row 'Profit for the year' or 'Loss for the year' printed above the split between owners of the parent and non-controlling interests in an HKFRS one. It equals Profit(Loss) Before Tax plus Total Income Tax. Cite that printed row, even where it is already named for another line: it is this line's figure. Do not add it up from its components yourself; the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup. Answer with an empty sources list only where the statement prints no profit or loss for the year.

items.label: Extraordinary Income(Exp)
items.definition: Extraordinary income or expense: items the filing itself presents as extraordinary, below profit after tax. HKFRS and CAS do not permit extraordinary items, so a statement prepared under either prints none, and this line is normally empty: answer with an empty sources list. It is not an exceptional or one-off item printed within profit before tax, not 营业外收入 or 营业外支出 (Other Non-Operating Inc(Exp)), and not the share of profit attributable to non-controlling interests (Minority Interests(PL)). Its peer by label is Extraordinary Income(Exp)(NC), the non-cash extraordinary item. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Profit for the year.

items.label: Extraordinary Income(Exp)(NC)
items.definition: Non-cash extraordinary income or expense: a non-cash item the filing itself presents as extraordinary, below profit after tax. HKFRS and CAS do not permit extraordinary items, so a statement prepared under either prints none, and this line is normally empty: answer with an empty sources list. It is not an exceptional item within profit before tax and not a non-cash non-operating gain such as a dilution gain (Other Non-Oper Inc(Exp)(NC)). Its peer by label is Extraordinary Income(Exp). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Profit for the year.

items.label: Minority Interests(PL)
items.definition: The share of the profit or loss for the year attributable to non-controlling interests, as printed in the attribution beneath the profit for the year: on a CAS income statement the row 2.少数股东损益 under 净利润's split; on an HKFRS statement the row 'Non-controlling interests' (非控股权益) under 'Profit/(loss) attributable to:', together with the share attributable to holders of perpetual (capital) securities where the attribution prints one. Cite the row as printed: the template's sign rule negates these captions, so a non-controlling share of profit is carried negative and a share of loss positive, and Profit for the year is the group profit less this share. It is not the non-controlling share of total comprehensive income (归属于少数股东的综合收益总额, or the 'Non-controlling interests' row under 'Total comprehensive income attributable to:'), and not the non-controlling interests in equity on the balance sheet. Where the statement prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Profit for the year
items.definition: The profit or loss for the year attributable to owners of the parent: the whole group's profit for the year after income tax, less the share that belongs to non-controlling interests (CAS and HKFRS recognise no extraordinary items). It is the owners' share printed under the profit for the year in the statement of profit and loss: 归属于母公司股东的净利润 (or 归属于母公司所有者的净利润) in a CAS income statement, and 'Attributable to: Owners of the Company' or 'Owners of the parent' in an HKFRS one. It is not the group total printed as 净利润 or 'Profit for the year' above that split, which is the line Profit(Loss) Bef Extraord Items. Where the filing prints no split because it has no non-controlling interests, the group total is the owners' share and is this line's figure. Do not compute it here; the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup. Where the filing prints neither, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Unreal Gain(Loss) Fixed Assets
items.definition: The revaluation surplus or deficit on property, plant and equipment recognised in other comprehensive income for the year — land and buildings and other fixed assets carried under the revaluation model: 'Surplus on revaluation of property, plant and equipment', 'Gain on revaluation of land and buildings', 'Revaluation of fixed assets' (重估物业、厂房及设备的收益). It is the year's movement, printed in the other comprehensive income section of the statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (or in the statement of changes in equity), net of tax where the filing prints it net. Read the printed row. Not this line: the revaluation gain recognised when a property is transferred to investment properties at fair value ('Unreal Gain(Loss) Invest Prpty'); fair value changes of investment properties in profit or loss ('FMV adj on investment properties'); impairment of fixed assets; the revaluation reserve balance ('Revaluation Reserves'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Other Comprehensive Income.

en: Revaluation of Property, plant and equipment

items.label: Unreal Gain(Loss) Invest Prpty
items.definition: The revaluation gain or loss relating to investment properties that is recognised in other comprehensive income for the year — the surplus that arises when owner-occupied property or inventory is transferred to investment properties carried at fair value ('Surplus on revaluation of properties upon reclassification to investment properties', 'Gain on revaluation of property transferred to investment properties'; CAS 自用房地产或存货转换为以公允价值模式计量的投资性房地产). It is the year's movement, printed in the other comprehensive income section of the statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (or in the statement of changes in equity), net of tax where the filing prints it net. Read the printed row. Not this line: the fair value changes of investment properties that go through profit or loss ('Changes in fair value of investment properties', which are 'FMV adj on investment properties'); gains on disposal of investment properties; revaluation of property held for own use ('Unreal Gain(Loss) Fixed Assets'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Other Comprehensive Income.

items.label: Unreal Gain(Loss) Investments
items.definition: Fair value gains and losses for the year on financial assets measured at fair value through other comprehensive income (and, under the older standard, on available-for-sale financial assets), recognised in other comprehensive income: 'Changes in fair values of financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income', 'Financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income – net movement in fair value reserve', 'Fair value changes in equity investments measured at fair value through other comprehensive income', 'Unrealised gain/loss on financial assets'; CAS 其他权益工具投资公允价值变动 and 其他债权投资公允价值变动. Where the filing prints the change and the amount reclassified on disposal or the tax on it as separate rows under one heading, the line is their net. It is the year's movement, printed in the other comprehensive income section of the statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (or in the statement of changes in equity), net of tax where the filing prints it net. Not this line: fair value changes through profit or loss; the share of associates' and joint ventures' other comprehensive income ('Other Equity & Reserves Adj'); derivatives and hedges ('Deferred Hedging Gain(Loss)', 'Derivatives FMV Adjustment'); the fair value reserve balance ('Accum Oth Eqty Rsrv Inc'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Other Comprehensive Income.
