items.label: Deferred Hedging Gain(Loss)
items.definition: The year's net movement on cash flow hedges recognised in other comprehensive income — the effective portion of fair value changes of hedging instruments, less the amount reclassified to profit or loss, and the tax on them: 'Cash flow hedges', 'Cash flow hedges – net movement in hedging reserve', 'Effective portion of changes in fair value of hedging instruments', 'Net gain/(loss) on cash flow hedges'; CAS 现金流量套期储备 (现金流量套期损益的有效部分). Where the filing prints the effective portion, the reclassification and the tax as rows under a cash flow hedges heading, the line is their net, or the subtotal the filing prints over them. It is the year's movement, printed in the other comprehensive income section of the statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (or in the statement of changes in equity), net of tax where the filing prints it net. Not this line: fair value changes on derivatives not designated as cash flow hedges ('Derivatives FMV Adjustment', or profit or loss); the hedging reserve balance ('Hedging Reserves'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Other Comprehensive Income.

items.label: Derivatives FMV Adjustment
items.definition: Fair value changes for the year on derivative instruments that the filing recognises in other comprehensive income OTHER than as a cash flow hedge — for example the cost-of-hedging movement (time value of options, forward elements, foreign currency basis spreads) or a hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation, where the filing prints it as a row of its own ('Cost of hedging', 'Net investment hedge', 'Reserve for derivatives'). It is the year's movement, printed in the other comprehensive income section of the statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (or in the statement of changes in equity), net of tax where the filing prints it net. Read the printed row. Not this line: the cash flow hedge movement ('Deferred Hedging Gain(Loss)'); fair value changes of derivatives in profit or loss ('FMV adj on derivatives'); derivative assets and liabilities themselves. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Other Comprehensive Income.

items.label: Minimum Pension Liability Adj
items.definition: Remeasurement gains and losses on defined benefit pension and retirement plans recognised in other comprehensive income for the year — actuarial gains and losses and the return on plan assets excluding interest: 'Remeasurement of defined benefit plans', 'Remeasurement gains/(losses) on defined benefit plans', 'Actuarial gains/(losses) on defined benefit obligations', 'Pension liability adjustment'; CAS 重新计量设定受益计划变动额 (重新计量设定受益计划). Where the filing prints the tax on it as a separate row beside it, the line is the net. It is the year's movement, printed in the other comprehensive income section of the statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (or in the statement of changes in equity), net of tax where the filing prints it net. Not this line: pension costs charged to profit or loss ('Prov for Retirement Costs'); the retirement benefit liability itself ('Retirement Benefits(LTP)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Total Other Comprehensive Income.

zh: 重新计量设定受益计划

items.label: Other Equity & Reserves Adj
items.definition: The other comprehensive income for the year that the other lines of this section do not take: exchange differences on translation of foreign operations (CAS 外币财务报表折算差额) and exchange reserve released on disposal or deregistration of subsidiaries or associates, the share of other comprehensive income of associates and joint ventures (权益法下可转损益的其他综合收益), income tax relating to components of other comprehensive income printed on its own, and any other item of other comprehensive income. This template's rollup arrives at it from the printed total other comprehensive income less Unreal Gain(Loss) Fixed Assets, Unreal Gain(Loss) Invest Prpty, Unreal Gain(Loss) Investments, Deferred Hedging Gain(Loss), Derivatives FMV Adjustment and Minimum Pension Liability Adj; do not compute it yourself. Not this line: the profit for the year; total comprehensive income; the total other comprehensive income itself ('Total Other Comprehensive Income'); the owners' and non-controlling interests' shares of comprehensive income; any row of the profit or loss section.

items.label: Total Other Comprehensive Income
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Total Other Comprehensive Income', reported in the statement of other comprehensive income. It is the sum of Unreal Gain(Loss) Fixed Assets, Unreal Gain(Loss) Invest Prpty, Unreal Gain(Loss) Investments, Deferred Hedging Gain(Loss), Derivatives FMV Adjustment, Minimum Pension Liability Adj and Other Equity & Reserves Adj. Read the printed subtotal. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Where the filing prints no subtotal on this line, answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup.

items.label: Cash Div Pref Shares(-)
items.definition: Dividends on preference shares charged to retained profits in the year: 'Dividends on preference shares', 'Preference dividends' (优先股股利, 優先股股息); on a CAS statement 对其他权益工具持有者的分配 (distribution to holders of other equity instruments) and 分配优先股股利 as printed. It is a movement of the year in retained profits, read from the retained profits column of the statement of changes in equity (on a CAS statement the 未分配利润 column under 利润分配). Read the printed row; it reduces retained profits. Not this line: dividends to ordinary shareholders ('Cash Div Common Shares(-)'); interest on preference shares classified as liabilities, which is a finance cost; distributions to holders of perpetual capital securities on an HKFRS statement ('Other Adj to Retained Profits').

其他权益工具持有人分配

items.label: Proposed Cash Dividends
items.definition: The cash dividend the directors propose or declare after the end of the reporting period in respect of the year, which is not recognised as a liability or as a movement in retained profits of the year: 'Proposed final dividend', 'Proposed dividends', 'Dividends declared after the reporting period' (拟派股息, 拟派末期股息, 建议派付股息; CAS 拟分配的现金股利). Where the statements print it — as a row of the statement of profit or loss, or as a proposed dividend shown in the statement of changes in equity — read that amount; where they do not, answer with an empty sources list. Not this line: dividends recognised in the year ('Cash Div Common Shares(-)'); a dividend declared and unpaid at the year end ('Dividends Payable'); a proposed dividend carried as a liability ('Proposed Dividends').

items.label: Cash Div Common Shares(-)
items.definition: Dividends to ordinary shareholders charged to retained profits in the year: final and interim dividends declared and recognised, and special dividends — HKFRS rows such as 'Final 2023 dividend declared', 'Interim dividend', 'Special dividend', 'Dividends paid' (已派股息, 末期股息, 中期股息); CAS 对所有者（或股东）的分配. It is a movement of the year in retained profits, read from the retained profits column of the statement of changes in equity (on a CAS statement the 未分配利润 column under 利润分配). Read the printed row; it reduces retained profits. Not this line: the cash paid for dividends ('Dividends Paid(Fin)'); a final dividend proposed after the year end and not recognised in it ('Proposed Cash Dividends'); dividends on preference shares ('Cash Div Pref Shares(-)'); scrip and share dividends ('Stock Dividends(NC)(-)'); dividends paid by subsidiaries to non-controlling shareholders; distributions to holders of perpetual securities.

items.label: Stock Dividends(NC)(-)
items.definition: Dividends settled in shares rather than cash, and capitalisation of retained profits into share capital: scrip dividends, bonus shares and stock dividends — 'Scrip dividend', 'Issue of shares for scrip dividend', 'Bonus issue' (以股代息, 股份股息); CAS 送股, 股票股利, 以未分配利润转增股本 and 盈余公积转增资本（或股本） as printed. It is a movement of the year in retained profits, read from the retained profits column of the statement of changes in equity (on a CAS statement the 未分配利润 column under 利润分配). Read the printed row; it reduces retained profits. Not this line: cash dividends ('Cash Div Common Shares(-)'); shares issued for cash or on the exercise of options; transfers to statutory reserves ('Transfer to Reserves(-)').

items.label: Transfer to Reserves(-)
items.definition: Appropriations from retained profits to other reserves in the year, and transfers back from those reserves to retained profits: 'Transfer to statutory surplus reserve', 'Transfer to statutory reserve', 'Transfer of reserves', 'Transfer from reserves', 'Transfer statutory surplus reserve to retained profits' (转拨至法定盈余储备, 储备转拨); CAS 提取盈余公积, 提取法定盈余公积, 提取任意盈余公积, 提取一般风险准备. It is a movement of the year in retained profits, read from the retained profits column of the statement of changes in equity (on a CAS statement the 未分配利润 column under 利润分配). Read the printed row: a transfer to reserves reduces retained profits and a transfer from reserves adds to them. Not this line: dividends; capitalisation into share capital ('Stock Dividends(NC)(-)'); the reserve balances themselves ('Capital & Restricted Reserves').

items.label: Prior Period Adjustments
items.definition: Adjustments to the opening retained profits for the correction of prior-period errors and for changes in accounting policy applied retrospectively: 'Prior year adjustments', 'Effect of change in accounting policy', 'Effect of adoption of' a new or amended standard, 'Opening adjustments', 'Restatement' (前期调整, 追溯调整); CAS 会计政策变更, 前期差错更正, 以前年度损益调整. It is a movement of the year in retained profits, read from the retained profits column of the statement of changes in equity (on a CAS statement the 未分配利润 column under 利润分配). Read the printed row. Not this line: the profit for the year; the restated prior-year figures elsewhere in the statements; an adjustment an auditor proposed and the company did not book ('Auditor adj on retained profits').

items.label: Other Adj to Retained Profits
items.definition: The movements of the year in retained profits that no other line of this section takes: distributions to holders of perpetual capital securities, transactions with non-controlling interests charged to retained profits (acquisition of non-controlling interests, deemed disposal or dilution of an interest in a subsidiary), release of share option or fair value reserves to retained profits, shares vested under a share award scheme, and other movements the retained profits column prints. Read each such row as printed. The profit for the year, dividends ('Cash Div Pref Shares(-)', 'Cash Div Common Shares(-)'), 'Stock Dividends(NC)(-)', 'Transfer to Reserves(-)' and 'Prior Period Adjustments' are their own lines, and the arithmetic that keeps them out of this line is declared in this template's rollup; do not net them off yourself. Not this line: the opening or closing retained profits ('Retained Profits'), any row printed on the face of the income statement, and movements in the other equity columns.

items.label: Net Profit/(Loss)
items.definition: The profit or loss the indirect-method operating section starts from: the first row of the operating activities section of the cash flow statement, before any adjustment. On an HKFRS statement this is usually the profit or loss before tax ('Profit before tax', 'Loss before taxation', 'Profit/(loss) before tax', 除稅前溢利 / 除稅前虧損); some statements start from the profit for the year after tax ('Profit for the year', 年內溢利), and either is this line as printed. On a CAS filing it is the first row of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量): 净利润, the net profit including the non-controlling interests' share. Take the figure for the whole group as the statement prints it, not the profit attributable to owners of the parent. Not this line: the income tax added back below a profit-after-tax starting row ('Income Tax Expense'); the non-controlling interests' share added back where the reconciliation starts from the owners' profit ('Minority Interests(CF)'); the operating profit before working capital changes, a subtotal printed further down. It is a printed row; where the section prints no starting profit, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Other After Tax (Income)/Expense
items.definition: An item stated after tax that the indirect-method operating section prints as its own row beside the starting profit, adjusting it before the non-cash adjustments — for example the result of discontinued operations, net of tax, where the reconciliation starts from the profit of continuing operations and brings the discontinued result in on a separate row. It is not the starting profit itself ('Net Profit/(Loss)'), not the income tax added back ('Income Tax Expense'), not the non-controlling interests' share ('Minority Interests(CF)'), and not any pre-tax adjustment for non-cash items (depreciation, impairment, gains and losses on disposal, fair-value changes), each of which has its own line or falls to 'Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)'. Most HKFRS and CAS statements print no such row: answer with an empty sources list unless the operating section prints one. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Minority Interests(CF)
items.definition: The non-controlling (minority) interests' share of profit or loss, where the indirect-method operating section prints it as its own row adding it back to a starting profit that is attributable to owners of the parent only (少数股东损益, 'Non-controlling interests', 'Minority interests'). Where the reconciliation starts from the profit of the whole group — profit before tax on an HKFRS statement, 净利润 on a CAS reconciliation — the minority share is already inside the starting row and this line is empty. Not this line: dividends paid to non-controlling shareholders ('Dvds Paid(Minority S'holders)'); capital contributed by them ('Net Proceeds Issuance of Capital'); the starting profit ('Net Profit/(Loss)'). It is a printed row; where the section prints none, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Income Tax Expense
items.definition: The income tax expense added back in the indirect-method operating section, where the reconciliation starts from the profit for the year after tax: a row such as 'Income tax expense', 'Taxation' or 'Tax expense' (所得稅開支, 税项开支, 所得税费用) printed among the adjustments to that profit. It is the charge the income statement recognised, current and deferred together, not the tax paid in cash. Where the reconciliation starts from the profit before tax — usual on an HKFRS statement — there is no tax add-back and this line is empty; a CAS reconciliation starts from 净利润 and adjusts tax only through the deferred tax rows ('Chg in Deferred Taxes'). Not this line: income taxes paid in cash ('Income Taxes Paid(Indirect)'); the change in deferred tax assets and liabilities ('Chg in Deferred Taxes'); the change in tax payable ('Chg in Taxes Payable'). It is a printed row; where the section prints none, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Depreciation
items.definition: Depreciation added back to profit in the indirect-method operating section: depreciation of property, plant and equipment, of right-of-use assets and of investment properties carried at cost, depletion of oil and gas assets, and the amortisation of land use rights and leasehold land — 'Depreciation', 'Depreciation of property, plant and equipment', 'Depreciation of right-of-use assets' (物業、廠房及設備折舊, 使用權資產折舊). On a CAS filing it is the rows of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量) for 固定资产折旧、油气资产折耗、生产性生物资产折旧 and 使用权资产折旧, together. Where the filing prints depreciation in several rows (by class of asset), this line is their total; where it prints one combined row for depreciation and amortisation ('Depreciation and amortisation', 'Depreciation, depletion and amortisation', 折旧及摊销) or depreciation and impairment, that row is this line as printed and is not split. Not this line: amortisation of other intangible assets and of long-term prepaid expenses, and impairment losses, where printed on rows of their own ('Amortization & Asset Impairment'); the gain or loss on disposal of fixed assets ('Cash Flow Disp Fixed Assets'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Amortization & Asset Impairment
items.definition: Amortisation of intangible assets and the impairment of assets added back to profit in the indirect-method operating section: amortisation of other intangible assets and of long-term deferred or prepaid expenses, impairment losses (and reversals, as negative figures) on property, plant and equipment, intangible assets, goodwill and other assets, write-downs of inventories, and expected credit losses on receivables — rows such as 'Amortisation of intangible assets', 'Impairment of property, plant and equipment', 'Impairment of trade receivables, net', 'Expected credit loss'. On a CAS filing it is the rows of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量) for 信用减值损失, 资产减值损失 (or 资产减值准备), 无形资产摊销 and 长期待摊费用摊销, together. Where the filing prints these in several rows this line is their total. Not this line: depreciation of property, plant and equipment and right-of-use assets, or a combined depreciation and amortisation row ('Depreciation'); fair-value changes on investment properties or financial assets, which are not impairment ('Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)'); gains and losses on disposal ('Cash Flow Disp Fixed Assets', 'Cash Flow Disp Financial Assets'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Cash Flow from Hedging(Oper)
items.definition: Cash paid or received on hedging and other derivative instruments that the operating activities section of the cash flow statement prints as a row of its own — for example 'Settlement of derivative financial instruments' or 'Cash flow from hedging' printed within operating activities. A fair-value gain or loss on derivatives added back among the adjustments to profit ('Fair value losses on interest rate swaps', 衍生工具) is a non-cash adjustment, not a cash flow, and is not this line. Derivative cash flows printed under investing activities are 'Cash Flow Hedging(Invest)', and under financing activities 'Cash Flow from Hedging(Fin)'. Most statements print no such row in the operating section: answer with an empty sources list unless one is printed. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Assoc Profit Share(Net of Dvds)
items.definition: The share of profits or losses of associates and joint ventures taken out of profit in the indirect-method operating section, as the statement prints it among the adjustments: 'Share of profits and losses of associates', 'Share of profits and losses of joint ventures', 'Share of results of associates' (應佔聯營公司損益, 應佔合營公司業績), or rows captioned 'Associates' and 'Joint ventures' (聯營公司, 合營公司) under a 'Share of profits and losses of' subheading. Where the filing prints associates and joint ventures on separate rows this line is their total, and where it prints the share net of the dividends received from those entities, that net row is this line. Not this line: dividends received from associates and joint ventures printed on their own row ('Dividends Received(Oper)' in the operating section, 'Dividends Received(Invest)' in investing); gains or losses on disposing of an associate or joint venture, and their impairment (adjustments that fall to 'Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)' unless a dedicated line claims them). A CAS reconciliation's 投资损失 row covers all investment income and is not this line. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Interest Inc Received(Oper)
items.definition: Interest received in cash that the cash flow statement prints within its operating activities section — typically a row 'Interest received' or 'Bank interest received' (已收利息) below 'Cash generated from operations', beside the tax and interest paid rows. The interest income deducted among the adjustments to profit ('Interest income', 'Bank interest income', 利息收入) is the reversal of an income-statement credit, not cash received, and is not this line (it falls to 'Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)'). Interest received printed under investing activities is 'Interest Income Rcvd(Invest)'. Where the operating section prints no interest received row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Interest Expense
items.definition: The finance costs added back to profit among the adjustments of the indirect-method operating section: 'Finance costs', 'Interest expense', 'Interest expense on lease liabilities' (財務費用, 融資成本, 財務成本, 利息開支). On a CAS filing it is the 财务费用 row of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量) (收益以“－”号填列). Where the statement prints finance costs in more than one adjustment row this line is their total. It is the charge recognised in profit, not cash paid: interest paid in cash is 'Interest Paid(Oper)' when printed in the operating section and 'Interest Paid(Fin)' when printed in financing. Not this line: interest income deducted among the adjustments, which falls to 'Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)'; exchange differences printed on a row of their own. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Cash Flow Disp Fixed Assets
items.definition: The gain or loss on disposing of, scrapping or writing off fixed assets, taken out of profit among the adjustments of the indirect-method operating section: '(Gain)/loss on disposal of items of property, plant and equipment', 'Gain on disposal of investment properties', 'Loss on disposal of right-of-use assets', 'Written-off of property, plant and equipment'. On a CAS filing it is the rows of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量) for 资产处置损失 (or 处置固定资产、无形资产和其他长期资产的损失) and 固定资产报废损失, together. Where several such rows are printed this line is their total. Not this line: the cash proceeds of the disposal, which are investing cash flows ('Proceeds Sale PPE', 'Proceeds Sale Investment Prop'); gains or losses on disposing of financial assets ('Cash Flow Disp Financial Assets'), of subsidiaries, associates or joint ventures; impairment of fixed assets ('Amortization & Asset Impairment'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Cash Flow Disp Financial Assets
items.definition: The realised gain or loss on disposing of or derecognising financial assets, taken out of profit among the adjustments of the indirect-method operating section: 'Realised gains on derecognition of financial assets at fair value through profit or loss', '(Gains)/losses on disposal of financial assets', and the same for financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income, at amortised cost, available-for-sale or held-to-maturity investments and short-term securities. Where several such rows are printed this line is their total. Not this line: unrealised fair-value gains and losses on financial assets still held ('Fair value (gains)/losses from financial assets at fair value through profit or loss'), which fall to 'Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)'; the cash proceeds of the disposal ('Proceeds Sale Fncl Assets'); gains or losses on disposing of fixed assets ('Cash Flow Disp Fixed Assets'). A CAS reconciliation's 投资损失 row covers all investment income and is not this line. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Trade Receivables
items.definition: The (increase)/decrease in trade receivables: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' — 'Decrease in trade receivables', 'Increase in trade receivables', '(Increase)/decrease in debtors', and the change in bills receivable and receivables financing. Where the filing prints one row for trade and other receivables together ('(Increase)/decrease in trade and other receivables'), that row is this line as printed and is not split. On a CAS filing it is the 经营性应收项目的减少 row of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量), as printed, whatever operating receivables it takes in. Not this line: other receivables, deposits and prepayments printed on their own rows ('Chg in Other Receivables', 'Chg in Prepayments & Def Assets'); contract assets ('Chg in Other Current Assets'); impairment of receivables, which is an adjustment to profit ('Amortization & Asset Impairment'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Other Receivables
items.definition: The (increase)/decrease in other receivables and deposits paid: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' — '(Increase)/decrease in other receivables', 'Increase in deposits paid', and a row the filing prints for prepayments, deposits and other receivables together ('Increase in prepayments, deposits and other receivables'), which is this line as printed and is not split. Not this line: trade receivables, or trade and other receivables printed as one row ('Chg in Trade Receivables'); prepayments printed on a row of their own ('Chg in Prepayments & Def Assets'); amounts due from associates, joint ventures or related parties printed under investing activities; contract assets ('Chg in Other Current Assets'). On a CAS reconciliation the single 经营性应收项目的减少 row is 'Chg in Trade Receivables', and nothing is split out to this line. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Inventories
items.definition: The (increase)/decrease in inventories: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' — 'Decrease in inventories', '(Increase)/decrease in inventories' (存貨減少). For a property developer the properties it builds for sale are its inventories, so the change in properties under development for sale and in completed properties held for sale ('Decrease in inventories of properties', 'Increase in properties under development', 'Decrease in completed properties held for sale') is this line too; where several such rows are printed this line is their total. On a CAS filing it is the 存货的减少 row of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量). Not this line: a write-down of inventories to net realisable value, which is an adjustment to profit ('Amortization & Asset Impairment'); additions to investment properties, which are investing cash flows ('Purchase Investment Property'); contract assets or contract costs ('Chg in Other Current Assets', 'Chg in Prepayments & Def Assets'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Prepayments & Def Assets
items.definition: The (increase)/decrease in prepayments and deferred assets: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' — '(Increase)/decrease in prepayments', 'Decrease in deferred expenses', 'Decrease in contract costs'. Where the filing prints prepayments together with deposits and other receivables in one row, that row is 'Chg in Other Receivables' and is not split. Not this line: other receivables and deposits ('Chg in Other Receivables'); trade receivables ('Chg in Trade Receivables'); contract assets and other current assets ('Chg in Other Current Assets'); deferred tax assets ('Chg in Deferred Taxes'); amortisation of long-term prepaid expenses, which is an adjustment to profit ('Amortization & Asset Impairment'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Fncl Instruments(Trading)
items.definition: The change in financial instruments held for trading: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' — '(Increase)/decrease in financial assets at fair value through profit or loss', 'Decrease in a financial asset at fair value through profit or loss', 'Increase/decrease in financial liabilities held for trading', where the statement classifies those trading positions within operating activities. It is a movement in the balance, not a gain or loss: unrealised fair-value changes added back among the adjustments fall to 'Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)', and realised gains on disposal are 'Cash Flow Disp Financial Assets'. Purchases and disposals of financial assets printed under investing activities are 'Purchase Financial Assets' and 'Proceeds Sale Fncl Assets'. Where the operating section prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Other Current Assets
items.definition: The (increase)/decrease in other current assets: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' — '(Increase)/decrease in other current assets', 'Increase in contract assets', and a movement in another current asset the section prints on its own row that no more specific line takes. Where the filing prints several such rows this line is their total. Not this line: trade receivables ('Chg in Trade Receivables'); other receivables and deposits ('Chg in Other Receivables'); inventories, including a developer's properties for sale ('Chg in Inventories'); prepayments and contract costs ('Chg in Prepayments & Def Assets'); trading financial instruments ('Chg in Fncl Instruments(Trading)'). On a CAS reconciliation the single 经营性应收项目的减少 row is 'Chg in Trade Receivables', and nothing is split out to this line. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Trade Payables
items.definition: The increase/(decrease) in trade payables: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' — 'Increase in trade and bills payables', 'Decrease in trade payables' (應付貿易賬款及應付票據增加), including bills and notes payable to suppliers. Where the filing prints one row for trade and other payables together ('Increase in trade and other payables', 'Decrease in trade payables, other payables and accrued liabilities'), that row is this line as printed and is not split. On a CAS filing it is the 经营性应付项目的增加 row of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量), as printed, whatever operating payables it takes in. Not this line: other payables and accruals, contract liabilities and customer deposits printed on their own rows ('Chg in Other Current Liab'); tax payable ('Chg in Taxes Payable'); provisions ('Chg in Provisions'); amounts due to related parties printed under financing activities. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Provisions
items.definition: The increase/(decrease) in provisions: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' — 'Increase in provision for warranties', 'Increase in provision for major overhauls, net', 'Decrease in provisions' (預計負債增加), for warranty, restoration, onerous contract, litigation and similar provisions. Where several such rows are printed this line is their total. Not this line: retirement and other post-employment benefit obligations ('Chg in Post Employ Bnft Oblig'); impairment allowances against assets, which are adjustments to profit ('Amortization & Asset Impairment'); accruals and other payables ('Chg in Other Current Liab'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Post Employ Bnft Oblig
items.definition: The increase/(decrease) in post-employment benefit obligations: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations', or among the adjustments to profit — 'Increase in retirement benefit obligations', 'Decrease in defined benefit obligations', 'Provision for long service payments', the movement in pension and other post-employment benefit liabilities. Where several such rows are printed this line is their total. Not this line: other provisions ('Chg in Provisions'); accrued salaries and other short-term employee payables, which are part of accruals ('Chg in Other Current Liab'); equity-settled share-based payment expense ('Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)'). Where the section prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Other Current Liab
items.definition: The increase/(decrease) in other current liabilities: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' — 'Increase in other payables and accruals', 'Decrease in contract liabilities', 'Increase/(decrease) in customer deposits', 'Increase in deposits received, deferred income and contract liabilities', 'Increase in accruals', 'Decrease in other liabilities'. Where several such rows are printed this line is their total. Not this line: trade payables, or trade and other payables printed as one row ('Chg in Trade Payables'); tax payable ('Chg in Taxes Payable'); provisions ('Chg in Provisions'); post-employment benefit obligations ('Chg in Post Employ Bnft Oblig'); amounts due to related parties and advances from non-controlling shareholders printed under financing activities. On a CAS reconciliation the single 经营性应付项目的增加 row is 'Chg in Trade Payables', and nothing is split out to this line. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Other Wkng Capital Items
items.definition: A working-capital movement that is none of the specific lines beside it: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' under a caption that names other working capital ('Changes in other working capital items', 'Other working capital movements'), or a movement the section itself groups as working capital in a balance no specific line covers. Its peers are the specific movements — 'Chg in Trade Receivables', 'Chg in Other Receivables', 'Chg in Inventories', 'Chg in Prepayments & Def Assets', 'Chg in Fncl Instruments(Trading)', 'Chg in Other Current Assets', 'Chg in Trade Payables', 'Chg in Provisions', 'Chg in Post Employ Bnft Oblig', 'Chg in Other Current Liab', 'Chg in Taxes Payable' and 'Chg in Deferred Taxes' — and a row any of them takes is not this line. It is a printed row, not a remainder: do not work it out as the difference between cash generated from operations and the other rows. Where the section prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Taxes Payable
items.definition: The increase/(decrease) in taxes payable: a movement in working capital printed in the indirect-method operating section, between the adjusted profit and 'Cash generated from operations' — 'Increase in tax payable', 'Decrease in other taxes payable', 'Increase in taxes payable' (應交稅費增加), the movement in the balance of taxes owed. It is not the tax paid in cash ('Income Taxes Paid(Indirect)'), not the income tax expense added back ('Income Tax Expense'), and not the change in deferred tax assets or liabilities ('Chg in Deferred Taxes'). Where the section prints no such row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Chg in Deferred Taxes
items.definition: The change in deferred tax assets and liabilities taken into the indirect-method operating section as an adjustment to profit: 'Deferred tax', 'Increase/decrease in deferred taxes', 'Deferred income tax'. On a CAS filing it is the rows of the reconciliation of net profit to operating cash flow that a CAS cash flow statement prints as its supplement (现金流量表补充资料, 将净利润调节为经营活动现金流量) for 递延所得税资产减少 and 递延所得税负债增加, together. Where two rows are printed this line is their total. Not this line: the income tax expense added back as a whole ('Income Tax Expense'); income taxes paid ('Income Taxes Paid(Indirect)'); the change in tax payable ('Chg in Taxes Payable'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Dividends Received(Oper)
items.definition: Dividends received in cash that the cash flow statement prints within its operating activities section — 'Dividends received', 'Dividends received from associates', 'Dividend from joint ventures', 'Distribution received from joint ventures' (已收股息, 聯營公司的股息, 合營公司的股息). Where several such rows are printed in the operating section this line is their total. Dividends received printed under investing activities are 'Dividends Received(Invest)', which is where most statements put them. The dividend income deducted among the adjustments to profit ('Dividend income from financial assets at fair value through profit or loss') is the reversal of an income-statement credit, not cash received, and is not this line. Where the operating section prints no dividends received row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Income Taxes Paid(Indirect)
items.definition: Income taxes paid in cash, printed in the operating activities section of an indirect-method cash flow statement, usually below 'Cash generated from operations': 'Income tax paid', 'Tax paid' (已付稅項), 'Hong Kong profits tax paid, net', 'Chinese Mainland taxes paid, net', 'PRC corporate income tax paid', 'Overseas taxes paid, net'. Where the statement prints taxes paid in several rows (by jurisdiction, or a refund received beside the payment), this line is their total; a PRC land appreciation tax paid row is part of it where the filing charges that tax within its income tax expense. It is cash paid, not the charge: the income tax expense added back is 'Income Tax Expense', and the change in tax payable is 'Chg in Taxes Payable'. A direct-method statement's taxes paid row — on a CAS statement 支付的各项税费 and 收到的税费返还 — is 'Income Taxes Paid(Direct)', not this line. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Interest Paid(Oper)
items.definition: Interest paid in cash that the cash flow statement prints within its operating activities section — 'Interest paid', 'Interest paid on bank borrowings', 'Interest paid on guaranteed notes' (已付利息), usually below 'Cash generated from operations'. Where several such rows are printed in the operating section this line is their total, including the interest element of lease payments where it is printed there. Interest paid printed under financing activities is 'Interest Paid(Fin)', and the two are told apart only by the section the row is printed in. It is cash paid, not the charge: the finance costs added back among the adjustments to profit are 'Interest Expense'. Where the operating section prints no interest paid row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Dividends Paid(Oper)
items.definition: Dividends paid in cash that the cash flow statement prints within its operating activities section ('Dividends paid', 已付股息) — an uncommon classification that HKFRS permits. Dividends paid printed under financing activities, where nearly every statement puts them, are 'Dividends Paid(Fin)', with dividends paid to non-controlling shareholders 'Dvds Paid(Minority S'holders)'; the two are told apart from this line only by the section the row is printed in. Where the operating section prints no dividends paid row, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Cash Flow Extraord Items(Oper)
items.definition: Cash flows from extraordinary items, where the operating activities section prints a row the filing itself labels as extraordinary ('Cash flow from extraordinary items'). Neither HKFRS nor CAS lets a filing present items as extraordinary, so this line is normally empty: an unusual or one-off item printed under another caption — a compensation received, a litigation settlement, a government grant — is not this line, and falls to the line its nature fits or to 'Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)'. Extraordinary cash flows printed under investing or financing activities are 'Cash Flow Extraord Items(Invest)' and 'Cash Flow Extraord Items(Fin)'. Where no such row is printed, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect).

items.label: Other Non-Cash Adjs(Oper)
items.definition: The operating section's remainder: every row printed on the face of the indirect-method operating section — an adjustment to profit or a working-capital movement — that no dedicated line of this template claims, such as equity-settled share-based payment expense, unrealised foreign exchange differences, a gain on bargain purchase, fair-value changes on investment properties and on financial assets still held, gains and losses on disposing of subsidiaries, associates and joint ventures, interest and dividend income deducted, and a CAS reconciliation's 投资损失 and 公允价值变动损失 rows. Its figure is the sum of those rows at their printed signs, each kept with its own caption; it is never worked out as the printed subtotal less the lines the template has mapped. Not this line: any subtotal or total — 'Operating profit before working capital changes', 'Cash generated from operations', the net cash flow from operating activities ('Cash Flows Oper Activ(Indirect)'); a row a dedicated line takes; and the direct-method rows a CAS statement prints, 收到其他与经营活动有关的现金 and 支付其他与经营活动有关的现金. Where a row fits a dedicated line, it belongs to that line and not here; do not add this line up yourself.

items.label: Borrowing Costs Paid
items.definition: Interest and other borrowing costs paid in cash, where a direct-method operating section prints them as a row of its own ('Interest paid', 'Borrowing costs paid', 'Interest expenses' printed among the direct-method receipts and payments). items.label: Cash Flows Oper Activ(Direct)
items.definition: The subtotal the filing PRINTS as 'Cash Flows Oper Activ(Direct)', reported in the operating section of the cash flow statement. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with a figure added up from those components: the arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a subtotal the filing states itself is the more authoritative number. Not this line: acquisitions of subsidiaries ('Acq of Sub(Net of Cash Acqrd)'); purchases of other equity investments held as financial assets ('Purchase Financial Assets'); proceeds, repayments and capital returned by associates and joint ventures ('Sale Assoc & Affiliates'); dividends received from them ('Dividends Received(Invest)'); advances to related parties that are not associates or joint ventures ('Other Invest Cash Flows'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows from Invest Activities.

Where several such rows are printed this line is their total. Not this line: dividends received from associates and joint ventures ('Dividends Received(Invest)'); the gain or loss on the disposal, an adjustment in the operating section; investments in and advances to them ('Investment Assoc & Affiliates'); proceeds from disposing of subsidiaries ('Proceeds Sale of Subsidiary'). items.label: Payment Fin Lease Liab
items.definition: Payments of finance lease liabilities that the statement classifies as investing — a row 'Payment for finance lease liability' or 'Payments of finance lease obligations' printed in the investing activities section of the cash flow statement. This line takes only a row printed under investing activities. Lease payments printed under financing activities — 'Principal portion of lease payments', 'Lease payments', 'Repayments of lease liabilities' (支付租賃本金部份) — are not this line, and neither is the interest element of lease payments ('Interest Paid(Fin)' or 'Interest Paid(Oper)', by the section it is printed in). Purchases of right-of-use assets are 'Purchase PPE'. Most statements print no lease payment in the investing section: answer with an empty sources list unless one is printed there. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows from Invest Activities.

items.label: Interest Income Rcvd(Invest)
items.definition: Interest received in cash, printed in the investing activities section of the cash flow statement: 'Interest received', 'Bank interest received', 'Interest income received' (已收利息, 銀行利息收入), including interest received on loans, deposits and debt investments. Where several such rows are printed in this section this line is their total. Interest received printed within the operating activities section is 'Interest Inc Received(Oper)', and the two are told apart only by the section the row is printed in. A CAS statement's 取得投资收益收到的现金 (cash received from investment income) is 'Dividends Received(Invest)' as printed, and nothing of it is split out to this line. Not this line: the interest income deducted among the adjustments to profit in the operating section, which is not a cash receipt; dividends received ('Dividends Received(Invest)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows from Invest Activities.

items.label: Dividends Received(Invest)
items.definition: Dividends and other distributions received in cash from investments, printed in the investing activities section of the cash flow statement: 'Dividends received', 'Dividend received from an associate', 'Dividends received from joint ventures', 'Dividends received from financial assets at fair value through profit or loss' or 'through other comprehensive income' (已收股息, 聯營公司的股息, 合營公司的股息, 自合營公司收取的分派). Where several such rows are printed in this section this line is their total. On a CAS statement it is 取得投资收益收到的现金 (cash received from investment income), as printed. Dividends received printed within the operating activities section are 'Dividends Received(Oper)'. Not this line: the dividend income deducted among the adjustments to profit in the operating section, which is not a cash receipt; the share of profits of associates and joint ventures ('Assoc Profit Share(Net of Dvds)'); capital returned by a joint venture ('Sale Assoc & Affiliates'); interest received ('Interest Income Rcvd(Invest)'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows from Invest Activities.

items.label: Cash Flow Extraord Items(Invest)
items.definition: Cash flows from extraordinary items, where the investing activities section prints a row the filing itself labels as extraordinary ('Cash flow from extraordinary items'). Neither HKFRS nor CAS lets a filing present items as extraordinary, so this line is normally empty: an unusual investing cash flow printed under another caption is not this line, and falls to the line its nature fits or to 'Other Invest Cash Flows'. Extraordinary cash flows printed under operating or financing activities are 'Cash Flow Extraord Items(Oper)' and 'Cash Flow Extraord Items(Fin)'. Where no such row is printed, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows from Invest Activities.

items.label: Cash Flow Hedging(Invest)
items.definition: Cash received or paid on hedging and other derivative instruments, printed in the investing activities section of the cash flow statement: 'Proceeds from derivatives', 'Payment for derivatives', 'Settlement of derivative financial instruments', '(Increase)/decrease in derivative financial instruments'. Where several such rows are printed this line is their total. Derivative cash flows printed under operating activities are 'Cash Flow from Hedging(Oper)', and under financing activities — for example realised gains on derivatives hedging borrowings — 'Cash Flow from Hedging(Fin)'. Not this line: fair-value gains or losses on derivatives taken out of profit in the operating section, which are not cash flows. Where no such row is printed, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows from Invest Activities.

items.label: Other Invest Cash Flows
items.definition: The investing section's remainder: every row printed on the face of the investing activities section that no dedicated line of this template claims — advances to and repayments from related parties other than associates and joint ventures, loans advanced to third parties and repayments received, government grants received for assets, placements and withdrawals of pledged, restricted and time deposits, and on a CAS statement 收到其他与投资活动有关的现金 and 支付其他与投资活动有关的现金. Its figure is the sum of those rows at their printed signs, each kept with its own caption; it is never worked out as the printed subtotal less the lines the template has mapped. Not this line: the net cash flow from investing activities ('Cash Flows from Invest Activities') or any subtotal such as 投资活动现金流入小计; a row printed under the operating or financing activities headings; the net increase or decrease in cash and cash equivalents; a row a dedicated line takes. Where a row fits a dedicated line, it belongs to that line and not here; do not add this line up yourself.

items.label: Net Proceeds Issuance of Capital

Not this line: share issue and listing expenses paid on a row of their own, distributions to and redemptions of perpetual capital securities, acquisitions of non-controlling interests, and capital returned to non-controlling shareholders ('Other Financing Cash Flows'); repurchases of the company's own shares ('Purchase(Sale) Treasury Stock'); proceeds from borrowings ('Proceeds Non-Cur Borrowings'). items.label: Purchase(Sale) Treasury Stock
items.definition: Cash paid to buy back the company's own shares, less cash received on reissuing them, printed in the financing activities section of the cash flow statement: 'Repurchase of shares', 'Purchase of shares under share award scheme', 'Shares repurchased for cancellation', 'Proceeds from sale of treasury shares'. A purchase is an outflow and a sale an inflow; where both are printed this line is their total. Not this line: proceeds from issuing new shares or on the exercise of share options ('Net Proceeds Issuance of Capital'); acquisitions of non-controlling interests in subsidiaries ('Other Financing Cash Flows'); redemptions of perpetual securities ('Other Financing Cash Flows'). A CAS statement prints no separate face row for share buy-backs — they sit within 支付其他与筹资活动有关的现金 — and this line is then empty. items.label: Proceeds Non-Cur Borrowings
items.definition: Cash received from new borrowings, printed in the financing activities section of the cash flow statement: 'New bank loans', 'New bank borrowings raised', 'Proceeds from bank and other loans', 'Cash received from borrowings', 'New loans' (新增銀行及其他貸款, 新增貸款), proceeds from issuing bonds, debentures, guaranteed and senior notes ('Proceeds from issuance of senior notes and domestic bonds'), and proceeds from finance lease and sale-and-leaseback financing. Where the filing does not separate long-term from short-term borrowings, its new borrowings row is this line as printed. On a CAS statement it is 取得借款收到的现金, together with 发行债券收到的现金 where the statement prints that row. Not this line: borrowings the statement identifies as short-term or current ('Increase in short-term borrowings', 'Proceeds from short-term loans', trade financing), which are 'Chg in Current Borrowings'; advances from related parties, shareholders and non-controlling shareholders ('Other Financing Cash Flows'); repayments ('Repayments Non-Cur Borrowings'). It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows from Finance Activities.

items.label: Chg in Current Borrowings
items.definition: The cash movement in short-term borrowings, printed in the financing activities section of the cash flow statement, where the statement identifies the borrowings as short-term or current: a net row ('Increase/(decrease) in short-term borrowings', 'Net change in trade financing', 'Increase/decrease in trust receipt loans') or separate proceeds and repayment rows ('Increase in short-term borrowings' and 'Repayments of short-term borrowings', 'Proceeds from short-term loans'), which this line takes together as their net total. items.label: Interest Paid(Fin)

items.label: Translation Adj Relating to Cash
items.definition: A foreign currency translation adjustment printed in the financing activities section of the cash flow statement, inside the net cash flow from financing activities — a row 'Translation adjustment' or 'Exchange translation differences' that the statement places among its financing cash flows and counts in that subtotal. The usual row for the effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents — 'Effect of foreign exchange rate changes, net', 'Translation of foreign currency', 汇率变动对现金及现金等价物的影响 — is printed below the financing subtotal, outside it, and is 'Net Foreign Exchange Difference', not this line. Unrealised exchange differences adjusted in the operating section are not this line either. Most statements print no such row inside the financing section: answer with an empty sources list unless one is printed there. items.label: Cash Flow Extraord Items(Fin)

Neither HKFRS nor CAS lets a filing present items as extraordinary, so this line is normally empty: an unusual financing cash flow printed under another caption is not this line, and falls to the line its nature fits or to 'Other Financing Cash Flows'. Extraordinary cash flows printed under operating or investing activities are 'Cash Flow Extraord Items(Oper)' and 'Cash Flow Extraord Items(Invest)'. Where no such row is printed, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows from Finance Activities.

items.label: Cash Flow from Hedging(Fin)
items.definition: Cash received or paid on hedging and other derivative instruments, printed in the financing activities section of the cash flow statement: 'Proceeds from derivatives', 'Payment for derivatives', 'Realised fair value gains from derivative financial instruments in hedges for borrowings', settlements of cross-currency and interest rate swaps hedging borrowings. Where several such rows are printed this line is their total. Derivative cash flows printed under operating activities are 'Cash Flow from Hedging(Oper)', and under investing activities 'Cash Flow Hedging(Invest)'. Not this line: fair-value gains or losses on derivatives taken out of profit in the operating section, which are not cash flows; the borrowings the derivatives hedge ('Proceeds Non-Cur Borrowings', 'Repayments Non-Cur Borrowings'). Where no such row is printed, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into Cash Flows from Finance Activities.

items.label: Dividends Paid(Fin)
items.definition: Cash paid as dividends, reported in the financing activities section of the cash flow statement. Where the statement prints dividends and interest paid as one row — on a CAS statement '分配股利、利润或偿付利息支付的现金' (cash paid for distributing dividends or profits, or for paying interest) — that combined row is this line's figure, interest included, and it is not split. Otherwise this line is the row the statement prints for dividends paid. An 'of which' row printed under the combined row for dividends paid by subsidiaries to non-controlling shareholders (其中：子公司支付给少数股东的股利、利润) is part of that figure, not this line's.

items.label: Net Foreign Exchange Difference
items.definition: The effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents, printed below the net cash flows of the three activities and outside them: 'Effect of foreign exchange rate changes, net', 'Effect of changes in exchange rates on cash and cash equivalents', 'Translation of foreign currency' (匯率變動的影響淨額, 匯率變動的影響). On a CAS statement it is 四、汇率变动对现金及现金等价物的影响, as printed. Where no such row is printed, answer with an empty sources list. It is one of the lines this template's rollup adds into End of Period-Cash & Cash Equiv.

items.label: End of Period-Cash & Cash Equiv

It closes the whole statement and is not part of the financing activities section. It is the statement's own closing figure, which can differ from the cash and bank balances of the balance sheet (time deposits over three months, restricted or pledged cash, bank overdrafts). Read the printed row. Do not compute it here and do not replace it with the opening cash plus the year's net cash flows and the exchange difference: that arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup, and a closing figure the statement prints is the more authoritative number. What the printed figure and that arithmetic leave between them is 'Unexplained Adjustment to Cash'. Not this line: the cash and cash equivalents at the beginning of the period ('Beg of Period-Cash & Cash Equiv'); the rows of the analysis of balances of cash and cash equivalents printed under the statement; the balance sheet's cash line ('Cash in Hand and at Banks'). items.label: Unexplained Adjustment to Cash
items.definition: The part of the year's movement in cash and cash equivalents that the cash flow statement leaves unexplained: what remains between the closing cash and cash equivalents the statement prints and the opening cash and cash equivalents together with the net cash flows from operating, investing and financing activities and the net foreign exchange difference. It belongs to the foot of the statement, beside the opening and closing cash, and is not part of the financing activities section. Neither HKFRS nor CAS prints such a row — a statement that reconciles leaves nothing here — and the figure is this template's own check, whose arithmetic is declared in this template's rollup. Do not cite a row for it and do not compute it yourself: answer with an empty sources list and leave it to the rollup. Not this line: the effect of exchange rate changes on cash ('Net Foreign Exchange Difference'); the net increase or decrease in cash and cash equivalents; other financing cash flows ('Other Financing Cash Flows').

items.label: Related Party Transactions
items.definition: The total of the related-party TRANSACTIONS the related-party note prints for the year: sales of goods and services to related parties, purchases of goods and services from them, leases, interest, key management personnel compensation and the note's other transactions, added up from its parts. Year-end balances owed to or by related parties, the amounts of guarantees given or received, loan principals and commitments are not transactions of the year and are not added; they are quoted with the disclosure the line carries.

cascade.note: EVERY TRANSACTION CATEGORY THE RELATED-PARTY NOTE PRINTS, added up. Each part is one category the note tabulates separately (购销商品、提供和接受劳务 / 关联租赁 / 资金拆借 / 关键管理人员报酬 / 其他关联交易, or the HKFRS note's rows by nature of transaction), so no amount is in two parts. Every term is `any_of`: a filing that prints only key management pay (301577) resolves on that one, and one that prints none of them leaves the line empty rather than publishing zero. NOT `refuse_negative`: a category can be printed net of returns (300391's 销售商品 rows include -44,598.86), and the total is what the note adds up to. Balances, guarantees and loan principals are not parts — they are stocks, not flows of the year — and travel with the line as the quoted disclosure instead.

items.label: Sales of goods and services to related parties
items.definition: Sum of every amount the related-party note prints for goods sold and services rendered TO related parties in the period — sales of inventories, plant and equipment, processing, construction, management, utility and other services provided (出售商品/提供劳务) — row by row, signed as printed. Excludes lease or rental income, interest income, purchases and totals. Read only an amount printed for a reporting period (本期发生额 / 上期发生额, or the year's column); an amount printed with start and end dates and no period column, a balance at the year end, a guarantee amount, a loan principal and an approved transaction limit (获批的交易额度) are not transactions of the year.

items.label: How far Find 3 exceeded Find 1 (current securities overshoot)

cascade.note: Find 3 − Find 1: the securities expression with every sign inverted. PASSED OVER WHEN NEGATIVE, so it carries a figure only where Find 1 − Find 3 came out at or below zero — the filings where the current line publishes zero — and that figure is the Level 3 amount Find 1 could not absorb. CP_ZERO keys on it, and Securities (LTP) deducts it. The constant 0 is deliberately NOT a term: as a `required` one it would alone satisfy the base test, so a filing disclosing none of Find 1 would publish a bare 0.

items.label: Related-party receivables on the balance sheet (non-current)
items.definition: Sum of the non-current related-party receivable rows the balance sheet prints — due from shareholders, directors, subsidiaries and minority interests — excluding entrusted loans.

cascade.note:
The NON-CURRENT related-party receivable rows the balance sheet prints, added up. Every term is `any_of`, so a filing disclosing one of them resolves the rung and one disclosing none leaves Find 1 empty rather than publishing zero.

WHY ONLY THE NON-CURRENT ONES. This Find feeds `bs_nca__due_from_related_parties_ltp`, which the template rolls up into total non-current assets, while every CURRENT related-party receivable column (`bs_ca__due_from_related_parties_cp`, the JV and partnership line, the related-party trade receivable and the trade-and-other aggregate) is a child of total CURRENT assets and publishes in its own right. Adding those here puts one balance in both sections. Measured on China SCE, whose face prints a single "Due from related parties" 4,065,231 under CURRENT ASSETS: with them, the non-current children summed to 52,567,208 against a printed 49,227,234 — an overshoot of 3,339,974; without them the residual is -725,257, which is the ordinary under-extraction.

THE SIX ENTRUSTED-LOAN COLUMNS ARE ABSENT on purpose: 但不包括委托贷款, the spec's own exclusion, expressed by not naming them so there is no pattern to get wrong. The parent is not a term either — it selects between the three Finds, so naming it here would be a cycle.

BOTH MATURITIES IS THE DECLARED INTENT, and this Find is the one place that does not follow it. Instructed: "Template intent is both long and short term on related party." Find 3 already reads both — its row captions take 其他应收款 and 一年内到期的长期应收款 alongside 长期应收款 — and on 000709 it is the rung that wins, so the column publishes 379,049,251.75 / 347,653,398.14: the whole related-party receivable note net of its allowance, current balances included. The intent is therefore already met wherever the note is read.

WHAT KEEPS THE FACE RUNG NON-CURRENT ANYWAY is a measurement, not a disagreement with the instruction. Widening this rung to the four current columns (bs_ca__due_from_related_parties_cp, the JV and partnership line, the related-party trade receivable and the trade-and-other aggregate) was tried and measured on the corpus: on China SCE 1966 it published the face's 4,065,231 / 3,914,425 into the LTP column while bs_ca__due_from_related_parties_cp still published the same balance, and the bs_nca__total_non_current_assets reconciliation went from tying EXACTLY (49,227,234 reported against 49,227,234 accounted, and 60,780,612 against 60,780,612) to `mixed_scale` — the one section relation that filing proves, lost. The face prints CP and LTP as two rows and the template rolls them into two different section totals, so a face reading cannot take both without counting one balance twice; a NOTE reading can, because the note is a decomposition and not a section. That is the split the three Finds now record.

cascade.note: FIND 3 IS THE NET, and the note it reads publishes only the two halves. The spec asks for the 淨金額 (net amount); a 关联方应收应付款项 table prints 账面余额 and 坏账准备 and no net column, so the net is gross LESS allowance and has to be computed here. Measured on 000709 when Find 3 read the primary measure alone: 952,910,390.11 against a true net of 554,344,602.47, overstated by 398,565,787.64 — and 565,528,459.41 of that was one counterparty, 河北承钢工贸, whose allowance EQUALS its gross, so its net is zero and it had been counted at face value. The allowance is an `adjustment`, so a note printing no allowance column simply deducts nothing rather than killing the rung, and `refuse_negative` catches an allowance larger than the gross — which would mean the two columns had been read the wrong way round.

items.label: Non-operating income (face row)
items.definition: The income-statement row a mainland filing prints as 营业外收入 — non-operating income: gains outside ordinary operating activity that CAS presents on this line (government grants unrelated to ordinary activity presented here, penalty and compensation income, donations received, gains on debt restructuring). Read OFF THE FACE of the income statement, above 利润总额. It is one of the two halves of the template's single net column Other Non-Operating Inc(Exp), which is its parent and which sums the two. It is NOT 其他收益, NOT 投资收益 and NOT 资产处置收益 — each of those has its own template line — and it is not the net of income and expense.

items.label: Non-operating expenses (face row)
items.definition: The income-statement row a mainland filing prints as 营业外支出 — non-operating expenses: losses outside ordinary operating activity that CAS presents on this line (donations made, penalties and fines paid, extraordinary losses, losses on debt restructuring). Read OFF THE FACE of the income statement, above 利润总额, where CAS prints it as an UNSIGNED POSITIVE magnitude that the statement's own arithmetic deducts. It is one of the two halves of the template's single net column Other Non-Operating Inc(Exp), which is its parent and which sums the two, so this part must carry the figure NEGATIVE — see its sign_rule, which negates the CAS caption only, and its negative_expected sign_convention, which flags any remaining positive for review rather than coercing it.

items.label: Income taxes paid (direct-method face row)
items.definition: The cash-flow row a mainland filing prints as 支付的各项税费 — the income taxes and other levies actually PAID in cash during the period, read off the face of the direct-method operating section (CAS 31 presents the direct method on the face and the indirect reconciliation as a note). CAS prints it as an UNSIGNED POSITIVE magnitude that the statement's own 经营活动现金流出小计 subtotal deducts, so this part must carry the figure NEGATIVE — see its sign_rule, which negates the CAS captions only and leaves an HKFRS filing's already-bracketed figure alone. It is one of the two halves of the template's single net column Income Taxes Paid(Direct), which is its parent and which sums the two; the other half is the refund received. It is NOT the income tax EXPENSE of the income statement, which accrues rather than pays and has its own template line.

items.label: Tax refunds received (direct-method face row)
items.definition: The cash-flow row a mainland filing prints as 收到的税费返还 — refunds of tax RECEIVED in cash, most often the VAT export rebate and overpaid income tax, read off the face of the direct-method operating section above 经营活动现金流入小计. It is a cash INFLOW and stays positive. It is the second half of the template's single net column Income Taxes Paid(Direct), which is its parent and which sums the two, so the parent reports taxes paid NET of refunds — which is what a template carrying one tax line per statement can mean. Before this part existed the caption reached no concept and was swept into the operating section's residual bucket alongside the indirect reconciliation's non-cash adjustments, where it was added to two other direct-method rows under one figure.

items.label: Other receivables on the face of the balance sheet

items.label: Other non-current financial assets on the face of the balance sheet
items.definition:
The NON-CURRENT other financial assets as the balance sheet prints them, as their own row under non-current assets: 其他非流动金融资产 on a mainland (CAS) face, and on an HKFRS face the non-current 'Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss' or 'through other comprehensive income' rows. A face that prints 债权投资 or 其他债权投资 as non-current rows of their own is read here too.

EXCLUDES 其他权益工具投资 (other equity instrument investments), which is read on a line of its own. Where the face prints none of these rows, answer with an empty sources list.

items.label: Other equity instrument investments on the face of the balance sheet (其他权益工具投资)
items.definition: The NON-CURRENT equity investments designated at fair value through other comprehensive income as a mainland (CAS) balance sheet prints them, as their own row: 其他权益工具投资 under 非流动资产. Read both periods off the FACE, not the note: the CAS note prints the year's movement as COLUMNS (opening balance, additions, disposals, …, closing balance), so a figure in a note row is a movement or an opening balance rather than the line's closing figure.

items.label: Guarantees and similar exposures given — contingent liabilities note
items.definition: Sum of all guarantees, letters of credit, performance bonds and bank guarantees the entity has given and that are still in force at the reporting date, excluding litigation and other claims, commitments, credit facility limits, guarantees it received, its share of guarantees given by its joint ventures and associates, and totals. Only guarantees still in force — not those already fulfilled, released or expired.

items.definition: Other-business revenue (其他业务收入) for the period, as the revenue note of a mainland filing prints it in its own 其他业务 row beside 主营业务: revenue outside the principal business, such as the rental of assets and the sale of materials and scrap. Read the printed row, not the note's total less its principal row. The face's 营业收入 holds it but Sales(Revenues) does not, being the principal-business revenue only, so it is part of Other Operating Income. Count it once, not again from a breakdown of the revenue by product, region or timing.

items.definition: The exchange gains and losses for the period that the finance-expenses note of a mainland filing (财务费用) prints in a row of its own: 汇兑损益, 汇兑净损益, 汇兑损失. The note prints the row as part of a finance EXPENSE, so a loss is positive and a gain negative. Read the printed row, not the note's total less its interest rows. items.definition: The finance expenses other than interest and exchange differences that the finance-expenses note of a mainland filing (财务费用) prints in rows of their own for the period: bank and other financial-institution charges (手续费), cash discounts and discounting interest (现金折扣, 贴息), guarantee fees and income, and the note's own 其他 row. Sum those printed rows as the note prints them, an expense positive and an income negative. Not the interest rows, which the face prints, not the exchange row, and not the note's total less its other rows.

others_master.note: The section residuals — each line is its section's unexplained remainder, filled only by the sweep in `residual_framework`. Marking a line here is what makes it a bucket: `value_scope` and `residual_policy` are derived from this list at load, so the fact is stated once instead of three times per line.

cross_check_master.note: The calculated lines whose PRINTED subtotal is read off the filing and compared against the figure the components come to. A disagreement is a finding, not a correction: the published figure stays the computed one and the review queue carries the printed one beside it, because a component is then mis-mapped, missing or double-counted and that is what an analyst has to look at. A line left out of this list is still computed and published; it simply is not compared.

prose_grammar.note: How a filing places a figure in a sentence. Authored once: measured over the 28 hand-written patterns this replaces, the subject and the connective were identical on all seven prose lines and only the destination differed.
